tei:div.tei:p: /!#$&')*,-./0123༄༅// phyag chen smon lam gyi 'grel pa

kun gyis go bde ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob pa'i ched du lam bzang po phyag rgya chen po'i smon lam nyams su len par bgyi'o snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang bcas gsal btab ste gsan par gnang ba zhu/ de la gang zhig gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rim pa ni skabs 'dir karma pa gsum pa rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i nges don phyag rgya chen po'i smon lam zhes bya ba 'di skabs su babs pa'i zhu bar bya ba'i chos 'di red/ 1 phyag chen gyi 'grel bshad/ spyir btang phyag rgya chen po'i 'grel bshad la mkhas pa so so'i 'grel tshul ma 'dra ba mang po yod red/ spyir btang gi mdo lugs kyi phyag chen dang*/ sngags lugs kyi phyag chen/ 'di 'dras byas nas 'grel lugs khungs gtugs sa 'dra po rnam pa gnyis 'dra po zhig bshad/ de'i thog la gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag bshad yong dus thun mong mdo lugs kyi thog nas 'grel pa bshad stangs shig dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo la sbyar nas zab mo nang gi don rnam shes chen po byas stangs shig bcas/ rnam pa gnyis 'dra po zhig yod pa red 'dug /yin na yang thun mong ba la phyag rgya chen po 'di tshig dang don gyi thog nas gdul bya thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ rgyu dang*/ khams dang*/ dbang po dang*/ mos pa dang bstun nas bshad dgos pa yod pa yin dus thun mong gi sgo nas 'di 'dras bshad yong dus/ rtsa ba chos thams cad stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba 'di/ spyir btang gi dbu ma'i skabs nas bshad pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid lta ba gtan la phab stangs dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i skabs nas bshad pa'i stong pa nyid phab stangs la khyad par gang yang yod ma red/ yin na yang stong pa nyid kyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid gtan la pha"$

ba zer nas nges don mthar thug spros bral stong pa nyid gtan la phab zin pa'i rjes la/ rnal 'byor pas nang gi nyams su myong bya la thun mong ma yin pa'i med dgag stong nyid kyi cha rkyang pa tsam ma yin pa'i thun mong ma yin pa ma yin dgag gi cha la dbu ma gzhan stong pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs srol la rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi 'od gsal 'di ye gdod ma nas sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la lhan skyes kyi tshul du rang chas kyi tshul du yod pa dang*/ rang chas kyi tshul du yod na yang rang rig la bdag tu 'khrul nas rang snang la yul du 'khrul pa dang*/ rang rig la bdag tu 'khrul pa'i dbang gis gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang chas su yod na yang ngo zin ma thub pa yin pa dang*/ ngos zin na yang de la brtan pa thob ma thub/ brtan pa ma thob pa la brten nas phyag rgya chen po kho rang gzhung nang nas bshad bsdad yag gi kho rang dngos gnas drang gnas kyi nges don mthar thug 'di'i steng la btsan sa nas ma song na yang zin ma thub pa'i rgyu mtshan de 'dra la brten nas 'byung ba red zer nas/ dang po 'khor ba'i 'khrul tshul thog nas ngos 'dzin byed stangs ma 'dra ba zhig bshad/ bar du lam la gnad du smin nas nyams su blangs stangs thog nas ma 'dra ba zhig bshad yong dus/ de la brten nas spyir btang mthar thug gi 'bras bu 'di'i mthar thug 'di spyir btang gi chos nyid kyi gnas lugs dang*/ don dam pa'i bden pa 'di las khyad par gang yang yod ma red/ don dam kho rang ngo nas khyad par yod ma red de/ don dam pa gtan la phab yong dus phab stangs kyis lam gyi rim pa rgya chen po zhig yod pa yin dus 'bras bu kho rang thog nas kyang khyad par chen po zhig 'di 'dras bshad bsdad pa red 'dug / 'di 'dra yin dus phyag rgya chen po zer yag gi tshig gi 'grel bshad 'di/ phyag rgya chen po zer yong dus nga rang tsho rgyal po chen pos rang gi 'bangs la/

dka' ga re bsgos pa'i bya ba 'di sgrub par byed pa la rgyal pos bka' shog byas/ bka' shog gi 'og la rgyal pos don grub rgyab nas/ rgya rgyab nas bka' 'di mar 'bangs la btang yong dus 'bangs kyis ji bzhin du rgyal po'i bka' 'di las mi 'da' bar rgyal po'i rgya 'di las phar mi 'da' bar byas nas/ nang don ga re yod pa 'di khas len byed dgos kyi yod red/ las ka 'di sgrub dgos kyi yod red/ 'di'i dpe 'di sbyar yong dus/ da lta 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'di yi dbyings las ma 'da' ba'am 'di'i ngang du yod pa red/ de las phar 'da' ba med pa dang*/ de las phar ma 'da' ba'am 'di'i nang du yod pa dang*/ de las phar 'da' sa med pa'i cha nas phyag rgya zhes rgya 'di 'dras 'byung ba red/ phyag 'di spyir btang gi zur tshig gi tshig red/ spyir btang saṃskrita'i skad nang la yod ma red/ de 'dra yin dus/ chen po zer yag 'di gang ltar de las lhag pa med pa/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos gang 'dra zhig yin pa yin na yang*/ gang ltar nang gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'di'i ngang las phar ma 'da' ba'am 'di'i nang la yod bsdad pa yin pa song tsang chen po zer yag 'di rdzogs chen skabs la spyir btang gi kun tu bzang po'i 'grel bshad bshad stangs 'di tsho phal che ba gcig pa 'dra po yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus phyag rgya chen po zer ba'i tshig gi 'grel bshad 'di 'dra yong gi yod red/ don dag 'di gzhi'i phyag rgya chen po/ lam gyi phyag rgya chen po/ 'bras bu'i phyag rgya chen po zer nas gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum du sbyar nas bshad dgos kyi yod red/ de yin dus kho rang 'og la 'byung 'gyur gyi cha nas yong gi yod red/ 'di yin dus da lta dmigs bsal 'grel bshad mi dgos pa byas/ smon lam zer yag 'di spyir btang gi smon lam rgyab yag red/

bdag dang gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs nas phyag rgya chen po'i nang nas bshad bsdad yag gi thob bya 'bras bu gang yin pa ma nor ba dang ma 'khrul pa/ nges don nyams su len pa'i thog nas kho rang 'bras bu 'di lta bu zhig thob yag la smon lam rgyab pas na smon lam zhes lab pa red/ de yang 'bri gung gi phyag chen lnga ldan gyi nang la/ tshogs gnyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu la// smon lam gyis byi dor ma byas na// dgos 'dod kyi 'bras bu mi 'byung bas// rjes bsngo ba 'di la nan tan mdzod// ces gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi smon lam zer yag 'di bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis bsags na yang*/ de la smon lam zhig ma rgyab na phar phyin skabs nas bshad pa'i 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa nyi shu rtsa bdun zhes chos sku skabs nas bshad kyi yod red/ 'di yin pa'i skabs su chos sku'i skabs nas bshad bsdad ya'i phar phyin gyi 'phrin las nyi shu rtsa bdun/ 'thob bya 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa nyi shu rtsa bdun thob yag la dka' las khag po yod pa red 'dug /'di 'dra yin dus smon lam 'di mthu btsan pa yin pa dang*/ smon lam 'di rten 'brel gyi dbang gis chos nyid kyi nus pa rang chas su grub bsdad pa yin dus/ smon lam gal chen po yin dus phyag rgya chen po'i smon lam zer nas tha snyad sbyar dgos pa red 'dug /bzhugs so// ka smon lam 'grub phyir yul khyad 'phags la rnams dpang por gsol ba/ na mo gu ru/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas// bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi smon lam rnams// ji bzhin 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur byin rlabs mdzod// 1 phyi nang gsang ba'i skyabs 'gro/ bla ma rnams dang zhes pa de/ 'di dang po de la dran gso 'dra po zhig byas pa red/

dran gso byed yong dus dang po de la spyir btang thun mong la phyi'i skyabs 'gro/ nang gi skyabs 'gro/ de kho na nyid kyi skyabs 'gro zer nas skyabs 'gro la gsum yong gi yod red/ phyi'i skyabs 'gro de la lam ston pa po sangs rgyas/ lam du 'gyur ba dam pa'i chos/ lam sgrub pa'i grogs dge 'dun zer nas dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum thun mong ba nang pa sangs rgyas pa yin nas bzung ste skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po skyabs gnas mthar thug tu khas len nas de las gzhan pa'i skyabs gnas med par smra ba'i lugs srol 'go btsugs nas bzung ste gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bar la thams cad kyis phyi'i skyabs 'gro khas len stangs de la gcig pa gcig kyang chags bsdad yod red/ de nas nang gi skyabs 'gro la slebs yong dus nang gi skyabs 'gro'i thog la sngags dang 'brel yong dus bla ma dang*/ yi dam dang*/ mkha' 'gro'am bla ma yi dam chos skyong zer na yang 'grig gi yod red/ gang ltar nang gi skyabs 'gro zer nas 'di 'dra bzhag gi yod red/ de nas gsang ba'i skyabs 'gro bzhag yong dus rtsa dang*/ rlung dang*/ thig le gsum la bshad yong gi yod red/ de yang rtsa dag pa sku/ rlung dag pa gsung*/ thig le dag pa thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bshad nas/ gang ltar rtsa rlung thig le gsum po 'di/ dag yong dus sku gsung thugs kyi rol pa 'di bshad nas/ rtsa dang rlung dang thig le gsum gyi gnad dang 'brel yong dus sku gsum gyi rol pa cha tshang zhig bshad bsdad yod red/ 'o de kho na nyid kyi skyabs 'gro zer na'ang 'grig gi 'dug /gsang ba'i skyabs 'gro zer nas kyang bshad kyi yod red/ de'i nang nas de'i skabs la gtso bo 'di/ bla ma rnams dang zhes bshad yong dus nang gi skyabs 'gro thun mong ba bshad yong gi yod red/ yin na yang nang gi skyabs 'gro nang log la phyi'i skyabs 'gro tshang dgos kyi yod pa bshad yong gi yod red ma gtogs yang phyi'i skyabs 'gro dang nang gi skyabs 'gro de so so ba'am tha dad pa'i chos la bsam blo btang na mi 'grig pa red/

spyir btang gi ldog pa'i cha nas tha dad yong gi red de/ yin na yang nyams su len yong dus bla ma rnams dang zer ba'i skabs su bla ma'i nang la sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang*/ dge 'dun gsum ka tshang dgos kyi yod red/ dkon mchog gsum po skyabs gnas mthar thug rnams kyi rang bzhin 'di bla ma'i nang la tshang dgos kyi yin pa red/ de 'dra yin dus bla ma rnams dang zhes mang tshig gis sgra sbyar yong dus rang la chos dngos su sems don man ngag kha thug la bstan mkhan de la rtsa ba'i bla ma zhes lab pa red/ 2 mtshon byed kun rdzob kyi bla ma/ chos byin rlabs dang 'brel ba yod pa 'di la brgyud pa'i bla ma zhes lab pa red/ de'i nang nas gtso bo 'di skabs la rtsa ba'i bla ma la bzhag dgos kyi yod red de/ de'i zhor la drin dang ldan pa'i dngos brgyud kyi bla ma yongs rdzogs la go yong dus bla ma rnams dang zhes lab pa red/ mtshon bya don dam pa'i bla ma de yang mtshon byed kun rdzob kyi bla ma la brten nas 'gro dgos kyi yod pa yin pa red/ de yang nga rang tsho spyir btang thun mong du bla ma bsten zer yag 'di dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen las dam pa'i gdams ngag thob/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag thob nas 'di nyams su len nas mthar thug gi 'bras bu mtshon bya don gyi bla ma 'di mjal ba'am mtshon bya don gyi bla ma de thob thub dgos kyi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus mtshon bya don gyi bla ma zhes bya ba de yang mtshon byed kun rdzob kyi bla ma/ nga rang tsho spyir btang so so skye bo'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ sa chen po la gnas pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhes dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rnam grangs mang po bshad kyi yod red de/ dang po nga rang tsho las dang po pa'i chos nyams len byed mkhan la so so skye bo'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de gal che shos yin pa red/

so so skye bo'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten nas lam gyi rim pa nyams su len yong dus/ rim pas rim pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen sa chen po la gnas pa dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku de mjal thub kyi yod pa yin dus/ dang po bla ma de so so skye bo'i bla ma'am so so skye bo'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mjal dgos kyi yod red/ de yang so so skye bo'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam so so skye bo'i bla ma de la bsten nas snang ba brda yi bla ma zer ba'i skabs su slob sbyong ngam/ nyams len byed yong dus gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa phyi'i snang tshul ga re yod pa de phyi'i rten 'brel gyi snang ba ga re yod pa thams cad phyi'i rten 'brel gyi log par snang ba ga re shar yod pa de thams cad bla ma'i ngo bo la shar ba red/ bla ma'i ngo bor shar zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ga re red zer na/ de la brten nas phyi'i kun rdzob kyi brda dang*/ phyi'i kun rdzob kyi snang tshul dang*/ phyi'i kun rdzob kyi mthong tshul ga re yod pa nyams len gyi grogs la slebs nas nyams len yar gong 'phel 'gro yag dang*/ nyams len gyi grogs la slebs yong dus khos dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bya ba thams cad byed thub kyi yod red/ de la brten nas snang tshul phyi'i brda dang*/ thabs dang*/ man ngag la sogs pa dang*/ ga re yin na yang thams cad so so la sems don gyi man ngag de gong 'phel 'gro yag la thams cad kyi bya ba gcig pa byed pa'i cha nas snang ba brda yi bla ma zer yag de kun rdzob kyi gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa zer na yang 'grig gi 'dug /gang ltar reg tshor dang*/ rig pa dang*/ dbang shes drug gi yul du gyur pa'am/ gang ltar tshogs drug gi shes pa'i yul du gyur pa'i yul drug la sogs pa thams cad de yang snang ba brda yi bla ma'i nang la yong gi yod red/

snang tshul kun rdzob kyi chos 'di'i gnas lugs don dam pa de ma nor ba zhig la rab tu rtogs yong dus/ de yi steng nas mtshon bya don dam pa rtogs thub kyi yod red/ 3 mtshon bya don dam gyi bla ma/ mtshon bya don dam pa'i bla ma zer yag de mtshon bya don dam gyi bla ma de rang so so so so skye bo thams cad kyi rgyud la ye gdod ma nas lhan skyes kyi tshul du sems kyi rang bzhin la khyab bsdad pa dang*/ sems kyi rang bzhin la yod bsdad pa/ de 'dra'i sems kyi rang bzhin la yod pa dang*/ sems kyi rang bzhin la khyab bsdad pa de 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la yod bsdad yag de ngo shes na mtshon bya don dam gyi bla ma yin pa dang*/ ngo ma shes pa yin dus gang ltar rang snang dang rang rig la bdag tu 'khrul pa dang*/ de nas yul du 'khrul nas 'khor ba la 'khrul tshul 'di yong gi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus bla ma zer yag de la kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i sgra bshad gnyis rgyab dgos kyi yod red/ bla ma rnams dang byas/ 4 yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ yi dam zer yag de sngags kyi skabs la rang gi bstan bya thun mong ma yin pa'i brda dang*/ thabs dang*/ man ngag la sogs pa 'di'i nang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgom pa dang*/ lha'i gsal snang ma bral ba'i thog nas sems don gyi man ngag de sems don gyi nyams len gong 'phel du 'gro thub yag gi grogs byed mkhan de la yi dam zhes lab pa red 'dug /tshig gis sgra bshad thog nas bshad yong dus/ yi dam de la yang spyir btang gi mang po yod pa red/

yi dam dkyil 'khor lha'i dkyil 'khor zer yag de spyir btang gi sngags kyi nang la yang de nyid bcu zer yag cig yong gi yod red/ de nyid bcu'i nang mtshan nang la gtso bo 'di lha'i dkyil 'khor zer nas bshad bsdad kyi yod red/ gtso bo 'di nang gi rang byung 'od gsal gyi ye shes de la lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khor gyis bskor bsdad pa 'di la dkyil 'khor zer nas sngags kyi skabs la sgra bshad 'di 'dra yong gi yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus dkyil 'khor zer yag 'di kun rdzob skabs la/ dang po rang gi lha bsgrub/ de nas lha 'di bsgrubs yong dus gnas lugs kyi steng la slebs yong dus lha 'di'i gnas lugs dang*/ rang gi gnas tshul gnyis po 'di dbye ba med par rtogs yong dus rang lha 'di'i ngo bo yin par rtogs/ de 'dra rtogs yong dus rang gi rgyud la yod pa'i rang byung 'od gsal gyi lhan skyes kyi ye shes de la lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i chos thams cad 'khor gyis bskor bsdad pa de ye gdod ma nas 'khor gyis bskor bsdad pa de rang gi mngon du 'gyur ba yin pa red/ de 'dra'i brda dang*/ thabs dang*/ man ngag la sogs pa rim pas yong thub yag gi gzhi 'dra po de dkyil 'khor zhes lab pa red 'dug /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ lha la mang po yod red/ dkyil 'khor lha zhes/ lha zer ba'i de skabs la'ang mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong la sogs pa ga re bsdus na yang bsdus kyi yod sa red/ rtsa ba gsum cha tshang 'di nang la yong gi yod red/ 5 dus gsum dus med du rtogs dgos pa/ phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa dang*/ dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad nga rang tsho las dang po pa la spyir btang gi don dam la phyogs med pa rtogs dgos pa red/ dus gsum de yang dus med par rtogs dgos pa red/ dus gsum gyi 'du shes dang*/

dus gsum du zhen pa'i blo yod na mi 'grig pa red/ phyogs kyang phyogs bzhi dang*/ phyogs bcu la sogs pa'i rnam grangs la brtsis byas na mi 'grig pa red de/ las dang po pa la nyams len sla thabs la dgongs nas phyogs bcur grangs bzhag /dus la dus gsum gyi rnam par bzhag nas phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa zer yag 'dra po/ dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa zer yag 'di rnam grangs thog nas 'di 'dra bzhag dgos yag rgyu mtshan 'di/ las dang po pa la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin pa red/ don dam pa la dus gsum 'di yang dus med par rtogs dgos pa 'di gal chen po yin pa red 'dug /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas// rgyal ba dus gsum gyi rgyal ba dang*/ de'i sras byang chub sems dpa' sras gtso bo 'di skabs la theg chen gyi byang sems bzhag dgos pa red/ spyir btang sku'i sras dang*/ gsung gi sras dang*/ thugs kyi sras zhes mang po yong gi yod red/ de'i nang nas kyang gtso bo thugs las skyes pa'i sras byang chub sems dpa'/ byang chub sems dpa' de yang de nas so skye byang sems dang*/ 'phags pa'i byang sems yongs rdzogs la go dgos yag red bzhag / smon 'jug gi dbye ba/ smon 'jug gi khyad par bshad yong dus/ spyir sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bkod yag 'bras bu la khas blangs pa dang*/ 'di'i ched du rgyu nyams su blang yag 'di smon 'jug gi dbye ba bshad yong dus so skye'i byang sems bshad kyi yod red/ yin na yang don dam pa'i byang chub sems dang*/ kun rdzob byang chub sems gnyis lhan cig tu rtogs yong ba 'di 'phags pa'i byang sems kyi bshad yong gi yod pa yin dus/ gnyis ka yang 'di nang la bsdus dgos kyi yod sa red/ sras dang bcas pa dang*/ 'di thams cad bla ma dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor yongs kyi lha/ phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi bdag la thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs zhes lab pa red/

bdag la brtser dgongs/ bdag la thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs so// bdag la thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ga re red zer na/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad ni de lta bu'i gnas lugs mngon du ma rtogs pa red/ phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs mngon du ma gyur pa red/ phyag rgya chen po'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'di sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la ye gdod ma nas nyi ma dang nyi ma'i 'od lta bu dang*/ me dang me'i tsha ba lta bu gnyis su med pas khyab yod red de/ yin na yang rang snang la yul du 'khrul/ rang rig la bdag tu 'khrul byas nas/ gang ltar gnas lugs kyi don las phar phyin ci log tu gyur nas/ lam yang dag pa'i steng la slebs ma thub pa red/ lam yang dag pa'i steng la slebs ma thub pa yin pa yin dus/ de 'dra'i gnas lugs yang dag par rtogs par byed pa la/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad ni gnas lugs mngon du gyur zin pa dang*/ gnas lugs kyi don la btsan sa zin zin pa red/ gnas lugs kyi don la btsan sa zin pa yin na yang dus dang rnam pa kun tu sems can gyi don las rang don dgongs sa med pa red/ sems can gyi don la dgongs pa yin dus/ da res bdag sogs sems can thams cad 'di lta bu'i phyag rgya chen po'i smon lam/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i phyag rgya chen po'i lam gyi rim pa 'di byung na stan thog 'di nyid la'am tshe 'di nyid la rtogs thub yag dang*/ de ltar ma byung na yang bar do'am skye ba bcu drug tshun chad nas nges par du rtogs thub yag gi thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs rogs mdzod ces zhu ba gsol 'debs zhus kyi yod pa red 'dug /bdag la thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs la/ thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs pa'i gzhi 'di dgongs bya 'di gang 'dra zhig la dgongs dgos red zer na/ bdag gi smon lam rnams bdag gi phyag rgya chen po'i smon lam rnams gsol ba ji ltar btab pa'am smon lam ji ltar btab pa de bzhin du 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur/

6 mthun 'gyur mdzad par smon pa/ mthun 'gyur zer dgos yag gi tshig 'dis rtsa ba gzhi gnas lugs mngon du rtogs yag rang la rag las kyi red ma gtogs bla mas mar phyag rgya chen po kha thug la spyir btang gi go bas rtogs/ phyag rgya chen po'i 'grel bshad dang*/ phyag rgya chen po bshad yag 'di gang 'dra yin min dang*/ phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa'i thabs la lam gang dang gang la bsten dgos pa/ gnyen po gang dang gang la bsten dgos pa/ lam gyi rim pa ji dang ji lta ba la bslab dgos pa 'di gsungs kyi red de/ yin na yang dngos su phyag rgya chen po'i steng la sgom rgyab nas 'di'i steng la nyams su len yag 'di rang rang so sos byed dgos red ma gtogs/ bla mas rogs pa byas nas rtogs yong yag med pa red/ rang gi rtogs dgos kyi yod pa red/ yin na'ang byin rlabs dang*/ thugs rje zer yag 'di rten 'brel bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas tshul yin pa/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas tshul yin pa yin dus mthun 'gyur thog nas yang rogs pa gnang thub yag 'di 'dra yod sa red/ ga re red zer na rogs pa gnang mkhan rang yang dang po phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs rtogs zin pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas nga rang tsho phyag rgya chen po rtogs 'dod yod nges kyi gang zag gis smon lam rgyab yong dus chos nyid kyi stobs kyis ra dang ma song na yang 'phrod byas nas phyag rgya chen po rtogs yag la rogs pa byed thub kyi yod sa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus mthun 'gyur byin rlabs mdzod/ ji bzhin du sgrub thub ya'i mthun 'gyur byin rlabs mdzod/ rtsa ba rang so so'i brtson 'grus byed pa'i thog nas nyams len dang*/ brtson 'grus phyin ci ma log pa lam yang dag par lam phyin ci log pa las bzlog nas lam yang dag pa la brten nas nyams su len pa'i nus pa la bsten dgos kyi yod na yang*/ de dang mnyam du rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mthun 'gyur gyi byin rlabs gnang rogs gnang zhes zhu ba red 'dug

/ kha spyir dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi// bsam sbyor rnam dag gangs ri las skyes pa'i// 'khor gsum rnyog med dge tshogs chu rgyun rnams// rgyal ba sku bzhi'i rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig / bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad bdag gzhan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa rnam dag dang*/ sbyor ba rnam dag gnyis las skyes pa'i lab pa red/ 1 bsam sbyor rnam dag 'di zer ba'i skabs su la spyir bsam pa zer yag 'di theg chen skabs nas snying rje gtso bor bzhag dgos pa red/ snying rje dang gcig /byang chub kyi sems dang gnyis/ sbyor ba rnam par dag pa 'di bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab la bzhag dgos pa red/ de yang mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ dbu ma rin chen phreng ba'i nang la/ bdag nyid dang ni 'jig rten 'dis// bla med byang chub thob 'dod na// de yi rtsa ba byang chub sems// ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan dang*// phyogs mthas gtugs pa'i snying rje dang*// gnyis la mi brten ye shes lags// zhes bshad yong dus bdag nyid dang ni 'jig rten 'dis zhes bshad yong dus bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis bla na med pa'i byang chub yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mthar thug pa thob par byed pa la/ yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thob par byed pa la/ de nas 'thob par 'dod kyi yod na/ 'di'i rtsa ba ga re red zer na/ 'di 'dra 'thob ya'i rtsa ba rgyu la bslab dgos pa red/ 'thob bya 'di lta bu 'di yang thob byed la 'brel dgos pa red ma gtogs/ thob byed dang ma 'brel bar 'thob bya phyin ci ma log pa 'thob rgyu med pa yin dus/ 'thob bya phyin ci ma log par de lta bu yang rang gang gis thob par byed pa'i 'thob bya yang phyin ci ma log pa zhig la bsten dgos kyi red/ 'di 'dra'i thob byed phyin ci ma log pa gang 'dra zhig yod red zer na/

'di'i rtsa ba 'di dang po byang chub kyi sems red lab pa red/ 2 byang chub kyi sems/ byang chub kyi sems zer ba'i skabs su 'di skabs byang chub kyi sems 'di gtso bo kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems la bshad kyi yod red/ smon 'jug gi dbye ba bshad kyi yod red/ rje btsun byams pa'i gzhung nang la smon 'jug gi dbye ba yod ma red/ don dam sems bskyed dang*/ kun rdzob sems bskyed ma gtogs bshad kyi yod ma red/ smon 'jug gi dbye ba gtso bo spyod 'jug mkhan po'i lugs red/ yin na yang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bshad yong dus kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems nang la smon 'jug gi dbye ba bshad yong ba yin dus 'di yi nang la 'thad yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus dang po byang chub kyi sems/ byang chub kyi sems zer yag 'di mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad bskal pa mang po'i mtha'/ bskal pa mang po'i rgyun dang*/ 'gro ba mang po'i mtha'/ rang gi bya dka' ba'i spyod pa gang 'dra zhig la bslab dgos kyi yod na yang de la dka' snang dang*/ 'tsher snang med pa/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad rang dang pha ma gcig pa'i bu nang bzhin gyi brtse ba chen pos kun nas bslangs pas rang don dang ma 'brel bas gzhan don gyi bsam pa mtha' yas pa'i dmigs pa rgya che ba zhig la byang chub kyi sems kyi mtshan nyid bzhag gi yod red/ 'di bshad yong dus byang chub sems dpa' mtshan nyid pa gcig la bzhag dgos kyi yod red/ byang chub sems dpa' mtshan nyid pa 'di la yang*/ byang chub sems btags pa ba gcig dang*/ byang chub sems mtshan nyid pa gnyis yong gi yod red/ dpe cha kha shas nang la kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems 'di byang chub kyi sems mtshan nyid pa la bzhag gi yod red/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'di byang sems btags pa bar bshad kyi yod red/ yin na yang rang lugs la don dam pa'i byang chub sems 'di byang chub kyi sems mtshan nyid pa bzhag gi yod red/

kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems 'di byang sems btags pa ba bzhag yod red/ 'di ga re red zer na/ sa dang po la gnas pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi rgyud la chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa 'di sa dang po'i byang sems yin dus sa dang po'i byang sems 'di'i rgyud la yod pa'i don dam byang chub kyi sems dang*/ sems de lta bu yang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems yod red/ kun rdzob byang sems la brten nas don dam byang chub kyi sems rtogs kyi yod pa yin dus/ mthar thug gi 'thob bya bla na med pa'i 'bras yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ngo ma gang gis thob mkhan byed kyi yod red zer na/ dngos rgyu 'di don dam pa'i byang chub sems kyis thob kyi yod red ma gtogs kun rdzob byang chub sems kyis thob kyi yod ma red/ 3 kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems/ kun rdzob byang chub sems zer yag 'di ga re red zer na/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems zer yag 'di byams pa dang*/ snying rje'i blo dmigs pa dang rnam pa 'di 'dra byed nas 'brel bsdad pa'i blo yin pa yin dus/ de lta bu 'thob bya bla na med pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi go 'phang dngos gnas thob par byed pa'i dngos rgyu byed kyi yod red pas zer na byed thub kyi yod ma red/ gang red zer na bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab/ bdag med par rtogs pa'i shes rab dang 'brel dgos kyi yod red ma gtogs/ byams dang snying rje la dmigs pa'i blo 'dra po 'di ga re red zer na/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi dang po'i ma rig pa dang 'gal zla yod ma red/ 'di dang 'gal zla yod pa'i chos shig dgos kyi yod red/ mthar thug gi 'bras yum yang dag par thob pa la 'di red 'dug ga /'di yin dus tshad ma rnam 'grel nang la/ byams sogs rmongs dang 'gal med phyir// shin tu nyes pa tshar gcod min//

nyes kun de yi rtsa ba can// de yang 'jig tshogs lta ba yin// bshad yong dus byams pa dang*/ snying rje la dmigs pa'i blo 'di ma rig pa dang 'gal zla chags thub kyi mi 'dug /gnyis snang gi thog la bsam blo btang yong dus 'gal zla chags thub kyi yod ma red/ 'di'i 'gal zla chags ma thub pa yin dus/ dngos gnas drang gnas kyi 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'di ga re red/ gzung 'dzin gnyis red/ gzung 'dzin yang gang las 'byung zer na/ rtsa ba rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi dang po'i ma rig pa las 'byung ba yin dus 'di'i rtsa ba bcad yag la gal che shos ga re red zer na/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab skye dgos red/ 'di 'dra bshad yong dus de skabs la 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis dbu ma rin chen phreng ba'i nang bshad bsdad yag gi byang chub kyi sems zer ba yang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems la bshad dgos yag rgyu mtshan 'di yin pa red/ byang chub kyi sems byas/ ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan dang*/ ri'i dbang po rgyal po lta bu brtan po yod pa gcig dang*/ phyogs mthas gtugs pa'i snying rje dang*/ snying rje zer yag 'di ga re red/ sdug bsngal dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bcas pa 'bral 'dod kyi blo de la snying rje bshad kyi yod red/

sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal dang*/ sdug bsngal gang las 'byung ba'i rgyu/ las dang nyon mongs pa/ las kyi kun 'byung dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung gnyis red/ 'di'i nang nas gtso che shos de nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung red/ nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung 'di rgyal po lta bu red/ las kyi kun 'byung 'di g.yog po lta bu yin pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung 'di spang bar bya ba gtso bor gsungs pa red/ snying rje zer yag 'di sdug bsngal dang*/ sdug bsngal 'di'i rgyu las nyon gnyis spang 'dod kyi blo yod pa 'di snying rje byas/ de nas/ phyogs mthas gtugs pa'i snying rje dang*// gnyis la mi brten ye shes lags// gnyis la mi brten ye shes lags zer na/ gnyis med rtogs pa'i shes rab/ gnyis su med par rtogs pa'i shes rab zer yag 'di chos thams cad bdag med par rtogs pa'i shes rab red/ chos thams cad bdag med par rtogs pa'i shes rab zer yag 'di gzhi chen po la sbyar na/ gang zag gi bdag med dang*/ chos kyi bdag med pa skad cha mang po yod red de/ yin na yang bsdoms nas bshad yong dus/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'di bdag 'dzin la brten nas 'byung ba red/ bdag 'dzin 'di dang dngos 'gal gang red zer na/ bdag 'dzin zer yag 'di ga re red zer na/ zhen yul la 'khrul pa'i log shes red/ zhen yul la 'khrul pa'i log shes 'di lta bu'i zhen yul la 'khrul pa'i log shes 'di'i dngos kyi gnyen po ga re zer na/ dngos kyi gnyen po bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab yin dgos kyi yod red/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab dngos kyi 'dzin stangs 'gal zla ga re red zer na/ bdag 'dzin red/ bdag 'dzin gyi dngos kyi 'gal zla 'di bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab yin pa yin dus bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab la ma bsten pa la bdag 'dzin spang thabs med pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mthar thug pa/

phar phyin skabs nas bshad bsdad pa'i 'bras yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mthar thug pa thob byed kyi rgyu yi rtsa ba 'di ga ba bzhag yod red zer na/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab la bzhag yod pa red/ gnyis su med par rtogs pa'i shes rab la bzhag yod red/ 'di'i rgyu ga re zer na snying rje red/ 'di yi rgyu ga re red zer na/ ya rim pa bzhin du 'gro dgos kyi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus da lta 'di'i skabs la bsam pa rnam dag zer yag 'di/ gtso bo byang chub kyi sems dang*/ snying rje gnyis la bzhag /byang chub kyi sems de yang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang*/ de la bzhag dgos pa red 'dug /dge ba rnam dag 'di bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab red/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab 'di yang phar phyin drug dang 'brel dgos pa red/ de'ang dang po pha rol du phyin pa zer yag gi tha snyad sbyar yag 'di yang gtso bo 'di 'khor gsum dmigs pa med pa'i shes rab gcig dgos kyi yod pa yin dus 'di'i skabs la yang 'khor gsum rnyog med zer yag 'di 'khor gsum dmigs pa med pa'i shes rab kyi rtsis zin pa zhig dgos kyi yod red/ 4 sbyin pa dang sbyin pa'i phar phyin sogs kyi khyad par/ 'di yin dus spyir btang gi sbyin pa dang*/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin gnyis la khyad par yod red/ tshul khrims dang*/ tshul khrims kyi phar phyin gnyis la khyad par yod red/ pha rol du phyin par byed pa la drug pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas rtsis zin dgos kyi yod red/ drug pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas rtsis zin yong dus sbyin pa sbyin bya len po gtong pos stong yong dus 'jig rten las 'das pa'i pha rol steng la 'gro dgos kyi yod red/ pha rol phyin pa'i steng la/ 'di gsum gyis rtsis zin pa zhig chags song na/ sbyin pa sbyin bya len po gtong pos stong ma thub na ga re chags pa red/

'jig rten pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zer nas zla ba grags pas tha snyad 'di 'dra sbyar yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus sbyor ba rnam dag zer yag 'di sbyor ba yang gtso bo bdag med par rtogs pa'i shes rab lab yong dus/ theg pa chen po'i lam gang 'dra zhig nyams su len kyang nyams su len bya'i lam gang 'dra zhig yin na yang 'di la 'khor gsum dmigs pa med pa'i shes rab kyis rtsis zin dgos kyi red/ 'khor gsum dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i thog nas sbyin pa btang ba yin na/ 'di'i 'khor gsum dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i thog nas dge ba'i rtsa ba sgrub pa yin na de lta bu'i 'jig rten pa'i dge rtsa chags kyi yod red ma gtogs/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge rtsa chags thub kyi yod ma red/ 'jig rten las 'das par byed pa la thabs phyin ci ma log pa gcig ma gtogs yod ma red/ 'di ga re red zer na/ bdag med par rtogs pa'i shes rab bam drug pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa red/ 'khor gsum dmigs pa med par rtogs pa'i shes rab cig dgos kyi red/ 'di lab yong dus sbyor ba rnam dag lab pa red/ bsdus yong dus bsam pa rnam dag 'di snying rje chen po dang*/ sbyor ba rnam dag 'di stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab/ 'di bzhag na'ang 'grig gi yod red/ 'di yang bsam sbyor rnam dag zer yag 'di rnam par dag yag 'di yang*/ sbyor ba rnam dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yang dper na/ mos spyod kyi sa la yin na tshogs sbyor gnyis kyi skabs la yin na ni/ dper na/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i lta ba yod ma red/ rjes shes kyis rtogs pa red/ mos pas spyod pa'i sa na mngon sum du rtogs pa yod ma red/ rjes dpag la brten nas rtogs dgos kyi yod red/ chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i lta ba 'di sa dang po'i 'phags pa byang sems kyi rtogs bya thun mong ma yin pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa yin dus/

chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab yin pa yin dus/ 'di'i skabs la rnam dag zer yag 'di yang gtso bo 'di mngon sum du rtogs pa la bzhag dgos kyi yod red 'dug /rnam par dag yag 'di'i tshe bsam pa rnam par dag yag dang*/ sbyor ba rnam par dag yag bsam sbyor gnyis po zung du 'jug dgos pa zhig red dgos kyi ma gtogs/ bsam pa snying rje chen po zur gcig la bzhag /sbyor ba bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab zur gcig la bzhag nas 'di gnyis khag khag nyams su len na rnam dag chags thub kyi yod ma red/ rnam dag phyin ci ma log par bsgrub yag la bsam pa rnam dag snying rje chen po dang*/ sbyor ba rnam dag stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab gnyis po zung du 'jug pa'i lta ba phyin ci ma log pa'i rtogs bya sa dang po nas yong gi yod pa yin dus chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i lta ba 'di chos rab rnam 'byed kyi shes rab la brten nas drangs thub kyi yod pa yin dus rnam dag 'di sa dang po la bzhag 5 bsam sbyor rnam dag gi dpe/ dpe 'di ga ba bzhag pa red zer na/ dpe 'di gangs ri la bkod pa red/ 'di 'dra'i bsam pa rnam dag dang*/ sbyor ba rnam dag gi dpe 'di gangs ri lta bu zhig red/ gangs ri las ga re babs pa red zer na/ gangs ri las chu rgyun babs pa red/ 'di yin pa'i skabs su gangs ri las chu rgyun babs nas chu rgyun 'di rgya mtsho nang la 'gro gi yod red/ 'di ma gtogs 'gro sa med pa red 'dug /'di 'dra yin dus bsam sbyor rnam dag gi gangs ri las ga re skye ba red zer na/ 'khor gsum rnyog pa med pa'i chu rgyun 'byung ba red lab pa red/ rgyu bsam sbyor rnam par dag tshar na 'di la brten nas 'khor gsum rnyog pa med pa'i dge tshogs ma yong rang yong chags bsdad kyi yod red/ 6 'khor gsum dmigs bcas dang dmigs med kyi khyad par/ de yang 'khor gsum rnyog pa med zer yag 'di ga re red/

dge ba'i rtsa ba gang 'dra zhig bsgrub pa yin na yang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sgrub mkhan rang*/ bsgrub rgyu'i dge ba/ de nas bsgrub bya'i yul mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'di gsum yang snang tsam dang*/ grags tsam dang*/ rig tsam dang*/ gsal tsam zhig red ma gtogs kun rdzob tu snang tsam red ma gtogs don dam pa la yul la bden par grub bsdad pa'i chos shig med pa 'di la med par rtogs pa/ med pa tsam ma red/ med pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rtogs pa la 'khor gsum du rnyog pa med pa'i lta ba zhes bzhag pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus 'khor gsum rnyog pa med/ 'khor gsum rnyog pa dang bcas zer yag 'di ga re red/ 'khor gsum yul dang yul can gyi rnam gzhag /yul dang yul can zer yag mi 'dug /gang 'dra'i sbyin pa zhig btang na yang sbyin pa btang mkhan dang*/ gtang rgyu'i sbyin pa dang*/ gtang ba'i yul gsum ga yang 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i thog nas/ zhen pa dang bcas pa'i thog nas/ mtshan bcas kyi thog nas btang ba yin na 'khor gsum rnyog pa dang bcas pa chags pa red/ 'khor gsum rnyog pa med zer yag 'di rnyog pa med pa 'di ga re la bzhag pa red zer na/ 'khor gsum dmigs pa med par rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa la bzhag dgos pa red/ 'di'i mkhyen pa'am 'di'i lta ba la/ 'khor gsum rnyog pa med pa'i dge ba'i tshogs theg pa chen po la drug pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas rtsis zin pa'i dge ba yin na/ 'khor gsum rnyog med kyi dge ba yin pa'i khyab kyi yod red/ 'di yin dus 'khor gsum rnyog pa med pa'i dge bas khyab pa'i rgyu mtshan yang rtsa ba drug pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtogs dgos kyi yod red/ mdo sdud pa'i nang la/ sbyin pa sbyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i shes rab ste// tshul khrims bzod pa bsam gtan sogs kyang de bzhin no// zhes bshad yong dus drug pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sbyin pa/

drug pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sngon du 'gro ba'i tshul khrims zhes bshad yong gi yod red/ 'di bshad pa'i skabs la drug pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas rtsis zin dus 'khor gsum rnyog med kyi lta ba nges par du slebs thub kyi yod red/ 'dis rtsis ma zin na/ shes rab dang bral ba'i thabs chags pa red/ 'dis thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob mi thub pa red 'dug ga /'o de 'dra yin dus/ 'khor gsum rnyog pa med pa'i dge tshogs chu rgyun rnams/ 'di 'dra'i gangs ri las bsam sbyor rnam par dag pa'i gangs ri las skyes pa'i dge ba'i tshogs 'di ga re 'khor gsum rnyog pa med pa zhig red/ 7 sku bzhi 'thob par smon pa/ 'di'i chu rgyun rnams ga ba 'gro gi red zer na/ rgyal ba sku bzhi'i rgya mtsho'i nang la 'jug gi red lab pa red 'dug /chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku zer nas bshad kyi yod red/ spyir btang sku gsum nang la sku bzhi bsdu gi yod red/ yin na yang 'di'i skabs la sku bzhi gsungs pa red/ gsal ba'i cha dang*/ stong pa'i cha gnyis dbye ba byas kyi yod red/ yang chos sku la de bshad pa'i skabs su la gsal cha la chos sku bshad/ stong cha la ngo bo nyid sku bshad yod red phar phyin skabs la/ 'o 'di 'dra byas nas rgyal ba sku bzhi'i rgya mtsho la 'jug 'gyur cig /de yin pa'i skabs su la 'jug mkhan su yin zer na/ nga rang red pa/ nga rang gis 'di lta bu'i dge ba gsar du bsgrub yong dus rgyal ba sku bzhi'i rgya mtsho'i nang la 'gro gi red ces lab pa red/ 'di bshad yong dus don dag 'di theg pa dman pa nyan thos pa 'dra po cha bzhag pa yin na/ sbyor ba rnam dag yod red/ ga re yod red zer na/ sbyor ba rnam par dag pa bden bzhi lugs 'byung dang*/ lugs ldog gi thog nas bstan yong dus bden bzhi blang dor phyin ci ma log par rtogs nas rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi dang po ma rig pa spangs nas nyon mongs pa mtha' dag zad par byed pa red/

nyon mongs pa mtha' dag zad par byed pa red de/ yin na yang bsam pa rgya che ba mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la dmigs pa'i brtse ba snying rje chen po dang*/ byang chub kyi sems med pa yin dus byang chub kyi sems dang*/ snying rje chen po dang 'brel ba'i stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab med pa yin pa yin dus mthar thug sku bzhi'i rgya mtsho la 'jug mi thub pa yin pa red/ 'jug mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ga re red/ sbyor ba bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab de yang rtsa ba sngon du ga re song ba red zer na/ bsam pa rnam par dag pa brtse ba snying rje chen po dang*/ don dam byang chub kyi sems zung du 'brel ba'i lta ba zhig yin pa yin dus 'di yi dge ba'i tshogs mtha' dag 'khor gsum rnyog pa med pas rtsis zin yong dus rgyal ba sku bzhi'i rgya mtsho la 'gro gi red/ theg pa che chung gi khyad par gcig kyang 'gro gi yod sa red/ rgyal ba sku bzhi'i rgya mtshor 'jug 'gyur cig / ga thun mong lam gyi rten phun tshogs la smon pa/ ji srid de ma thob pa de srid du// skye dang skye ba'i tshe rabs kun tu yang*// sdig dang sdug bsngal sgra yang mi grag cing*// bde dge rgya mtsho'i dpal la spyod par shog / dus ji srid de lta bu'i rgyal ba sku bzhi'i go 'phang zer na yang 'grig gi 'dug /de lta bu'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang*/ sbyor ba rnam par dag pa ma thob kyi bar la zer na yang 'grig gi 'dug /rgyu 'bras gang la sbyar na'ang 'grig gi yod sa red/ 'bras bu rgyal ba sku bzhi la sbyar na'ang 'grig gi 'dug /rgyu bsam sbyor rnam dag la sbyar na'ang 'grig gi 'dug /gang yang rung ba de lta bu ma thob pa de srid du rang de lta bu la mngon du 'gyur ma thub pa'am de lta bu btsan sa zin ma thub pa/ 'di nyams su myong ma thub pa de srid du rang skye ba 'di dang*/

skye ba gzhan tshe rabs gzhan du gnas gang dang gang du skye ba yin na yang*/ tshe rabs kun tu yang gang dang gang du skye ba yin na yang*/ yul de dang de dag la sdig dang sdug bsngal sgra yang mi grag cing rgyu sdig pa ma byed na 'bras bu sdug bsngal sgra yang grags kyi ma red/ 'di 'dra yin dus/ sdig sdug sgra yang mi grags shing*/ bde dge rgya mtsho'i dpal la spyod par shog /sdig pa yang ming tsam du ma grags pa/ sdug bsngal yang ming tsam du ma grags pa lab pa red 'dug /sdig dang sdug bsngal sgra yang mi grags shing*// bde dge rgya mtsho'i dpal la spyod par shog /rgyu dge ba bsags pa la brten nas 'bras bu bde ba yong gi yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus rgyu dge ba rnam par dag pa bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa thob pa'i mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa de lta bu yod pa'i dpal la spyod par shog /'di smon lam red bzhag / nga thun min lam gyi rten phun tshogs la smon pa/ dal 'byor mchog thob dad brtson shes rab ldan// bshes gnyen bzang bsten gdams pa'i bcud thob nas// tshul bzhin bsgrub la bar chad ma mchis par// tshe rabs kun tu dam chos spyod par shog / ces thun mong gi nyams len la dang po dal brgyad 'byor bcu red/ dal ba brgyad dang*/ 'byor pa bcu tshang ba'i mi lus rin po che thob pa dang*/ dal 'byor mchog thob de dal 'byor mchog tu 'gyur ba thob pa dang*/ dal 'byor mchog thob pa'i steng la yang phun sum tshogs pa'i cha rkyen ga re dgos red zer na/ dad pa dang*/ brtson 'grus/ shes rab gsum dgos gyi yod red/

1 dad pa gal chen po yin pa/ dad pa zer yag 'di spyir btang gal chen po yin pa red/ dad pa zer yag de yang*/ rgyud bla ma nang la/ rang byung rnams kyi don dam de// dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin// zhes bshad yong dus chos nyid kyi gnas lugs mthar thug pa dad pa la brten nas rtogs dgos pa gsungs kyi yod red/ dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin// zhes bshad kyi yod red/ de tsam du ma zad pa'i dad pa la spyir btang gi phar phyin skabs la dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang*/ dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang gnyis bshad kyi yod red/ de bshad pa'i skabs su dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes 'brang zer yag 'di nga rang tsho spyir btang 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis chos dang chos ma yin pa so sor phye thub kyi yod ma red de/ yin na yang lo rgyus dang*/ grub mtha'i 'dzin stangs byed stangs shig gi thog nas khas len byed yong dus rtsa chen po red zer nas dad pa byed yag 'di dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes 'brang zer gyi red/ 'di lta bu thar pa rnam dag sgrub yag la phan thogs med pa yin pa red/ thar pa rnam dag bsgrub yag la ga re dgos pa red zer na/ dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang dgos pa red/ 'di yin dus spyir btang dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes 'brang byed pa yin na yang phan thogs med pa ma red/ phan thogs yod red/ dge ba'i rtsa ba'i bag chags phra mo zhig bzhag thub kyi yod red/ yin na yang chos rab rnam 'byed kyi shes rab mthar thug pa skye yag la dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang dgos kyi yod red/ chos dang chos ma yin pa so sor 'byed shes pa'i rtog dpyod 'di 'dra'i blo gros dgos kyi yod red/ 'di 'dra'i mthu dang ldan pa gcig gis brtag dpyad btang nas chos ma yin pa thams cad dor shes pa byed/ chos yin pa thams cad yar blang shes pa/ 'di 'dra'i blang dor gyi gnas la yang gzhan la gtan la phab pa rang gi dngos gnas drang gnas blo gros kyi mthu'am blo gros kyi shes rab 'dis dpyad yong dus de la yang nges shes 'brang thub pa zhig yin dgos kyi yod red/

nges shes de lta bu 'brang yag la tshad ma sngon du 'gro dgos kyi yod red/ tshad ma 'di yang gzhal bya mngon gyur la mngon sum tshad mas ma gnod pa dang*/ gzhal bya lkog gyur la rjes dpag tshad mas ma gnod pa/ shin tu lkog gyur la yid ches tshad mas ma gnod pa dpyad gsum dag pa'i lung la brten dgos pa red/ dpyad gsum dag pa'i lung la brten nas dpyad gsum dag pa'i thog nas rang la phyin ci ma log pa'i 'dod pa'i dad pa skyes na 'di la brten nas nges shes 'brang gi red/ nges shes 'brang dus de lta bu'i nges shes 'brang zin pa'i rtogs bya'i lta ba gang yin pa de la 'pho 'gyur 'gro yag med pa red 'dug /'di 'dra yin dus dad zer yag 'di dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes 'brangs las lhag pa'i dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang gtso bo bshad pa red/ dad pa zer yag de tsam du ma zad pa'i spyir dad pa la cha bzhag na yang*/ dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la// dkar po'i chos rnams mi skye ste// sa bon me yis tshig pa la// myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no// zhes gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi dad pa med na 'di'i rgyud la dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad skye thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ sa bon me yis tshig pa la myu gu sngon po skye mi srid pa ltar du dad pa med pa'i gang zag la 'jig rten dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge rtsa bsgrub thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ dge rtsa skye thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ 'di yin dus dang po dad pa gal chen po red/ 2 brtson 'grus gal chen po yin pa/ de nas brtson 'grus gal chen po red/ gnyis pa de la btson 'grus zer yag 'di/ brtson gang dge la spro ba 'o// gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi gang dag dge ba'i gnas la spro ba dang ldan pa zhig la spro bas 'jug pa gcig la brtson pa zer gyi yod red/ de'ang brtson zer yag 'di yang rtogs bya 'di lta bu yi lta ba la spro bas 'jug 'dod kyi kun slong yod dgos pa red 'dug

/de'ang lan dang rnam smin la re ba med pa zhig gi thog nas mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don gtso bo dmigs pa zhig dgos kyi yod red ma gtogs yang rang thar pa don gnyer gyi bsam blo btang ba yin na yang nyan thos kyi brtson 'grus chags 'gro gi yod red/ de yin dus theg chen la mi 'grig pa red/ de yin dus mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du dmigs rnam gtso bo mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la dmigs rnam byed dgos pa red/ 'di'i ched du thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang bsgrub par byed pa la brtson 'grus nges par du dgos pa red/ brtson 'grus med du mi rung ba yin dus brtson 'grus nges par du bsten dgos par/ 'jug pa'i nang la/ yon tan ma lus brtson 'grus rjes 'gro zhing*// bsod nams blo gros tshogs ni gnyis kyi rgyu// zhes tshogs gnyis kyi rgyu yi rtsa ba brtson 'grus la bzhag yod pa red/ 'di yin dus brtson 'grus/ 3 shes rab gal chen po yin pa/ de nas shes rab zer yag 'di gal chen po yin pa red/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ mthong dang ma mthong yon tan ni// kun gyi rtsa ba shes rab yin// de ltar mngon par bsgrub pa'i phyir// shes rab yongs su gzung bar bya// zhes bshad yong dus mthong dang ma mthong yon tan zer yag 'di mthong ba tshe 'di'i yon tan dang*/ ma mthong tshe phyi ma'i yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba ga re la rag las pa red zer na/ shes rab la rag las pa red gsungs pa red/ shes rab med na 'jig rten dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gnas lugs mthar thug pa thams cad rtogs thub yag yod ma red/ 'di 'dra yin dus shes rab zer ba gal chen po red/ shes rab la yang spyir btang 'jig rten pa'i shes rab dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab gnyis yod pa'i nang nas gnyis ka gal chen po yin pa red/ dang po 'jig rten pa'i shes rab gal chen po red/

'jig rten pa'i shes rab la yang 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i shes rab dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i phyin ci log pa'i shes rab gnyis yod pa red/ 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i shes rab la bsten dgos pa red/ 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i shes rab la brten nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yang dag pa'i shes rab rtogs thub kyi yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus shes rab zer yag 'di shes rab dngos kyi bya ba zer yag 'di ga re zer na/ bdag 'dzin gyi dngos kyi gnyen po byed thub kyi yod red/ bdag 'dzin de'ang gang zag gi bdag dang chos kyi bdag gnyis ka gcod par byed pa'i shes rab cig dgos kyi red/ de yin dus shes rab mthu dang ldan pa dal ba brgyad dang 'byor pa bcu tshang ba'i thog la dad brtson shes rab gsum gyis phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ de nas dad pa yang yod/ brtson 'grus kyang yod/ shes rab kyang yod/ de nas bsdad bsdad na 'grigs kyi yod ma red/ 4 dge ba'i bshes gnyen nges par du bsten dgos pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gcig nges par du bsten dgos kyi yod red 'dug go/ 'di 'dra yin dus bshes gnyen bzang bsten lab pa red 'dug /bshes gnyen bzang po bsten pa/ bshes gnyen bzang po bsten zer yag 'di yang bzang po zer yag 'di'ang phyin ci log pa'i bshes gnyen bsten pa yin na mi 'grig pa red/ 'di yin pa'i skabs su bshes gnyen bzang po bsten pa zer yag 'di/ rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni// theg chen don la mkhas pa dang*// byang chub sems pa'i brtul zhugs mchog / srog gi phyir yang mi btang ngo*// zhes mtshan nyid de lta bu tshang ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten dgos yod red/ de 'dra yin dus bshes gnyen bzang po bsten pa la rgyu mtshan ga re yod red zer na/ bshes gnyen bzang po nges par du bsten dgos kyi yod red/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*/ dge slong thams cad la dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten dgos par gsungs pa red/

dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen par bya/ bkur bar bya/ gsungs pa red/ bsnyen bkur bzang pos bsten dgos pa red 'dug /bshes gnyen bzang po bsten/ bshes gnyen bzang po bsten zer yag 'di yang bshes gnyen dang po rang gis so sor phye shes dgos kyi yod red/ phyin ci log pa'i bshes gnyen dang*/ phyin ci ma log pa'i bshes gnyen gnyis po so sor phye shes nas/ phyin ci log pa'i bshes gnyen zer mkhan 'di bdud kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i bshes gnyen la phyin ci log pa'i bshes gnyen red/ 'di 'dras lam dang lam ma yin pa gnyis kyi dbye ba ni phye shes kyi ma red/ 'di phye ma shes yong dus lam log pa la lam tshad mar gzung bzhag na dpe bsag gi yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus lam phyin ci log pa la lam phyin ci log pa ston shes mkhan/ lam rnam par dag pa la lam rnam par dag pa ston shes mkhan/ de gnyis khag khag phye shes mkhan zhig dgos kyi yod red/ 'di 'dra phye shes pa la dang po bshes gnyen kho rang la chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab cig dgos kyi yod red/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab mthar thug pa thams cad mkhyen pa la ma gtogs yod ma red de/ yin na yang chos rab rnam 'byed kyi shes rab nges par du dgos kyi yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus bshes gnyen bzang po bsten/ zhes rang yang chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i lta ba la nges shes dang*/ tshad ma phyin ci ma log pa skyes yod mkhan/ gzhan la yang de lta bu la skye 'dod kyi blo yod mkhan zhig dgos pa red 'dug ga /bshes gnyen bzang po bsten pa/ bshes gnyen bzang po la bsten tsam byed na yang 'grig gi yod ma red/ 'di'i mdun nas gdams pa'i bcud thob dgos pa red/ 5 gdams ngag snying po thob dgos pa/ gdams pa'i bcud zer yag 'di/ spyir btang gdams pa'i bcud bshad yong dus gdams ngag mang po yod pa'i nang nas snying po 'dra po zhig thob dgos kyi red lab yong dus phyag rgya chen po la gtso bo go bsdad pa red 'dug

/'di yin dus spyir bcom ldan 'das kyis/ nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen po la chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs yod red/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong thams cad kyang rtsa ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob yag dang*/ 'khor ba las thar pa'i thabs kho na ma gtogs don med pa'i gtam dang*/ don med pa'i tshig yod ma red de/ yin na yang tshe gcig lus gcig la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas yag rje btsun mi la ras pa lta bu dang*/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pa lta bu'i rnam thar la rjes su 'brang mkhan yin na/ phyag rgya chen po'i lam gyi man ngag la brten nas skye ba 'di nyid kho na la dngos gnas drang gnas kyi stan thog gcig la phyag rgya chen po'i lam gyi nyams len 'di stan thog gcig la bcud skye thub yag gi spro ba dang 'di 'dra'i 'dun pa yod na/ gdams pa'i bcud la zhe drag gal chen po red gsungs pa red 'dug /bcud zer na snying po/ snying po lta bu 'di phyag rgya chen po yin pa red/ yin na yang phyag rgya chen po zer ba'i skabs su lta bas sgro 'dogs bcad ma dgos pa/ 'di 'dra byas nas kha thug la gser dngul sprod yong ba lta bu las dang po pa'i gang zag ma yin pa las dbang po cig car ba zer dgos red pa/ cig car ba'i blo ngor 'dra po dang*/ dbang po shin tu rnon po 'di tsho yin na ni/ da lta mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gang zag yin na ni nges par du dgos kyi yod sa ma red ma gtogs gzhan 'dra po yin na ni/ dang po lta ba'i sgro 'dogs bcad dgos kyi yod red/ rim pa bzhin du bslab dgos kyi yod red/ de yang brtag pa gnyis pa'i nang la/ dang po bye brag smra ba bstan/ de nas mdo sde pa bstan dgos pa dang*/ 'di'i rjes sems tsam pa bstan dgos pa red/ 'di yi rjes su dbu ma pa bstan/ de nas de'i rjes la sngags bstan dgos pa red/ sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas//

de rjes kyai yi rdo rje bstan// zhes bshad yong dus 'di'i rjes la rgyas pa zhig bstan gyi yod red/ 'di 'dra bshad yong dus kho lam gyi go rim 'di grub mtha' gang 'dra yod pa 'di nang bzhin byed nas 'gro dgos pa red 'dug ma gtogs/ yang kha thug la lta ba chos dbyings rtogs pa'i lta ba sngon du 'gro ma dgos pa 'di 'dra red mi 'dug /bdag dang bdag med kyi rnam gzhag 'di tsho yag po shes nas de'i steng la brtan pa thob/ de nas gnas lugs mngon du 'gyur/ de nas phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag la slebs dgos pa red 'dug ga / 6 lta thog nas sgom pa btsal ba/ yin na yang spyir bka' brgyud pa la lta thog nas sgom pa btsal ba dang*/ sgom thog nas lta ba btsal ba'i lugs gnyis yod red/ de yin dus shes rab yang dag pa phyin ci ma log pa'i skyes stobs sbyang stobs dngos gnas drang gnas sngon du 'gro bsdad mkhan gang zag dbang po yang rab yin na ni/ sgom gyi thog nas lta ba btsal thub pa red 'dug /sgom gyi thog nas lta ba btsal thub pa red/ mi bskyod rdo rjes/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i nang la yod red/ dngos gnas drang gnas tshe 'di la slob sbyong ma byed na yang rtsa rlung thig le la gnad bcings nas skye ba snga ma rnams su bag chags kyi mthu shugs chen po yong mkhan gyi rigs 'di bla ma la mos gus dang*/ dad pa dang*/ dag snang shugs chen po yod pa/ mar rigs drug gi sems can la yang snying rje dang*/ byang chub kyi sems shugs chen po yod pa/ bar du nga rang 'khor ba la nges 'byung gi blo shugs chen po yod pa byas/ de nas rtsa rlung thig le la gnad bcings nas de 'dra byed bsdad mkhan zhig yin na ni/ dngos gnas drang gnas grub mtha'i kha 'dzin gyi 'di 'dra'i slob sbyong shugs chen po ma byed na yang skye ba 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag tshe gcig la thob bsdad mkhan 'di 'dra yod red zer nas gsungs yod red/

'di 'dra yin dus sgom thog nas lta ba btsal bsdad pa 'dra po mthong bsdad kyi yod red/ yin na yang dbang po rim gyis pa 'di tsho phal che ba'i lugs su byed pa yin na/ lta thog nas sgom btsal dgos rgyu yin dus lta ba sngon du ma song bar sgom pa yong gi yod ma red/ 'di 'dra yin dus sgom rnam dag rgyud la skye ba la dang po lta ba rnam dag rgyud la skye dgos kyi yod red/ 'di yin dus sngon la bye brag smra ba nas bzung nas ya gi dbu ma'i bar du bshad bsdad yag gi lta sgom spyod gsum cha tshang sngon du song*/ 'di'i rjes la mthar thug gi grub don 'dra po phyag rgya chen po yi nang la bshad bsdad ya'i man ngag gi nyams su len yong dus gdams pa'i bcud lab pa red 'dug / 7 gdams ngag snying po rtogs dgos pa/ gdams pa'i bcud thob nas/ gdams pa'i bcud thob pa tsam gyis phan gyi ma red/ 'di bsgrub dgos pa red/ 'di ma bsgrub na phan gyi ma red/ go lo thos lo tsam la bzhag bzhag pa yin na/ 'dis phan gyi yod ma red/ phyag rgya chen po zer nas kha nas bshad bsdad na phan gyi yod ma red/ stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba zer nas kha nas bshad bsdad na phan gyi yod ma red/ kho dngos gnas drang gnas kyi dngos kyi gnyen po byed dgos kyi yod red/ 'dzin stangs dngos 'gal zhig dgos kyi yod red/ da lta nga rang tsho phyin ci log pa'i 'dzin pa dang dngos su 'gal ba'i lta ba zhig dgos kyi yod pa yin dus dngos su nyams su myong nas dgos kyi yod red ma gtogs grub mtha'i nang gi khas len gyi 'dzin mtshams dang*/ khas len gyi tshad dang*/ de tsam khas len pa tsam gyis phan gyi yod sa ma red/ spyir btang rje btsun mi las gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis/

lta ba stong pa'i ye shes de// kha lta rkyang par 'chor nyen gda'// don la nges shes ma skyes na// tshig gis bdag 'dzin grol ba med// gsungs pa red/ lta ba stong pa'i ye shes zer na gang ltar phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs gnyug ma lhan cig gnas pa'i ye shes zer yag 'di/ stong pa'i ye shes dngos su nyams su ma len na kha'i lta ba rkyang pa la shor ba'i nyen kha yod red/ de yin dus 'di 'dra ma yong ba'i thabs shes la ga re dgos red zer na/ don la nges shes skyes dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ don la nges shes skyes zer yag 'di don la rang gi nges shes skyes dgos kyi red pa/ rang gi don phyin ci ma log pa'i tshad mas drangs pa'i nges shes skyes dgos pa red 'dug /de ma gtogs gzhan gyis de lta bu red zer nas bstan tsam gyis mi 'grig pa red 'dug / 'di yin dus rang gis nges shes skyes dgos pa red/ de ma gtogs tshig tsam gyis bdag 'dzin grol thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ 'di yin dus tshul bzhin grub zer yag 'di gal chen po yin pa red/ mngon pa mdzod nang la/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas// sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor// zhes bshad yong dus dang po gzhi tshul khrims la gnas pa byed/ de nas tshul khrims la gnas pa'i thog nas thos bsam yang dag par phyin ci ma log pa byed/ thos byung gi shes rab bsam byung gi shes rab sgom byung gi shes rab la brten nas/ de nas chos sgrub pa la sbyar dgos pa red gsungs pa red/ sgrub zer yag 'di lta ba rnam par dag pa gang sngon du song ba'i grub don 'di rang gi sems nyid la tshur sbyar ba yin pa red/ chos dang gang zag gnyis gcig tu sbyar ba yin pa red/ chos dang gang zag so sor ma song ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi nang la spang blang gi gnad ka dang*/ nyams su blang bya dang*/ spang bya ga re bshad yod pa thams cad pha gi dpe cha nang la lhag ma song ba/

'di rang rgyud la tshur gdams ngag la 'char shes pa la sgrub pa lab pa red/ 8 bar chad med par dam chos spyod par smon pa/ 'di yin dus sgrub la bar chad ma mchis pa/ yang dus snyigs ma lnga'i skabs su bar chad mang po yong gi yod red/ phyi'i bar chad yong gi yod red/ nang gi bar chad yod red/ chos sgrub pa la bar chad rlung ltar 'tshub pa yong gi red/ de 'dra yin dus bar chad ma yong ba'i don dag la/ lha dang bla ma la gsol ba btab yag dang*/ rang gi yang chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i lta ba rgyud la skyes song na bar chad kyis kyang tshugs thub kyi yod ma red/ 'di yin dus bar chad phar sel yag la yag shos 'di lha la gsol ba btab pa las kyang rang gis chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i lta ba rgyud la skye yag yag shos red zer gyi red/ de yin dus tshul bzhin sgrub la bar chad yong gi yod red/ bar chad ma yong ba'i don dag la bsam sbyor rnam dag la bsten dgos kyi red/ bar chad ma mchis pa/ tshe rabs kun tu dam chos spyod par shog /de yang skye ba 'di tsam du ma zad pa'i skye ba 'di nas skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du mthar thug gi 'bras bu bla na med pa yang dag pa rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar la tshe rabs kun tu dam pa'i chos kho na la spyod par shog /'di'i skabs la dam chos 'di phyag rgya chen po rang la sbyar dgos kyi yod pa red 'dug /dam chos phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len kho na la spyod par shog gsungs pa red 'dug /shes rab gsum gyi snang ba 'di/ ca lam rtogs byed shes rab la smon pa/ lung rigs thos pas mi shes sgrib las grol// man ngag bsam pas the tshom mun nag bcom// sgom byung 'od kyis gnas lugs ji bzhin gsal// shes rab gsum gyi snang ba rgyas par shog / dang po thos byung gi shes rab/ gnyis pa bsam byung gi shes rab/ gsum pa sgom byung gi shes rab/

shes rab gsum bshad kyi yod red/ de'ang dang po/ lung rigs thos pas mi shes sgrib las grol// dang po thos pa gal chen po yin pa red/ 1 thos pa'i shes rab/ thos pa gti mug mun sel sgron me yin// rkun po la sogs mi 'khyer nor gyi mchog / kun tu rmongs pa'i dgra 'joms mtshon cha bzhin// thabs tshul man ngag ston pa grogs kyi mchog / ces bshad yong dus dngos gnas drang gnas kyi gti mug gi mun pa sel ba la sgron me nang bzhin yin pa dang*/ rkun po dang*/ jag pa dang*/ chom rkun la sogs pas khyer rgyu med pa'i nor gyi mchog lta bu yin pa dang*/ ma rig pa'i rmongs pa'i dgra bcom pa la mtshon cha lta bu yin pa de'ang thos pa yin pa red/ de nas grogs la thabs shes 'dra mi 'dra mang po bstan mkhan gyi grogs po yag shos 'di yang thos pa zer yag 'di red gsungs pa red/ 'di gsungs yong dus thos pa zer mkhan 'di yang gtso bo lung rigs thos pas lab pa'i skabs su lung dang*/ rigs pa gnyis la bsten dgos pa red/ 'di zer ba'i skabs su lung dang rigs pa gnyis la gang 'dra byed nas bsten dgos pa red zer na/ spyir nga rang tsho nang pa sangs rgyas pa la skyabs kyi mthar thug su red zer na/ ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhag gi yod red/ ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis lam gyi rim pa'i nang log la spang blang gi gnad ka mang po gsungs yod red/ spang blang gi gnad ka mang po gsungs pa'i skabs ma gi nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims kyi dbang du byed de/ zhes bshad 'go btsugs pa nas bzung ste/ ya gi gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i bar du mdo sngags kyi lta ba zer na yang mi 'dug /mdo sngags kyi nyams su len stangs la bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' rgya che ba dang*/ lung grangs mang ba mang po yod red/ 'di tsho thog la slob sbyong yag po byed dgos red 'dug /dang po de la lung zer yag 'di slob sbyong byed yag 'di red/

'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo'i skabs su drang nges gnyis kyi thog nas bshad kyi yod red/ sngags kyi skabs su mtha' drug dang*/ tshul bzhi'i thog nas 'grel gyi yod red/ 'di 'dra byed nas 'grel yong dus drang nges kyi thog nas 'grel yong dus bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung thams cad la drang don yin pa'i rgyu mtshan/ nges don yin pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di/ dang po drang nges kyi dbye ba lung la nges shes yag po zhig 'brang dgos kyi yod red/ 'di la brten nas sngags kyi skabs la yang mtha' drug tshul bzhi gnad ka 'di tsho la yag po nges shes 'brang dgos kyi yod red/ 'di yin dus dang po rtsa ba gal chen po lung yin pa red/ 'o na lung tsam la skyabs bcol na 'grig gi red pas zer na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi lung tsam la skyabs bcol nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di 'dra gsungs pa red zer nas lung tsam la skyabs bcol nas bzhag na 'grig gi yod ma red/ rang yang 'di yi steng la rigs pas 'brangs pa'i nges shes shig dgos kyi yod red/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*/ dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis// bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du// legs par brtag la nga yi bka'// blang bar bya yi gus phyir min// ces gsungs yong dus legs par brtag la bshad yong ba'i skabs su brtag dpyad nan tan snga phyi bar gsum la 'di 'dra byed nas brtag dpyad btang dgos pa red gsungs 'dug a/ 'o 'di 'dra yin dus lung dang rigs pa gnyis la bsten dgos pa red/ lung kho na la skyabs bcol na mi 'grig pa/ rigs pa kho na la bcol na'ang 'grig gi yod ma red/ dper na phyi rol pa la rtsod pa rgyab pa'i skabs su lung 'khyer sa yod ma red/ gtso bo rang gi rigs pas sgrub dgos kyi 'dug a/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs bzhag pa'i lung 'di gzhir bzhag /'di'i steng la rang gis shing rta chen po thogs med dang*/

klu sgrub chen po rnam pa gnyis kyi shing rta gnyis kyi rigs pa gtso bo bzhag nas 'di'i steng la rang gis kyang nges shes 'brangs pa'i rigs pa 'di'i thog nas rtsod na pha rol po la rgol ba las rgyal bar byed dgos kyi yod red/ 'di yin dus rigs pa gal che ba red/ rigs pa de lta bu la yang brten sa gzhi gcig dgos kyi red ma gtogs brten sa gzhi med na khungs med pa chags kyi red/ khungs ga ba bcol dgos red zer na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi lung tshad ma la brten dgos pa red 'dug ga /'o 'di 'dra yin dus lung dang rigs pa gnyis la brten nas thos pa yang dag par rang gi rgyud la skyes pa red/ thos pa la brten nas ga re byed zer na/ mi shes pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba red/ chos dang chos min pa'i dbye ba phye mi shes pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba red gsungs pa red/ mi shes pa'i sgrib las grol/ 'di zer ba'i skabs su mi shes sgrib las grol zer yag 'di sgrib zer yag 'di gtso bo nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa gtso bo bshad kyi yod sa red bsam bsam zhig 'dug /spyir btang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis kyi nang nas nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa gtso bo bshad kyi yod sa red/ mi shes zer yag 'di yang gtso bo rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi dang po ma rig pa la mi shes zhes byed nas ma rig pa bshad yong dus 'di skabs kyi mi shes zer yag gi ma rig pa 'di rten 'brel bcu gnyis can gyi rtsa bar 'gyur pa'i ma rig pa byas/ 'di yin dus 'di ga re'i nang la bsdu dgos kyi red zer na/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa nang la bsdu dgos kyi yod red/ 'di yin dus mi shes sgrib las zer ba'i skabs su nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa las grol gyi red/ 'di da lta grol gyi red lab pa ma red/ 'di grol gyi ma red pa/ yin na yang grol zer yag ma 'ongs pa la grol byed kyi rgyu chags kyi red/

'grel yong dus go ba 'di 'dra byed nas 'gro gi yod sa red/ mi shes sgrib las grol/ 2 bsam pa'i shes rab/ man ngag bsam pas the tshom mun nag bcom// 'di'i steng du bsam dgos pa red/ thos pa tsam la bzhag na 'grig gi yod ma red/ thos don 'di la bsam dgos pa red/ bla mas man ngag mang po bstan gyi yod red/ dper na rang gi thos don lung rigs la brten nas slob sbyong byed yong dus go ba lon yag yod red/ go ba ma lon pa'ang yong gi red/ da ga nang bzhin gyi dngos gnas drang gnas gnad ka zab mo 'di tsho go thub kyi ma red/ 'di 'dra bla ma la bka' 'dri zhu nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bka' 'dri zhu yong dus dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis man ngag bstan gyi red/ thabs tshul man ngag 'di tsho thams cad ma nor ba 'di tsho gsal zhing gsal po byed nas bstan gyi yod red/ man ngag la yang nas yang du bsam yong dus bsam byung gi shes rab skyes pa red/ bsam byung gi shes rab skyes yong dus the tshom dang mun nag bcom pa red lab pa red/ gang 'dra yin nam min nam bsam pa'i the tshom mang po yod red/ tshad ma'i skabs la don 'gyur gyi the tshom dang don mi 'gyur gyi the tshom mang po bshad kyi yod red/ dang po don mi 'gyur ba'i the tshom shugs che yag 'dra po zhig yong gi yod red/ gang tsam zhig la don 'gyur gyi the tshom shugs chen po skyes kyi yod red/ de gnyis ka med pa bsgrub dgos kyi yod red/ gang 'dra yin nam bsam bsam 'dra po byung na don 'gyur gyi the tshom red/ min nam bsam bsam 'dra po 'di don mi 'gyur ba'i the tshom red/ de gnyis ka med pa bsgrub dgos kyi yod pa red 'dug /'di 'dra yin dus man ngag gis bsam yong dus bsam pas the tshom 'di yis mun nag bcom gyi red/ thos bsam gnyis 'di bzhag pa red/ 3 sgom pa'i shes rab/ 'di thar pa'i brgyud rgyu yin pa red/

thams cad mkhyen pa'i brgyud rgyu red ma gtogs thams cad mkhyen pa'i dngos rgyu ma red/ thos bsam gnyis po 'di thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i brgyud rgyu yin pa red/ dngos rgyu 'di ga re red zer na/ thams cad mkhyen pa dngos su thob par byed pa la rang gis dngos kyi rgyu ga re byed kyi red zer na/ rang gi skad cig snga ma'i dngos rgyu 'di/ sgom byung 'od kyis gnas lugs ji bzhin gsal// thos bsam gnyis las thos pa la brten nas mi shes pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba dang*/ man ngag bsam pa la brten nas the tshom gyi mun nag bcom pa de gnyis gzhi ga ba sbyar dgos red zer na/ sgom byung red/ sgom byung gi shes rab/ sgom rgyab dgos red/ sgom rgyab zer yag de yang spyir btang gi thos bsam gyis rnyed pa'i don dag de rang gi rgyud la goms par byed pa la sgom zhes lab pa red/ goms pa'am goms shing 'dris par byed pa de la sgom zhes lab pa red/ bsgom pa ma yin goms pa yin// goms pa klong du 'gyur ba yin// zhes bshad pa'i skabs su rtsa ba de'i steng la nges shes phyin ci ma log pa/ dngos gnas drang gnas kha thug la don 'brang thub yag de bsgom la brten nas yong gi yod pa red 'dug / 4 bde gshegs snying po'i go ba len tshul/ sgom byung 'od kyis gnas lugs ji bzhin gsal// bsgoms nas byung ba'i shes rab bam sgom byung gi 'od kyis rang la yod pa'i gnas lugs ji bzhin gsal lab pa red/ gnas lugs ji bzhin gsal/ sgom byung 'od kyis gnas lugs ji bzhin gsal lab pa red/ de yang gnas lugs zer yag 'di sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la ye gdod ma nas yod red/ gnas lugs zer yag de la gzhi'i gnas lugs dang*/ lam gyi gnas lugs zhes gnyis yong gi yod red/ 'di yin pa'i skabs su gzhi gnas zer yag de sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la yod red/ bde gshegs snying po 'gro kun yongs la khyab//

gsungs pa nang bzhin dang*/ de ka nang bzhin gyi/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang*// de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang*// rigs yod phyir na lus can kun// rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can// zer yag gi rgyud bla ma'i skabs nas bshad bsdad yag gi gang ltar sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la bde gshegs snying po khyab bsdad yag de gzhi'i gnas lugs red/ bde gshegs snying po nas de la go ba rgyab stangs mang po yod red/ la las ni/ chos thams cad bden pas stong pa'i stong nyid du khas len mkhan yang yod red/ la las ni/ bde gshegs snying po de 'khor 'das thams cad kyi byed po gcig la bzhag bsdad mkhan yang yod red/ yang la las/ bde gshegs snying po zer yag 'di sems can ma 'ongs pa la glo bur dri dag gi gzhi'i gnas lugs mngon du 'gyur yag gi rgyu'am/ rigs sam/ khams shig la gtso bo bzhag nas chos nyid de chos can gyi tshul du yod bsdad yag gcig /chos nyid don dam pa'i gnas lugs de chos can kun rdzob kyi tshul du yod bsdad yag /chos nyid don dam pa'i gnas lugs de chos can kun rdzob kyi rnam pa'i tshul du yod bsdad yag cig la go ba len stangs shig yod red/ de 'dra yin dus gzhi gnas de la go ba len tshul mang po yod red/ bde gshegs snying po de la/ ga re yin na yang 'dra/ min na'ang 'dra/ gang ltar phyag rgya chen po gtso bo byas nas bshad yong dus sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zer yag 'di ye gdod ma nas yod bsdad pa red/ da lta nga rang tsho 'khrul pa'i skabs su yang yod red/ sang nyin mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i skabs su yang yod red/ da lta gzhi so so skye bo'i gnas skabs nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba kun ldan gyi skabs la sems kyi gnas lugs de glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri mas gos ma myong ba yin pa red/ sems can gyis sdug tu ma btang ba/

sangs rgyas kyis bzang du ma btang ba'i gnas lugs shig sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la lhan skyes kyi tshul du yod pa red/ de yod pa la brten nas nga rang tsho yang 'khor ba la skyo ba bskyed yag yod pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa thob 'dod kyi blo yod pa de yang rtsa ba de la brten nas 'byung ba yin zhes rgyud bla ma nas gsungs kyi yod red pa/

gal te sangs rgyas khams med na// sdug la skyo bar mi 'gyur zhing*// mya ngan 'das la 'dod pa dang*// don gnyer smon pa'ang med par 'gyur// zhes 'di bshad yong dus rgyu mtshan zhig ga re zer na/ gtso bo nga rang tsho'i gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zer yag de da lta nga tsho'i ngo ma shes pa red ma gtogs gang ltar 'khrul bsdad pa'i gnas skabs de ga rang la gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis yod red/ yod pa de nga rang tsho'i ngo ma shes pa red/ 'di ngo ma shes pa yin dus 'di ga re byed dgos red zer na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis gdams ngag 'di ngo sprod nas 'o khyod rang la de 'dra yod red/ gnas lugs zer ba de gzhi'i gnas lugs 'di 'dra zhig yod red/ de la khyod rang lam 'di 'dra zhig sbyang dgos red/ de nas thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab 'di 'dra byed nas bsten dgos red/ de 'dra byed nas bsten na/ khyod rang nam zhig mngon du 'gyur gyi yod red/ ces bshad kyi yod red/ de bshad yong dus nga rang la yod bsdad pa de bla mas ngo sprod yong ba red/ de red ma gtogs bla mas ngo sprod gsar du khyer yong yag de 'dra gang yang yod ma red/ yin na yang rang la yod bsdad pa 'di bla mas ngos 'dzin byed nas de ngo sprod yong dus rang la yod pa'i gzhi'i gnas lugs de'i steng la rtsad gcod nas thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab bsgom rgyab yong dus sang nyin dngos gnas drang gnas kyi 'chi kha yin na'ang red/ bar do yin na'ang red/ ga ba yin na yang gang ltar bla mas man ngag bstan bzhag pa'i gnas lugs de dang*/ rang la yod pa'i gzhi'i gnas lugs gnyis po de a ma dang phru gu ngo 'phrod pa bzhin ma bu ngo 'phrod kyi tshul du byas nas de nas grol ba yin zhes nas bshad kyi yod red/ grol stangs 'dra po 'di 'dras byas nas yong gi yod red/

5 mthar thug la gnas lugs gnyis med pa/ de 'dra yin dus skabs la gnas lugs gnyis yod pa'i skad cha ma red/ gzhi'i gnas lugs dang*/ lam gyi gnas lugs zer yag de gnyis yod pa'i skad cha ma red/ gzhi'i gnas lugs zer yag de sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la yod bsdad pa de rang bla mas ngo 'phrod nas de'i steng la thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab rtsad bdar byed yag de la lam gyi gnas lugs lab kyi yod red/ de gnyis ngo 'phrod yong dus ngo bo rang la yod pa'i gzhi gnas de dang*/ bla mas man ngag bstan pa de gnyis ngo 'phrod yong dus ma bu ngo 'phrod kyi tshul du gnas lugs mngon du 'gyur ba yin gsungs pa red/ 'bras bu mthar thug pa thob yag de phyag chen skabs la 'di 'dra byed nas yong gi yod red/ gnas lugs ji bzhin gsal/ de yin dus bla ma la bsten yag de gal chen po yin pa red/ de yang bla ma la bsten yag de yang bla ma la bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su 'du shes bskyed nas bla ma la bsten dgos pa ma gtogs/ phyag chen skabs su bla ma so so skye bo 'dzin pa yin na phyag rgya chen po skabs nas bshad pa'i man ngag 'di rang gi rgyud la skye yag la dka' las khag po yod pa red/ bla ma'i yon tan de sangs rgyas dang mnyam na'ang sku drin sangs rgyas las kyang lhag pa yin pa/ de 'dra zhig la ngo shes nas bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos su thag chod pa zhig dgos kyi yod gsungs kyi 'dug a/ de 'dra yin dus gnas lugs mngon du 'gyur yag la de dgos kyi yod red/ de phyag chen skabs la gzhi gnas mngon 'gyur de de 'dra zhig bshad kyi yod red/ de 'dra yin na yang*/ lam 'og ma dbu ma'i skabs su skad cha bshad stangs khag khag yin pa red/ gnas lugs ji bzhin gsal/ 6 shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas par smon pa/ 'di yin dus shes rab thams cad snang ba rgyas par shog /dang po thos byung gi shes rab skyes/

thos byung gi shes rab la brten nas bsam byung gi shes rab skyes/ bsam byung gi shes rab la brten nas sgom byung gi shes rab skye dgos pa red/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i dngos rgyu ngo ma 'di sus byed kyi yod red zer na/ sgom byung gi shes rab kyis byed kyi red ma gtogs thos bsam gnyis kyis byed kyi yod ma red/ yin na yang sgom byung gi shes rab skye ba la yang thos bsam gnyis gal chen po yin pa red/ las dang po pa la de bas kyang da dung gal che ba yin pa red/ thos bsam gnyis 'di bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*/ zla ba tshes pa la phyag bya'i nya ba la ni ma yin no// gang dag nga la dad pa rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag bya'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la de ltar ma yin no// zhes bshad yong dus tshes bco lnga'i zla ba nya gang ba yang tshes gsum gyi zla ba phyed pa la brten nas yong ba yin dus tshes gsum gyi zla ba phyed pa de gal che ba yin pa dang*/ nga la dad pa rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal dgos pa red ma gtogs de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal rgyu yod ma red/ de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba gang la brten nas byung ba red zer na/ byang chub sems dpa' la brten nas 'byung ba red zhes nas bshad pa yin dus rgyu gal che ba gsungs song a/ de 'dra yin dus phar phyin skabs la yang de 'dra bshad kyi yod red/ spyir btang drug pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten nas phar phyin gyi tha snyad sbyar gyi yod red de/ de 'dra ba'i drug pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par slebs par byed pa la yang dang po sbyin pa la bslab dgos kyi yod red/ sbyin pa gal chen po red gsungs pa red/ de nang bzhin 'di skabs la yang spyir btang gnas lugs mngon du 'gyur ba la yang sgom byung la brten nas yong dgos kyi yod red de/ sgom byung de lta bu skye bar byed pa la yang dang po thos bsam gyi rgyu sngon du 'gro dgos kyi 'dug a/

de 'dra yin dus go rim thog nas bshad yong dus snga ma snga ma gal che ba yin pa red/ dngos rgyu byed pa'i cha nas bshad na phyi ma phyi ma gal che ba bshad kyi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus 'jog stangs 'dra po 'di gnyis kyi thog nas 'gro dgos kyi yod sa red/ 'di la gzhi lam 'bras gsum bshad yong ba red/ cha 'khrul med kyi lam nyid la smon pa/ rtag chad mtha' bral bden gnyis gzhi yi don// sgro skur mtha' bral tshogs gnyis lam mchog gis// srid zhi'i mtha' bral don gnyis 'bras thob pa'i// gol 'chug med pa'i chos dang 'phrad par shog / dang po 'di la gzhi bden gnyis zung 'jug dbu ma'i skabs la de khag khag red/ gzhi bden gnyis zung 'jug gi dbu ma/ lam tshogs gnyis zung 'jug gi dbu ma/ 'bras bu sku gnyis zung 'jug gi dbu ma zhes nas bshad pa nang bzhin gyi 'di skabs la gzhi bden gnyis kyi phyag rgya chen po dang*/ lam tshogs gnyis kyi phyag rgya chen po dang*/ 'bras bu don gnyis kyi phyag rgya chen po zhes nas bshad kyi yod red/ 1 dang po lta ba gal che ba/ de yang dang po lta ba zer ba gal chen po red/ lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum gyi nang nas dang po lta ba gal che ba red/ lta ba nor na sgom pa nor gyi red/ sgom pa nor na spyod pa nor gyi red/ de 'dra yin dus lta ba de zhe drag gal chen po yin pa red/ lta ba zer yag de ga re red/ sgro 'dogs gcod yag de la lta ba zer gyi yod red/ sgro 'dogs chod rung zhig la lta ba zer gyi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus/ lta bas dpyad pa rdzogs yag 'di sbyor lam chos mchog chen po'i sngon la rdzogs dgos kyi yod red/ lta bas dpyad pa rdzogs yag la sbyor lam chos mchog chen po la rdzogs dgos kyi yod pa yin dus sbyor lam chos mchog chen po la lta bas dpyad pa rdzogs nas de nas sa dang po chos nyid sngon du 'gro ba'i don mthong dgos kyi yod red/

de yin dus de sngon la rdzogs dgos kyi yod pa red 'dug /de 'dra yin dus rtag chad mtha' bral zer yag 'di ga re dgos kyi yod red/ de nas rtag chad gnyis kyi lta ba de skyon yin pa red/ rtag par lta ba dang*/ chad par lta ba zer yag gi skyon de skyon chen po yin pa red/ 2 dbu ma'i dgag bya bstan pa/ dbu ma'i skabs su yang dgag bya gtso bo de ga re red zer na/ rtag chad gnyis kyi dgag pa lta ba de gtso bo dgag gi yod red ma gtogs de las gzhan pa'i dgag pa gang yang yod ma red/ lam rtag par smra ba dang*/ lam chad par smra ba de dbu ma'i dgag bya thun mong ma yin par mtha' gnyis zer yag de skyon che shos yin pa red/ gnas lugs 'bras bu yang dag par thob par byed pa la yang skyon che shos 'di gnyis yin pa red/ slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyi lam las ni// phyi rol 'gyur la zhi ba'i thabs med do// de dag kun rdzob de nyid bden las nyams// de las nyams pas thar pa grub yod min// zer nas zla ba grags pas gsungs yag 'di gtso bo thar pa med par sgrub yag gi skyon 'di lta ba nor bzhag yong tsang rtag chad kyi lta ba la bzhag 'dug a/ 'di 'dra yin dus rtag par smra ba mu stegs grangs can pa/ chad par smra ba mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa/ gtso bo lta log drug cu tsa lnga yod red/ 'di yongs rdzogs tshur bsdus pa yin na rtag par smra ba bzhi dang*/ chad par smra ba gcig gi nang la bzhag yod red/ mi pham rin po ches dbu ma rgyan nang la/ 'di 'dra yin dus rtag chad gnyis zer nas rtag par smra ba mu stegs grangs can pa bzhag /chad par smra ba 'di mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa bzhag na'ang 'grig gi 'dug a/ yin na yang 'di tsho kho grub mtha' smra ba'i skad cha zhig red/ phyi rol pa'i grub mtha' smra ba red/ 'di ha cang gi 'gal yag yod ma red de/ nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba nas/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i bar la rtag chad kyi lta ba khas len na/

'di skyon che shos yin pa red/ 'di sdug shos yin pa red/ phyi rol pa zhig gis rtag chad khas len pa yin na 'di la ha las dgos yag med pa red/ 'di kho rang kho rang gi grub mtha'i khas len zhig red/ 'di las lhag pa'i lta ba ni kho la bshad yag yod ma red/ rtag chad spang ba'i thabs shes ni byed kyi yod ma red/ 'dis kho rang kho rang gi lta ba 'di khas blang bsdad kyi yod red ba/ 3 nang pa sangs rgyas pa thams cad sems tsam par grub pa/ nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa/ spyir nang pa sangs rgyas pa zer yag 'di sems tsam pa la bshad kyi yod red/ sems tsam pa la gnyis yod red pa/ byed po gzhan med par smra ba'i sems tsam pa dang*/ snang ba sems su sgrub pa'i sems tsam pa gnyis bshad kyi yod red/ snang ba sems su sgrub pa'i sems tsam pa 'di bshad yong dus grub mtha' smra ba bzhi'i zlas phye ba'i sems tsam pa 'di bshad kyi yod red/ byed po gzhan med par smra ba'i sems tsam bshad pa'i skabs su nang pa sangs rgyas pa yongs rdzogs sems tsam pa chags 'gro yi yod red/ 'di 'dra sbyar nas bshad kyi yod red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa yongs rdzogs byed po gzhan med par smra ba'i sems tsam pa chags yong dus tshang mas las khas len gyi yod red/ 'jig rten bkod pa po lha dang dbang phyug tshangs pa zer yag 'di khas len gyi yod ma red/ nang pas lta ba ga re bshad kyi yod red zer na/ lta ba rten 'brel khas len gyi yod red/ nang pas lta ba rten 'brel khas len yong dus 'jig rten 'di las las skyes pa/ las kyis byung ba khas len gyi yod pa/ khas len yong dus nang pa yongs rdzogs byed po gzhan med par smra ba'i sems tsam pa lab dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di red 'dug /'di yin dus/ 'jig rten sna tshogs las las skyes// zer yag 'di las la brten nas skyes kyi yod pa khas len dus nang pa sangs rgyas pas rtag chad smra ba khas len pa yin na mi 'grig pa red/
