'di yin dus 'di skabs la rtag chad mtha' bral zer yag 'di phyi rol pas khas len bsdad pa'i rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral na/ bden gnyis gzhi'i don zer nas gsungs kyi yod ma red/ ga re zer na/ phyi rol pa'i skad cha gang yang yod ma red/ phyi rol pas kho rang kho rang grub mtha' khas len stangs shig red/ 'di 'dra phyi rol pas khas len bsdad pa 'di nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' smra ba bzhi yis/ lhag par phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag nyams su len pa'i skabs la 'di 'dra'i rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis khas len byas na 'grig gi yod ma red gsungs pa red/ rtag par smra ba dang chad par smra ba de 'dra byas nas khas len byas na/ 'di yin dus gzhi'i skabs la rtag pa'i skyon dang bral ba/ rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral ba/ chad pa'i mtha' dang bral ba 'di/ 'di'i gnyen po la bden pa gnyis yong gi yod red/ rtag mtha' spong ba la don dam pa'i bden pa yong gi yod red/ chad pa'i mtha' spong ba la kun rdzob bden pa yong gi yod red/ de red 'dug a/ 4 bden pa gnyis bstan pa/ 'di yin dus bden pa gnyis zer yag 'di la/ bden gnyis kyi spyir btang gi rnyog sgra mang po yod red/ de nas bden pa gnyis kun rdzob kyi bden pa dang*/ don dam pa'i bden pa zhes bshad kyi yod red/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa dang*/ don dam pa'i bden pa zhes bshad dus/ kun rdzob bden pa zer yag 'di ga re red zer na/ da lta nga rang tsho'i dbang shes drug gi yul du gyur pa'i tshogs drug gi shes pa'i yul du gyur pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa/ mdor na gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar du gyur pa'i chos thams cad kun rdzob bden pa yin pa red/ de nas don dam pa'i bden pa zer yag 'di 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag rnal 'byor pa sa dang po la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i mnyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'di'i ngor gang yod pa don dam bden pa yin pa red/

de dang ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi yul du gyur pa'ang rnam mkhyen gyi yul du gyur pa'i chos thams cad don dam bden pa yin pa red/ de yang bden gnyis zer yag 'di chos gnyis yod nas bden pa gnyis bshad kyi yod ma red/ chos thams cad bden pa gnyis kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa bshad dgos pa red/ 'di bshad yong dus/ snang tshul gyi cha nas kun rdzob bden pa bshad/ gnas tshul gyi cha nas don dam bden pa bshad kyi yod red/ blo'i 'dzin stangs gnyis 'byung ba red ma gtogs chos kho rang gi steng la kun rdzob bden pa zer yag chos shig dang*/ don dam bden pa'i chos zer yag chos gnyis yod pa bshad kyi yod ma red/ kun mkhyen mi bskyod rdo rje yi lugs la bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag bshad yong dus/ spyir btang gi kun rdzob kyi bden pa gang yin pa de rang don dam pa'i bden pa dang*/ don dam pa'i bden pa gang yin pa de rang kun rdzob bden pa bshad kyi yod red/ de red ma gtogs kun rdzob kyi bden pa'i chos zer na 'di red/ don dam pa'i bden pa'i chos zer na 'di red/ ces yod ma red/ yin na yang 'khrul tshul gyi thog nas bshad yong dus so so skye bo'i snang yul du gyur pa'i snang tshul 'di kun rdzob bden pa la bzhag /'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag rnal 'byor pa'i mkhyen pa'i yul du gyur pa'i chos 'di don dam pa'i bden par bzhag gi red zer yag 'di rlom tshod dang bsam tshod thog la khas len stangs shig gi khyad par red ma gtogs don la 'di don dam pa'i chos red/ 'di kun rdzob bden pa'i chos red zer nas 'di 'dra byas nas bshad yong yag gang yang yod ma red/ 'di skabs sems kyi thog la nyams su len yong dus gang dag 'khrul pa'i chos su gyur pa yin na/ 'di thams cad snang tshul kun rdzob bden pa'i chos red/ don dam ma 'khrul pa'i chos shig yin nas bzung ste ma 'khrul pa'i chos gang yin pa thams cad don dam pa'i bden pa red lab pa red/

'di yin dus da lta gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa gang dag snang tshul dang rig tshul du gyur pa'i chos thams cad kun rdzob bden pa red 'dug a/ kun rdzob bden pa 'di'i ngo bo de mdun la yod pa'i cog tse 'di kun rdzob bden pa red/ mdun la yod pa'i cog tse 'di'i rang bzhin ga re yin pa 'di ma nor ba'i rang bzhin gang yin pa don dam bden pa red ma gtogs snang tshul phar bzhag nas/ 'di ma yin pa don dam pa'i bden pa gcig logs nas 'khyer yong yag zhig yod sa ma red/ da lta'i snang tshul gang yin 'di'i rang bzhin ma nor ba shes na don dam bden pa dang*/ 'di'i rang bzhin ma nor ba ma shes na kun rdzob bden pa zhes bzhag pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus don dam bden pa zhes bshad yong dus rtag par smra ba'i skyon spangs pa red/ kun rdzob bden pa zhes bshad yong dus chad par smra ba'i skyon spang pa red 'dug /'di 'dra yin dus bden gnyis zung 'jug gi lta ba gtan la phab yag 'di gzhi yi lta ba red/ gzhi yi don zer/ gzhi bden gnyis zung 'jug gi lta ba/ bden pa gnyis la ma brten pa la lam tshogs gnyis zung 'jug dang*/ 'bras bu sku gnyis zung 'jug yong gi yod ma red/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang*/

sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa// bden pa gnyis la yang dag bstan// zhes bshad yong dus sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan yag 'di gtso bo bden gnyis la sbyar nas bshad pa red/ bden pa gnyis la ma sbyar ba'i chos rtsa nas bshad yag med pa red/ de yin dus bden pa gnyis kyi byed las ga re red zer na/ rtag chad gnyis kyi skyon spang ba yin pa red/ 'di yin dus bden gnyis gzhi yi don/ 5 sgro skur gyi mtha' gnyis dang bral tshul/ lam gyi skabs su sgro skur gyi mtha' gnyis dang bral ba la tshogs gnyis bstan dgos pa red 'dug /yod pa la sgro btags pa'i skyon/ med pa la skur pa 'debs pa'i skyon zhes bshad kyi yod red/ kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad dngos gnas drang gnas kyi don dam pa la yod red/ da lta'i snang tshul ga re yod pa 'di dngos gnas drang gnas 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa ye shes kyi yul du gyur pa de ga rang red zer nas bshad pa yin na 'di sgro btags pa red/ yod ma red pa/ 'di med pa red/ dper na don dam pa'i chos gnas lugs gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang*/ stong pa nyid bshad pa 'di tsho 'dra gyi yod ma red/ nga tsho so so skye bo'i mthong ba med pas 'di yod ma red ces lab pa yin na/ skur ba btab pa red/ so so skye bos ma mthong ba tsam gyis med pa bsgrub thub kyi ma red/ 'di yin dus yod pa la sgro btags pa'i skyon dang*/ med pa la skur ba 'debs pa'i skyon mtha' gnyis dang bral bas 'di'i gnyen po la dmigs bcas bsod nams kyi tshogs dang*/ dmigs med ye shes kyi tshogs zhes tshogs gnyis kyi lam la brten dgos red/ dmigs bcas bsod nams kyi tshogs 'di kun rdzob red/ dmigs med ye shes kyi tshogs 'di don dam bden pa red/ de yang bden gnyis la brten nas yong dgos kyi yod red/ tshogs gnyis la brten nas 'bras bu thob dgos kyi yod red/

de nas 'bras bu de la/ srid zhi'i mtha' dang bral bas don gnyis 'bras thob pa'i/ srid zhi'i mtha' dang bral ba zer yag 'di srid pa khams gsum 'khor ba'i skyon dang*/ zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i skyon gnyis yong gi yod red/ de yang gtso bo ga re dgos kyi red zer na/ nyan thos pa lta bu cha bzhag pa yin na/ lta ba stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab yod red/ lta ba stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab yod pa la brten nas srid pa'i rtsa ba gcod thub kyi red de/ yin na yang zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa 'gog pa'i dbyings la gnas kyi yod red/ ga re red zer na/ thabs dang bral bas shes rab chags pa red pa/ de theg pa chen po 'dra po yin na ni thabs dang shes rab gnyis ka yod pa'i skabs su srid pa dang zhi ba gnyis ka la mi gnas pa'i srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha' las 'das pa'i 'bras yum shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i 'bras bu thob thub kyi yod red/ 'di la brten nas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis rang don dang gzhan don gnyis ka mthar phyin nas/ spang rtogs phun sum tshogs pa mthar phyin nas 'bras bu thob thub kyi yod pa 'di theg pa chen po kho na la ma gtogs nyan rang la med pa red pa/ de 'dra yin dus srid zhi'i mtha' bral zer yag 'di srid pa 'khor ba'i mtha' dang*/ zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' gnyis dang bral ba bshad yong dus/ 'di gnyis gang yang rung ba la ma gnas pa/ 'di gnyis las 'das pa'i 'bras bu thob dgos pa yin pa de yang gtso bo don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa mthar phyin pa la rag las kyi yod red/ 6 gol 'chug med pa'i chos dang 'phrad par smon pa/ de yin dus/ don gnyis 'bras thob pa'i/ gol 'chug med pa'i chos dang phrad par shog /phyag rgya chen po yi skabs su gol 'chug med pa gtso bo gzhi bden gnyis zung 'jug dang*/ lam tshogs gnyis zung 'jug dang*/ 'bras bu don gnyis sku gnyis zung 'jug 'di bshad pa red/

rang don la chos sku dang*/ gzhan don du gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis kyi 'bras bu thob pa/ don gnyis de rang yin pa red/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu 'di/ gol 'chug med pa'i chos dang phrad par shog /zer yag 'di/ gol 'chug zer yag 'di gnyis la go dgos kyi yod red/ gol zer yag 'di phyi rol pa'i lam la ma gol ba/ 'chug zer yag 'di nyan rang gi lam la ma 'chug pa zer nas 'grel bshad bskyon gyi yod/ 'di 'dra yin dus gol 'chug med pa'i chos dang phrad par shog /theg pa chen po kho rang nang la gtso bo kho rang gol 'chug med pa'i lam chags bsdad kyi yod red de/ 'di nang nas theg pa chen po da lta 'di phyag rgya chen po man ngag gi lam gyi rim pa'i skabs la yang kho rtsa ba nyan rang dang*/ phyi rol pa'i lam la gol 'chug med pa thun mong ma yin pa bshad bsdad kyi yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus gol 'chug med pa'i chos dang phrad par shog /ma 'ongs pa la bdag dang sems can thams cad 'di lta bu yi gol 'chug med pa'i chos dang 'phrad par shog gsungs pa red bzhag / ja lam de nyams su len tshul ma 'khrul par smon pa'i go don/ sbyang gzhi sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug la// sbyong byed phyag chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ches// sbyang bya glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma rnams// sbyang 'bras dri bral chos sku mngon gyur shog / 'di skabs la/ sbyang gzhi dang gcig /sbyong byed dang gnyis/ sbyang bya dang gsum/ sbyang 'bras dang bzhi bshad kyi yod red/ de'ang gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi phyag chen dang sbyar ba'i skabs su lam rgyud kyi phyag chen la gtso bo go dgos kyi yod sa red/ lam rgyud kyi phyag chen rnal 'byor 'di nyams su len yong dus dang po ha go dgos yag 'di dri ma gang du sbyangs nas gzhi'i dang po ngos 'dzin dgos kyi yod red/ dri ma gang du sbyangs pa'i gzhi 'di ngos zin nas de lta bu'i dri ma de lam gang 'dra zhig la brten nas dri ma sbyangs dgos kyi yod pa 'di lam gang gis sbyong ba'i rnal 'byor du bshad dgos kyi yod red/

lam gang gis sbyong ba'i rnal 'byor 'di bshad tshar nas/ sbyang rgyu dri ma ga re yin pa/ sbyang bar bya rgyu ga re yin pa/ lam 'di'ang gnyen po 'di yis gang zhig sbyang bar bya ba/ sbyang bya yi dri ma 'di bshad nas/ de lta bu tshar nas sbyangs pa 'di yis thob pa'i 'bras bu chos sku bshad nas rim pa 'dra po bzhi'i thog nas yong gi yod red/ 1 sbyang gzhi ngos bzung ba/ 'di la dang po/ sbyang gzhi sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug la// dang po sbyang gzhi ngos zin pa red/ dri ma sbyangs zer yag 'di spyir btang theg pa thun mong gi skabs la dri ma dang po ngos zin dgos kyi yod red/ dri ma ngos zin nas dri ma de sbyang ba la brtson dgos kyi yod red/ dri ma de sbyang bar brtson pa la dang po dri ma de ga ba la yod red zer nas/ rtsad gcod btang yag 'di theg pa thun mong gi lugs la lam gyi rim pa bshad stangs shig chags yong dus/ de skabs la theg pa thun mong ba'i sgo dang bstun nas bshad yong dus dang po sbyang gzhi 'di/ sbyang bar bya ba'i dri ma 'di gzhi gang du yod red zer nas bshad 'ong dus dang po sbyang bya kho rang dri ma rang bzhin du grub dang ma grub la/ dang po bsam blo zhig btang yag 'di yong bsdad kyi yod sa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus sbyang bya kho rang dri ma 'di/ kun rdzob tu yod yod pa red/ kun rdzob tu dri ma sbyang dgos pa red/ kun rdzob kyi dri ma sbyang bar bya bar byed pa la de'i sbyong byed kyi gnyen po la bsten dgos pa red/ yin na yang dang po dri ma 'di ga ba la yod red zer nas bshad yong dus dri ma gzhi gang zhig la gnas/ gzhi gang 'dra zhig la brten/ gzhi gang 'dra zhig la bsdad yod red/ de ngos 'dzin byed 'ong dus dri ma bsdad sa'i gzhi de sems kyi gnas lugs/ sems nyid/ gnas lugs/ 'od gsal/ lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes kyi dbyings la yod red lab pa red/

'di 'dra zer ba'i skabs su la/ 'o na dri ma dang sems gnyis la tha dad med pa 'dra po gcig /de 'dra ba'i sbyang bya glo bur gyi dri ma dang*/ gang du sbyang ba'i gzhi sems nyid bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po'am sems kyi gnas lugs mthar thug pa'i chos kyi dbyings 'di gnyis ngo bo gcig pa 'dra po zhig gi thog la gnas yod red pas zer na ma red/ gnas sa sems nyid bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po'i steng la gnas yod red de/ gnas stangs gang 'dra zhig gi thog nas gnas yod red zer na/ dri ma bral rung gi tshul gyi sgo nas gnas yod red/ glo bur bral rung gi tshul du gnas yod pa red/ dri ma zer ba de glo bur ba red/ sems nyid zer yag 'di yon tan gyi mthar thug yin pa red/ yon tan gyi mthar thug tu gyur pa'i chos de la rang bzhin la 'gyur ba yod ma red/ rgyud bla ma yi skabs la yang*/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi sems zer yag cig bshad bsdad kyi yod red/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi sems zer yag 'di ga ba bshad bsdad kyi yod red zer na/ gzhi sems can thams cad khams gsum 'khor ba la 'khrul tshul de rang gi rang ngo ma rig nas 'khrul ba red/ yin na yang 'khrul ba'i gnas skabs de nyid nas sems kyi rang bzhin nam sems kyi ngo bo spang bya ye nas med pa dang*/ gnyen po yon tan thams cad ye nas rdzogs pa/ spang bya'i skyon thams cad ye nas zad pa/ 'di 'dra zhig la ngos 'dzin byed dgos red ma gtogs spang bya'i skyon de rang bzhin gyis grub pa zhig dang*/ gnyen po yon tan de'ang gsar du bstan bya yod pa zhig la khas len na/ ma 'grig pa de byams chos kyi nang la mang po bshad bsdad kyi yod red/ 'byed rnam gnyis la sogs pa gsungs pa'i skabs la/ 2 sems dang sems nyid kyi khyad par/ 'o na 'di skabs la rang bzhin rnam dag gi sems ngo 'dzin byed yong dus spyir sems zhes pa dang*/ sems nyid zer ba gnyis la khyad par chen po zhe drag yod red/

sems nyid lab yong dus nyid ces pa'i sgra 'di ga ba go dgos kyi yod red zer na/ sems kyi rang bzhin la go ba red/ ma bcos pa la go ba red/ sems kyi gnas lugs la go ba red/ nyid zhes pa de gzhan ldan rnam gcod kyi sgra yin dus ga re gzhan ldan rnam par gcod kyi yod red zer na/ glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba'i bral cha de la ga re yod red zer na/ gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i shes pa de yod red/ sems kyi rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i gnyug ma'i ye shes de ma bcos pa sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la ye gdod ma nas rang chas su yod bsdad pa/ 'di 'dra ba'i rang chas su yod bsdad pa'i yon tan de'ang gsar du bsgrub bzhag pa 'di 'dra yang ma yin pa/ gnyen po la brten nas gsar du bsgrub pa yang ma yin pa/ spang bya la brten nas spang bya phar yod nas spang bya rang bzhin gyis grub nas de phar spangs pa'i bral 'bras la bral cha de la sems nyid zer yag gcig /yang gsar du tshur grub yag lta bu de 'dra ma yin pa/ gnas lugs de kho na nyid kyi yon tan 'di sems can thams cad 'khrul pa'i gnas skabs na yang kho ngo bo la 'pho 'gyur thams cad dang bral ba/ bzang du sangs rgyas kyis ma btang*/ ngan du sems can gyis kyang ma btang ba'i gnas lugs kyi gnyug ma zer yag 'di sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la rang chas su ye gdod ma nas yod bsdad pa de la nyid ces pa'i tha snyad kyi sgra 'di sbyar yong dus/ nyid ces pa'i don dag 'di sems kyi ngo bo la go ba yin pa red/ sems kyi rang bzhin la go ba red/ sems kyi mtshan nyid ma bcos pa bshad pa red/ sems zhes pa 'di ga re red/ sems zhes pa spyir btang gi sems zhes pa bshad yong dus sems tsam pa'i skabs la/ sems rig rnam shes gsum gyi skad cha bshad yong ba'i skabs su sems zhes pa ma dag pa'i sems la skad cha bshad kyi yod red/

spyir dag pa'i sems dang ma dag pa'i sems zhes dbye ba phye chog gi yod red de/ yin na yang spyir btang sems zhes pa ma dag pa'i tshig cig la bshad bsdad kyi yod red/ ma dag pa'i shes pa zhig la sems zhes tha snyad btags kyi yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus sems nyid bshad yong ba'i skabs su rdzogs chen skabs la yin na ni/ sems dang rig pa dbye ba phye nas bshad yong dus/ rig pa dag cha nas bshad/ sems ma dag pa'i cha nas bshad yong ba'i gnas skabs shig yod red/ 'di 'dra bshad yong dus sems rig gnyis skad cha khag khag phye nas bshad yong dus/ sems la dag dang ma dag pa'i skad cha med pa byas/ sems kho rang spyir btang ma dag pa'i cha nas bshad/ dag pa 'di sems glo bur ba'i rnam rtog gi nyon mongs bral cha 'di'i shugs la rig pa bshad pa ma bcos pa'i gnas lugs shig yod red/ ces rig pa gsal cha'am dag cha nas bshad nas/ sems zhes pa ma dag pa'i cha nas kun 'byung gi cha nas bshad kyi yod pa red 'dug / phyag chen skabs su de 'dra'i skad cha gang yang med pa red/ 'di 'dra gang yang med yong dus/ do ha de 'dra'i nang log la/ srid zhi gnyis kyi yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems las byung ba yin dus/ yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gang ltar yid bzhin nor bu dang 'dra ba'i sems la phyag 'tshal ba yin dus sems 'di dag pa'i sems la bshad pa red/ dag pa'i sems dang ma dag pa'i sems dbye ba gnyis phye nas sems nyid zhes pa'i sems nyid 'di da lta do ha la sogs pa'i nang la gsungs bzhag pa'i glo bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag gi glo bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag phar ldan bzhin pa'i gnas skabs nas kyang sems can thams cad kyi rang bzhin 'di ye nas rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin zhig yin bsdad ya'i gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i shes pa'am ma bcos pa'i gnyug ma rang babs kyi shes pa zhig la/ nyid ces pa'i tha snyad sbyar yong dus/

dag pa'i sems nyid bshad pa red 'dug / de yang mdo yi skabs la yin na ni/ tshogs sbyor gyi gnas skabs la lam gyi yon tan bstan stangs gcig /de nas mthong lam gyi skabs slebs pa'i skabs su 'phags pa'i bden pa chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs yong ba'i gnas skabs la sems kyi gnas sa gcig /de nas mthong lam la sogs par slebs yong ba'i skabs su/ mnyam rjes kyi dbye ba la brten nas dag pa dang ma dag pa'i rnam gzhag cig bshad yong dus sems kyi thog nas yon tan skye stangs dang*/ spang bya de mar sgrib stangs kyi thog nas skad cha mang po bshad kyi yod red de/ 'di tsho de'i skabs la skad cha gang yang med pa red/ ga re zer na/ med pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di phyag rgya chen po 'di rtsa ba sems nyid kyi gnas lugs ngos 'dzin byed yag la/ dbang po spyir btang gi cig car ba 'dra po zhig la bsam blo btang nas bshad kyi yod red 'dug /dbang po rim gyis pa 'dra po yin na ni/ theg pa rim gyis pa'i thog nas zer na'ang dang po nyan thos nas byas nas gsang sngags bla med kyi bar du la go rim bzhin du 'gro dgos pa 'di chags bsdad kyi yod red/ 3 phyag chen ngo sprod pa'i bla slob kyi mtshan nyid/ yin na'ang phyag rgya chen po zer yag 'di skad cig thung bya'i thog nas ma bcos pa'i tha mal shes pa kho rang mthar thug la ngos 'dzin byed yong ba'i dbang po yang rab kyi nyams len byed yag gi gnas tshul zhig chags yong dus lam sbyangs pa sngon song ba yin na yang red/ lam sbyangs pa sngon du ma song na yang red/ gang ltar chos nyid kyi gnas lugs 'di kho rig pas btsal cing ngo sprod thub yag cig gi skor la nus pa dang cha rkyen 'dra po 'di 'dra zhig yod pa gzhir bzhag nas 'di'i steng nas ngo sprod byed 'ong ba yin dus/ bla ma yang chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig byed/ slob ma yang phyag rgya chen po nyams len byar rung ba'i skal pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag gcig gi ngos nas bshad yong dus/

kha thug la rig pa rjen cer du ngo sprod nas gnas lugs gnyug ma 'di thad kar gtugs byas nas bshad yong ba yin dus da lta mdo lam nang bzhin byas nas rim bzhin du 'di skabs su 'gro yag skad cha 'di skabs su med pa red/ lam sbyangs pa sngon song lta bu yi skad cha bshad pa yin na ni theg pa rim can gyi thog nas 'gro dgos kyi red/

spyir spang bya la nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa zer yag 'di spang bya mar mdo nas byas nas ya gi gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bar du la spang bya yongs rdzogs gcig pa red ma gtogs de ma yin pa'i spang bya zhig zur du yod ma red/ phra rags kyi thog nas skad cha zhig bshad kyi yod red ma gtogs 'di 'dra yin dus thad kar gyi kho ngos 'dzin byed yag skad cha yin pa yin dus nyid ces pa'i skabs su rang bzhin rnam dag gi sems la go ba red/ 'di 'dra yin dus dri ma 'di ga ba la yod red zer na/ dri ma 'di de lta bu'i sbyang gzhi dri ma 'di gzhi gang 'dra zhig la bsdad yod red/ ces bshad yong dus sems nyid gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i shes pa 'di'i steng la bsdad yod red lab pa red/ 'dir bsdad yong dus nga rang tsho thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang sgrub par byed pa la gegs kyi dri ma mang po yong gi yod red/ gegs kyi dri ma mtha' dag sel ma thub na/ sems nyid kyi gnas lugs ngos 'dzin byed thub kyi ma red/ 'di 'dra yin dus/ dri ma sbyang sa yi gzhi kho rang kha thug la ngos 'dzin byed yong dus theg pa rim gyis pa'i skad cha nang bzhin byas nas 'gro mi dgos pa byed nas kha thug la dri ma gang du gnas pa'i gzhi 'dra po 'di la ngos 'dzin byas yong dus thad kar sems nyid ces lab pa red 'dug a/ de ma gtogs spyir btang tshad ma rnam 'grel nang la/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal te// dri ma rnams ni glo bur ba// zhes bshad yong ba'i skabs su 'di gnyis la khyad par zhe drag gang yang phye thub yag med pa red/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal yin pa 'di'i sgang la yongs rdzogs ngos 'dzin byed yag cig red/ dri ma rnams ni glo bur ba yin pa 'di theg pa che chung gis cha tshang gis ngos 'dzin byed yag cig red/ de red ma gtogs med pa yin dus kho ngo 'dzin byed yong dus gcig pa 'dra po zhig 'gro gi yod red/

'di yin dus sems nyid rang bzhin rnam dag gi sems 'di yod red/ 4 sbyang gzhi sems nyid kyi mtshan nyid/ 'di 'dra sbyang gzhi yi sems nyid kyi gnas lugs 'di 'o na ga 'dra zhig yod red zer na/ mtshan nyid bshad yong dus gsal stong zung 'jug red ces lab pa red/ sbyang gzhi sems nyid de 'dra'i sems nyid de 'o na ga 'dra zhig yod red zer nas bshad yong dus spyir btang sems nyid de 'dra zhig yod red zer nas dpe gang gis kyang mi mtshon/ tshig gang gis kyang brjod pa dang bral ba 'di 'dra zhig gi thog nas 'gro dgos kyi yod red/ yin na yang kho mtshon byed tsam gyis bshad yong dus gsal stong zung 'jug red ces lab pa red/ sems zhes pa 'di'i rang bzhin gang 'dra yod red zer na/ sems zhes pa'i rang bzhin 'di gsal stong zung 'jug red/ stong pa sems kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ gsal ba sems kyi rang bzhin zhes bshad kyi yod red/ gsal stong zer yag 'di/ 'di la stong zhes pa'i tshig 'di la yang*/ dbu ma rang stong skabs la stong nyid khas len stangs shig dang*/ dbu ma gzhan stong pa rnams kyis stong nyid khas len stangs rnam pa gnyis yod red/ de'ang rgyud bla ma yi nang la/ rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid kyis// glo bur dag gis khams stong gi/ rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid kyis// bla med chos kyis stong ma yin// zhes pa'i tshig 'di la brten nas mar yong gi yod red/ 'di yong dus kun rdzob kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad blo gnyis 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad 'di ma dag pa'i gzhan dbang gis bsdus pa'i chos red/ 'di 'dra ma dag pa'i gzhan dbang la bsdus pa'i chos de lta bu rang bzhin gyis grub pa yod red pas zer na/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa yod ma red/ 'o 'di yin dus kho kho rang rang gis ngo bos stong pa red/ rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa'am rang gi ngo bos stong pa/

rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa red ces lab pa red/ rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'am rang gi ngo bos stong pa/ yin na yang da lta 'di'i skabs la phyag chen skabs dang gzhan stong skabs nas bshad bsdad pa'i stong nyid 'di rang stong la go rgyu min pa red/ 'di 'dra'i stong nyid 'di ga re red zer na/ de lta bu'i sems kyi gnas lugs rang bzhin rnam dag gi sems ye gdod ma nas spang bya dang skyon thams cad zad bsdad pa'i yon tan gyi rang chas su yod bsdad pa'i sems kyi gnas lugs de la/ zhen yul da ltar gyi glo bur gyi dri ma bag chags nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa la sogs pa glo bur gyi dri mas stong pa'i cha la gzhan stong zhes tha snyad sbyar yong dus/ rang gi ngo bo stong nyid yin pa 'di bshad kyi yod ma red 'di skabs la/ rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i stong nyid zer yag 'di kun rdzob kyi cha nas bshad pa red/ kun rdzob cha nas bshad yong dus kun rdzob stong tshul dang*/ mnyam bzhag gi thog nas chos thams cad spros pa'i mtha' bkag yag la dbu ma rang stong dang gzhan stong gnyis la khyad par med zer nas gsungs kyi yod red/ rang stong dang gzhan stong gnyis la kun rdzob stong tshul dang*/ kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad rang rang gi ngo bos stong tshul dang*/ 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag gi ngo la mtha' bzhi dang spros pa'i skyon thams cad phar bkag yag la spros pa'i mtha' 'gog yag la dbu ma rang stong gzhan stong gnyis la khyad par med pa red/ 'o na ga re red zer na/ mnyam bzhag gi spros mtha' thams cad bkag tshar nas mnyam bzhag gi spros mtha' thams cad bkag /kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad rang gi ngo bos stong zin pas stong shul 'di la dgag bya bkag pa'i shul la med dgag khas len nam ma yin dgag khas len/ 'o da de nas khyad par yong gi yod pa yin dus dgag bya bkag shul la khas len stangs 'gro gi yod red/

'di'i khyad par 'gro yong dus dbu ma gzhan stong pa thams cad kyis dgag bya bkag pa'i shul la ga re yod red zer na/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshogs gnyis kyi 'bras bu 'di sku gsum gyi yon tan 'di rang chas su grub bsdad pa 'di bshad sdod kyi yod red/ sku gsum gyi yon tan rang chas su grub bsdad pa 'di yang da lta sems dang rig pa shes pa gsum bshad yong ba'i skabs su sems dang gcig /rnam shes dang gnyis/ rig pa dang gsum/ zhes zer nas gsum bshad kyi yod red/ sems rig rnam shes gsum bshad pa'i skabs la/ 'di la kun gzhi dang gcig /de ma thag pa'i yid dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i yid gsum sbyar nas bshad yong dus de'i ldog phyogs la sku gsum gyi rnam gzhag 'di yong gi yod byas nas/ ngo bo stong pa chos sku/ rang bzhin gsal ba longs sku/ thugs rje 'gag med du shar ba sprul sku 'di sku gsum gyi rang chas 'di 'bras bu'i skabs la 'di 'dra yong gi yod/ 'di dbu ma gzhan stong pas sgrub yong dus/ kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad rang rang ngo bo stong nyid sgrub pa la rang stong gzhan stong gnyis la khyad par med pa red/ dgag bya bkag pa'i shul la sku dang ye shes 'du bral med pa'am sku gsum rang chas su khas len mkhan 'di dbu ma gzhan stong pa thams cad kyi khyad chos yin zhes bshad kyi yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus gsal stong zung 'jug zer yag 'di yang gsal ba sems kyi rang bzhin dang*/ stong pa sems kyi mtshan nyid gnyis po 'di zung du 'jug pa zhig la go ba red 'dug / 5 zung 'jug gi don/ zung 'jug zer yag 'di yang skud pa dkar nag bsgril bzhag pa nang bzhin zung 'jug 'di 'dra ma yin chos gnyis yod nas zung du 'jug pa'i skad cha ma red/ ldog phyogs nas bshad yong gi yod red/ ldog phyogs nas bshad yong dus gsal ba dang stong pa zhes byas nas sems la rang bzhin gyi cha nas sems gsal ba 'di bshad/

mtshan nyid kyi cha nas stong pa bshad yong dus 'di 'dra'i gsal la stong pa/ stong la gsal ba'i sgo ma bkag pa/ 'di 'dra'i yon tan gnyis de yang tha mi dad pa'i tshul gyis ldog pa'i cha nas tha dad phye ba red ma gtogs don gyi cha la khyad par med pa zhig bshad bsdad kyi yod red/ de'ang mi pham rin po ches nges shes sgron me'i nang la gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi/ snang de snang tshugs ma shor zhing*// gzhi med rtsa ba bral bar gnas// stong de stong tshugs ma shor zhing*// rten 'byung 'gags par med par shar// zer yag 'di 'dra'i gsal stong dbyer med kyi grub stangs 'di dang*/ da lta 'di'i skabs la phyag chen gyi grub stangs 'di gnyis khyad par med pa red 'dug /snang ba'i skabs nas kho snang dus nyid nas kho rang bzhin stong cha 'di ma 'gags pa zhig yod pa red/ stong pa'i cha nas stong pa'i mtshan nyid bshad bsdad pa'i skabs nas gsal cha 'di ma 'gags pa zhig yod pa 'di/ chu'i zla ba lta bu la dpe bzhag nas 'di 'dra'i gsal stong zung 'jug 'di mtshon byed tsam la bkod pa red ma gtogs mtshon bya kho rang ngo thog nas bshad pa yin na brjod mi thub pa red/ de lta bu brjod mi thub pa red/ brjod bya rjod byed dang bral ba yin pa red/ mnyam par bzhag na mnyam par bzhag pa'i de kho na nyid sems na mnyam par bzhag la de kho na nyid sems pas rtogs thub kyi red ma gtogs dpe 'di 'dra zhig yod red/ mtshan nyid 'di 'dra zhig yod red/ kho'i ngo bo 'di 'dra zhig yod red/ bzo blta 'di 'dra zhig yod red/ kho shar yong dus 'di 'dra byas shar yong gi red/ 'di 'dra bshad yag med pa red 'dug /'di 'dra kho bshad pa yin na/ kho smra bsam brjod med zer nas bshad thub kyi ma red pa/ 'di 'dra yin tsang smra bsam brjod med zer yag 'di kho bshad mi thub pa yin dus kho mtshon bya de lta bu rang gis nyams su myong ba'i thog nas mtshon pa ma gtogs dpe dang tha snyad dang tshig gis thog nas brjod mi thub pa red 'dug a/

rgyud bla ma nang la/ phra phyir thos pa'i yul min te// don dam yin phyir bsam bya'i min// chos nyid zab phyir 'jig rten pa'i// bsgom pa la sogs yul ma yin// gang phyir gzugs la dmus long bzhin// byis pas de sngon mthong ma myong*// btsas pa'i khyim nas bu chung gis// nyi ma'i gzugs bzhin 'phags pas kyang*// zhes sa la gnas pa'i 'phags pa yis kyang mdang gsum btsas pa'i khyim na/ bu chung gis nyi ma'i gzugs mthong ba nang bzhin zhig yin zer/ de ma gtogs chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gnas lugs gnyug ma ma bcos pa'i shes pa mthar thug pa 'di chos rab rnam 'byed kyi shes rab mthar thug pa mnga' ba 'di sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ma gtogs yod ma red/ spyir chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab 'di sa dang po la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la yang yod red de/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab mthar thug pa mnga' ba 'di thams cad mkhyen pa ma gtogs med pa yin dus thams cad mkhyen pas ma gtogs mkhyen gyi yod ma red zer lab pa red 'dug /don dag 'di 'dra yin dus gsal stong zung 'jug gnyis po 'di yin pa red/ nyams su myong ba'i tshul gyis rtogs dgos pa ma gtogs tha snyad dang tshig dang sgra rtog las 'das pa yin pa red 'dug /gsal stong zung 'jug la/ 'di yin dus zung 'jug zer ya'i rgyu mtshan 'di gsal ba'i cha nas stong pa mtshon thub pa dang*/ stong pa'i cha nas gsal ba mtshon thub pa zhig la bshad dgos kyi yod sa red/ 'di ma gtogs gsal ba zhes pa 'di mtshan nyid cig bshad/ stong pa zhes pa 'di yang sems kyi mtshan nyid cig bshad nas gsal stong gnyis yan gar ba 'dra po zhig la bsam blo btang ba yin na/ sems kyi gnas lugs mtshon thub kyis ma red/ 'di 'dra'i mtshon byed gnyis bzhag yod red de/ mtshon bya zhig gi thog nas bshad yong dus gsal stong gnyis kar 'di nyams myong gi steng nas gsal zer ba'i skabs su gsal gsal mo dang*/

stong zer ba'i stong stong mo 'dra po de 'dra ma yin pa byas/ gsal zhes pa de'ang stong pa'i yon tan zhig gi cha nas bshad yong ba red/ stong zer yag 'di yang gsal ba'i cha nas bshad yong dus kho gnyis gcig gi grogs la gcig slebs thub yag gcig /gang ltar sa dang po'i skabs su 'phags pa'i shes rab kyi chos nyid mngon sum rtogs pa'i lta ba dang*/ de'i rgyud la yod pa'i snying rje byang chub sems dang snying rje gnyis 'dra po gtso bo 'di gnyis ste mnyam du gcig gi grogs la gcig chags thub pa red ma gtogs/ 'di ni yang shes rab zer ba'i skabs su snying rje brlag 'gro yag 'dra po dang*/ snying rje zer ba'i skabs su yang shes rab brlag 'gro yag 'dra po 'di 'dra yod ma red pa/ gcig grogs gcig yong thub kyi yod red/ 'o 'di 'dra po red lab pa red/ 'di yin dus 'di 'dra'i glo bur gyi dri ma 'di glo bur gyi dri ma 'di 'dra po ga ba la yod red zer na/ sems kyi gnas lugs kyi steng la yod red/ sems kyi gnas lugs steng la yod stangs 'di ga 'dra byas nas yod red zer na/ tha mi dad pa'i tshul gyis yod pa ni ma red/ tha dad pa'i tshul gyis yod pa red/ tha dad pa ga 'dra zhig yod red zer na/ glo bur bral rung gi tshul gyis bral rung gi 'dra po zhig glo bur ba red/ glo bur ba zer ba'i skabs la ga re/ kho rkyen zhig dang gnyen po zhig 'phrad yong dus kho lam sang bral chog chog yod red/ kho ga re zer na/ sa 'dra po zhig yod ma red/ gnyen po stobs ldan slebs yong dus kho gnas thub yag cig gi nus pa med pa yin dus kho bral rung gi cha nas bsdad yod pa red/ gsal stong zung 'jug la byas/ 6 sbyong byed ngos bzung ba/ sbyong byed phyag chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ches// 'o na lam gang gis sbyong ba rnal 'byor du bshad yong dus su yis sbyang gi red/ 'di 'dra'i glo bur gyi dri ma 'di sbyang mkhan 'di sus sbyang gi red/

sus sbyang thub kyi red zer na sbyong byed phyag rgya chen po'i rdo rje'i rnal 'byor chen po 'dis sbyang thub kyi red lab pa red/ 'di la phyag chen rdo rje rnal 'byor zer yag 'di la mdo'i skabs nas skad cha bshad stangs dang*/ sngags kyi skabs nas skad cha bshad stangs gnyis so sor yong gi yod red de/ spyir btang thun mong gi dbang du bshad na/ dang po nga rang tsho skyabs 'gro nas byas nas skyabs su 'gro ba skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po skyabs gnas mthar thug tu khas len nas de las gzhan pa'i skyabs gnas med par smra ba/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i mtshan nyid yin bshad kyi yod red/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan nyid la zhugs nas gzung ste la thun mong gi sngon 'gro thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la sogs pa sngon 'gro bcu gnyis yong gi yod red/ 'di tshar nas thun mong skabs su lam sbyangs pa la zhi gnas nges par du 'gro dgos kyi yod red/ zhi gnas tshar nas de nas lhag mthong bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab bskyed nas nyams su rim pa bzhin du brten nas bla mas ngo sprod nas/ don dag snying po 'di da lta tha mal gyi shes pa 'di rang ngo mthong dgos yag cig gi gnas tshul zhig la rdo rje rnal 'byor 'di bzhag bsdad kyi yod red/ tshogs sbyor skabs la tshogs lam dang sbyor lam skabs su ni nyams gtso bo che ba yong gis yod red/ de nas mthong lam thob tshar ba'i skabs su 'di'i nyams 'di yang rtogs pa'i thog nas slebs yong ba red/ nyams 'di rtogs pa la tshur mngon 'gyur du 'pho yong ba red/ nyams zer yag 'di kho gal chen po med pa red/ brlag 'gro yag cig yin pa red 'dug /rtogs pa zer mkhan 'di la 'pho 'gyur med pa yin dus tshogs sbyor zer ba'i tshogs sbyor skabs la kho nyams gtso bo slebs yong dus yang kho phyag rgya chen po rdo rje rnal 'byor 'di yang 'di skabs la rtogs pa red bsam nas nor yag yod pa yod red 'dug
/yin na yang 'di nyams ma gtogs rtogs pa min pa red 'dug /'di yin pa'i skabs su rje btsun mi la yis/

nyams na bun dang 'dra ste yal nas 'gro// rtogs pa nam mkha' dang 'dra ba 'gyur ba med// gsungs pa red/ 'di yin dus nyams nag khung nang bzhin yin pa red/ smug pa nang bzhin red/ kho yal 'gro gi red/ rtogs pa 'di kho nam mkha' nang bzhin yin dus 'pho 'gyur med zer bshad pa red/ nyams kyi nang nas rtogs pa rnyed dgos pa red 'dug / 7 nyams dang rtogs pa gnyis la nor nyen yod pa/ de 'dra yin dus mtshams mtshams nyams rtogs nor yag nyen kha yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus tshogs sbyor skabs su nyams gtso bo byas/ mthong lam thob nas rang gi rgyud la phyag rgya chen po rdo rje rnal 'byor 'di mngon 'gyur du skye yong ba red/ de nas tsam nas mthong lam thob tshar na mnyam bzhag 'di je brtan je brtan la 'gro gi yod red/ rjes thob kyi 'khrul snang thams cad 'di yang gsal du gsal du 'gro thub kyi yod red/ spyir btang 'khrul snang yong gi yod red/ yin na yang 'khrul snang 'di gsal du 'gro gi yod sa red/ mthong lam thob tshar nas 'khrul snang 'di gsal du gsal du 'gro yag dang*/ mnyam bzhag gi ngo bo rtogs pa 'di brtan du brtan du 'gro thub yag gi yon tan 'di yong gi yod sa red/ de nas mar mar slebs tshar nas bla mas slob ma 'di rtogs pa mchog ldan du mthong na de nas thad kar tha mal gyi shes pa 'di la rang ngo sprod yong gi yod red/ tai lo pas nā ro pa la/ tai lo nga la ci yang bstan du med// rang gis rang nyid mthong na grol bar 'gyur// gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi kho thad kar bla mas ngo sprod byas yong dus sems kyi gnas lugs 'pho 'gyur dang bral ba 'di mthong yong dus/ 'o de la phyag rgya chen po rdo rje rnal 'byor zhes ming btags pa red/ 'di red ma gtogs rim pa bzhin du tshogs rnam pa gnyis bsags/ sgrib pa rnam pa gnyis sbyangs/ 'di 'dra byas nas sa lam rim pa bzhin du bgrod/

'di 'dra byed mi dgos pa red/ phyag rgya chen po gcig chod la// rmongs pas sa lam brtsi ba 'khrul// gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis phyag rgya chen po gcig chod yin pa yin dus sa lam gcig chod la sa dang po rab tu dga' ba/ gnyis pa dri ma med pa zhes brtsi bsdad pa yin na de nas 'khrul ba yin gsungs pa red/ phyag rgya chen po'i skabs su 'di med pa red/ kho dbang po mngon sum yin pa yin dus dbang po mngon sum 'di rtogs pa mchog ldan gyi gang zag la tha mal gyi shes pa 'di rang ngo mthong ba'i thog nas 'di 'dra po zhig mar rtogs pa khyad par can bskyed yong ba red/ 8 rtogs pa skye tshul mi 'dra ba bstan pa/ de yang sngags kyi skabs su yin na ni dang po rim pa gnyis la brten nas 'gro stangs shig yod red/ bskyed rim la brten nas 'gro stangs gcig /rdzogs rim la brten nas 'gro stangs gcig /rim gnyis la brten nas 'bras bu mchog thob dgos kyi yod red/ rang lugs dwags po rin po che'i lugs srol la/ dbang po rab la dbang bzhi'i rim pa de 'gro dgos kyi ma red/ thad kar bla mas ngo sprod yong dus bla mas slob ma rtogs pa mchog ldan thams cad 'di rang ngo mthong nas grol thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ sa skya pa rnams kyis lugs srol la yin na ni phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa'i ye shes 'di dbang bzhi'i rim pa las skye dgos kyi red/ dbang dang po bum dbang 'di bskur/ gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang bskur/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi nyams myong*/ de nas bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che la ngo sprod nas nyams su myong ba 'di phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa mchog ldan gyi go 'phang thob kyi yod red ma gtogs/ dbang bzhi'i rim pa la ma bsten pa la thad ka la phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa bskyed yag 'di 'dra'i khyad mtshar po 'dug byas nas gad mo shor gyi yod red/ yin na yang rang lugs la 'di 'dra dgos kyi ma red/

'di tsho rigs 'di dbang po gcig car ba'i skad cha yin pa red/ dbang po rim gyis pa'i skad cha yin na ni dang po bskyed rim la bslab de nas rdzogs rim la bslab de nas rim pa bzhin du dbang gong ma bum dbang bskur/ de nas 'di la yang ngo sprod cig sprod/ de nas yang spang bya gang yin pa 'di gcig spang*/ gnyis pa slebs pa'i skabs su gsang dbang gcig ngo sprod/ de nas shes rab ye shes gsum pa dbang bskur de nas rim pa bzhin du 'gro dgos pa'i skabs su zhe drag 'gor 'gro gi yod red/ rnal 'byor rnams la brten nas rtogs dgos yag 'di dbang po cig car ba'i skad cha red/ 'di red ma gtogs dbang po yang rab pa la 'di mi dgos pa'i skad cha yin pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus 'da' kha ye shes 'pho ba zer nas skad cha bshad nas ye shes 'pho ba'i skad cha rigs mang po bshad kyi yod red/ phyag chen skabs la 'di yin pa'i skabs la dbang bzhi yi rim pa la bskur nas dbang gsum pa'i nyams myong 'di tshig dbang la brten nas bskyed dgos red zer yag dbang po rim gyis pa'i skad cha red/ nga rang tsho'i ngo la dbang po mchog ldan gyi gang zag la rtogs pa mchog ldan gyi slob ma la bla ma thabs la mkhas pas lung mar ngo sprod yong dus khos khams dang dbang po mos pa 'di so sor bshad yong dus dbang po mchog ldan yin pa tsam la kho thad kar ngo sprod nas kho grol thub kyi yod pa red 'dug /rgyal po ind+ra bodhi nang bzhin red pa/ da lta ind+ra bodhi nang bzhin yin na/ kho lus ma bsgom pa la 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur thub pa 'byung ba red/ dpe 'di nang bzhin red gsungs pa red/ 'di yin dus phyag rgya chen po rdo rje rnal 'byor zer yag 'di kho rang kha thug la ngo 'dzin byed yag 'di ga ba byed dgos kyi yod red zer na/ gang ltar tha mal gyi shes pa 'di rang red/ 9 tha mal gyi shes pa bstan pa/ tha mal gyi shes pa zer lugs bka' brgyud pa yi thun mong ma yin pa'i tshig cig yin pa red/

tha mal zer yag 'di bcos ma zer yag tshig 'di ma red/ tha mal zer ba'i skabs la sdug po zer yag gi tshig ma red/ kho ma bcos pa zhig la tha mal zhes lab kyi yod red/ ma bcos pa'i shes pa da lta nga rang tsho'i glo bur gyi nyon mongs pa 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug la sogs pa dang*/ nga rgyal phrag dog la sogs pa ga tshod nyon mongs pa shugs chen po yod na yang kho sems la gnas lugs steng nas gang yang 'pho 'gyur btang thub kyi yod ma red/ gnas lugs 'di la kho nyon mongs pas gos thub kyi yod ma red/ sems kyi rang bzhin la nyon mongs pa'i g.ya' yis gos thub kyi yod ma red/ gser la ga tshod g.ya' yis gos na'ang gser gyi rang mdangs brlag gi ma red/ de nang bzhin gyis kho sems kyi gnas lugs 'di la nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pas ga tshod cig bsgrib na yang kho sems kyi gnas lugs 'di la nyon mongs pas gos ma thub pa/ nyon mongs pa'i skyon gyis gos ma thub pa yod pa red/ yon tan ye gdod ma nas rdzogs bsdad pa zhig dang*/ spang bya thams cad ye gdod ma nas zad bsdad pa zhig red/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba'ang cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// zhes pa'i gang ltar 'di la bsal bar bya ba'ang ci yang med zer ba'i skabs la sems kyi gnas lugs la bsal bya yi skyon ye nas ma grub pa yin pa red/ de nas yon tan 'di 'dra po zhig dgos kyi red zer nas sa lam gyi yon tan la sogs pa thams cad gsar du tshur grub yag med pa red/ sems la gnas lugs ga re yin pa 'di bla ma rtogs pa mchog ldan gyis ngo sprod yong dus ngo sprod pa 'di gzhi'i gnas lugs nga rang tsho sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la yod yod pa red/ yod pa 'di bla mas ngo sprod yong dus bla ma'i gdams ngag la brten nas ngo 'phrod yong ba red/ ngo 'phrod yong dus rang la yod pa'i chos nyid kyi gnas lugs 'di rang gis ma bu ngo shes pa nang bzhin gyi ngo shes pa 'di rang phyag rgya chen po rdo rje rnal 'byor 'di ka rang yin pa red/

yin na yang mdo yi phyag chen dang sngags kyi phyag chen skabs su lam gyis rim pa bstan stangs tog tsam khyad par yod sa red ma gtogs ngo 'dzin byed stangs gcig pa yin pa red/ 'di 'dra'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ches/ chen po'i sgra sbyar yong dus spang bya thams cad rtsad nas zad par byed pa la gnyen po stobs ldan 'di ma gtogs med pa red/ lam gyi rim pa gcig chod yin pa red/ lam gyi rim pa gcig chod ma gtogs lam gyi rim pa bzhin du 'gro mi dgos pa red/ 'di 'gro ma dgos pa yin dus kho gnyen po zhig gis spang bya dri ma mtha' dag rtsad nas zad par byed thub pa'i nus pa stobs ldan de lta bu 'di yod pa'i cha nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ches zer/ rdo rje zer yag 'di spyir btang gi mi 'gyur ba/ mi 'jig pa/ brtan pa/ sra ba/ thogs pa med pa/ pha rol po'i mthu pham par byed pa la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par mang po bshad pa 'di nang bzhin gyis 'di 'dra'i rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud la yod pa'i tha mal gyi shes pa yi rang ngo mthong na/ 'di 'dra'i rang ngo mthong ba'i tha mal gyi shes pa 'di spang bya'i dri ma mtha' dag rtsad nas zad par byed pa dang*/ mdo'i skabs su yin na lhan skyes kyi dri ma bshad kyi yod red/ kun btags kyi dri ma gnyis bshad kyi yod red pa/ lhan skyes kyi dri ma dang*/ kun btags kyi dri ma thams cad kho rtsad nas zad par byed thub pa 'di'ang cig car ba zad thub par byed pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus rtogs pa mchog ldan gyi nyams len 'di la rdo rje rnal 'byor ches zhes byed nas chen po'i sgra sbyar ba red 'dug a/ 10 sbyang bya ngos bzung ba/ 'dis ches zer nas rnam dbye gsum pa byed sgra sbyar nas bcom mkhan 'di su red/ lam gang gis sbyong ba red zer na/ lam sbyong mkhan 'di phyag rgya chen po rdo rje rnal 'byor chen po 'dis bcom gyi yod red/

zhes byed sgra sbyar song ba/ sbyang bya ga re sbyang ba red/ 'o na phyag rgya chen po rdo rje rnal 'byor chen po 'dis gang zhig sbyang bar bya ba'i dri ma 'di ngos 'dzin byed yong dus dri ma 'di glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma lab pa red/ glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma zer mkhan 'di 'dod chags zhe sdang ti mug nga rgyal phrag dog la sogs pa zer na yang 'grig gi 'dug /nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa la sogs pa sgrib pa ga ba bzhag na yang thams cad yin pa red/ gtso bo thar pa la sgrib pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa la sgrib pa gnyis bshad yod red/ 'di 'dra'i sgrib gnyis gtso bor gyur pa'i skyon gyi cha mtha' dag 'di glo bur gyi 'khrul ba'i dri ma red/ glo bur zer yag 'di gang red/ kho nam mkha' la sprin tshogs pa nang bzhin red/ kho gang ltar glo bur du skyes yong dus/ yar kho glo bur du 'byung ba red/ phar 'gro dus yang kho glo bur gyis bral yong ba red/ 'di 'dra yin dus kho la sa brtan po zhig dang kho 'di na bsdad red zer nas/ gzhi chags nas bsdad sa 'di 'dra gang yang med pa red/ spyod 'jug la gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis/ nyon mongs nyon mongs shes rab mig gis spangs// bdag yid las bsal gang du 'gro bar 'gyur// gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis nyon mongs pa zer yag 'di kho gnyen po stobs ldan bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis rtsis zin nas gnyen po bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi ngos 'dzin byas thub pa yin na/ glo bur gyi 'khrul pa'i dri ma zer yag 'di kho yod ma red/ spyir btang gi glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma zer yag 'di med pa red/ so so'i skye bo la skyon 'jug yong dus bden 'dzin la brten nas yong gi yod red/ de'ang bden 'dzin la lhan skyes dang*/ kun btags gnyis bshad kyi yod red/ 'di'i nang nas gtso che shos 'di nga rang tsho'i skyon che shos 'di lhan skyes kyi bden 'dzin yin pa red/

lhan skyes tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas byas nas rang dang lhan du 'grogs bsdad yag gi nga'o bsam pa'i ngar 'dzin gyi rtog pa 'di lhan skyes la bzhag gi yod red/ 'di 'bu grog ma nas bzung ste yod bsdad yag gi ngar 'dzin 'di la bshad bsdad kyi yod red/ kun btags zer yag 'di grub mtha' la sbyangs pa'i skyon zhig bshad bsdad kyi yod red/ spang bya las sla bo yin pa red/ lhan skyes spang tshar na kun btags rang bzhin gyis spang 'gro gi yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus 'di 'dra'i bden 'dzin gyis nga tsho la bdag tu 'dzin pa dang bden par 'dzin pa'i blo 'di skabs la glo bur 'khrul ba'i dri ma gtso bo 'di bshad kyi yod red/ 11 bden 'dzin skyon yin par grub pa/ bden 'dzin 'di yod red pas zer na/ bden par grub bsdad pa zhig yod red pas zer na/ bden par grub bsdad pa shes bya'i khams na yod ma red/ bden par grub pa yod ma red de bden par 'dzin pa yong gi yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus skyon gyi cha 'di bden 'dzin gyis bshad kyi yod red/ bden par grub pa 'di yod ma red/ bden par grub pa med yong dus bden par 'dzin pa spang thub kyi yod red/ bden 'dzin skyon yin pa grub thub kyi yod red/ gal srid shes bya'i khams la bden par grub pa zhig yod na/ bden 'dzin spang thub kyi ma red/ bden 'dzin spang thub dgos yag gi rgyu mtshan 'di gang du bden par 'dzin byed kyi gzhi 'di rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa red/ 'di zhen yul la 'khrul pa'i log shes yin pa yin dus zhen yul la 'khrul pa'i log shes 'di gnyen po stobs ldan gyis bsten yong dus kho spang thub yag yod pa zhig yin pa yin dus/ kho shes bya'i khams na ma grub pa dang shes bya'i khams na de lta bu zhig med pa'i cha nas bshad yong dus spang thub kyi yod red/ shes bya'i khams la rang bzhin gyis grub bsdad pa zhig yod na gnyen po stobs ldan gyis bsten na yang spang thub kyi yod ma red/

mdo'i skabs su bshad pa yin na/ dbu ma'i skabs la yin na ni lam gyi dgag bya gcig dang*/ rigs pa'i dgag bya gnyis bshad yod red/ phyag rgya chen po'i skabs su 'di 'dra'i skad cha med pa red/ gnyen po stobs ldan zhig la spang bya'i skyon thams cad phra rags thams cad rtsad nas zad thub pa yod red/ dbu ma'i skabs su lam gyi nyams 'dra po zhig bshad bsdad kyi yod pa yin dus kho lam gyi dgag bya zhig bshad kyi yod red/ glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma 'di sbyang stangs 'di la lam gyis dgag gi yod red/ rigs pas dgag gi yod red/ bden 'dzin 'dra po yin na ni gtso bo rigs pas dgag gi yod red/ rigs pas dang po sgrub dgos pa red/ rigs pas bsgrubs nas dang po bden 'dzin 'di tsho skyon yin pa bshad/ rigs pas bkag thub yag 'di la rigs pa'i dgag bya 'di bden grub la bzhag gi yod red/ de nas lam gyi dgag bya 'dra po yin na ni gtso bo 'di/ rgyud bla ma'i nang yin na/ 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang*// de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod//

ser sna la sogs rnam rtog gang*// de ni nyon mongs sgrib par 'dod// zer nas gtso bo nyon sgrib 'di sgrib pa gnyis gtso bo 'di lam gyi sgrib pa lam gyi dgag bya bshad kyi yod red/ lam la brten na dgag thub kyi yod pa red/ nyon mongs pa kun rdzob tu yod pa red/ bden grub kun rdzob tu yang yod ma red/ 'di yin pa'i cha nas rigs pa'i dgag bya 'di kun rdzob tu med pa'i bden grub bkag bsdad kyi yod red/ nyon mongs pa kun rdzob tu yod red/ 'di yin pa'i cha nas lam gyi dgag bya lam la brten nas spang thub kyis yod pa red/ 'o 'di 'dra yin dus dgag bya gnyis po 'di re re byas bshad kyi yod sa red/ yang phyag rgya chen po skabs su 'di'i skad cha gang yang yod ma red/ yin na yang lam 'di'i skabs la glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma zhes bshad yod dus kho ngos 'dzin byed stangs 'di 'dra zhig yod red zer nas bshad na/ yang stabs bde bo 'dra po zhig ma gtogs yang phyag chen skabs la skad cha bshad stangs dang dbu ma'i skabs nas skad cha bshad stangs gnyis 'di gnyis kyang dper na/ 'gal zla chen po 'dra po zhig yin na yang de 'dra yang ma 'grig pa red/ 'di 'dra'i dri ma sbyangs nas 'di 'dra'i dri ma ngos 'dzin nas 'khrul pa'i dri ma spang thub kyi yod red/ spang thub dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang red zer na/ dri ma rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa yin pa red/ dri ma rang bzhin gyis ma grub nas spangs thub kyis yod red ma gtogs dri ma rang bzhin gyis grub na spang thub kyi ma red/ 'di 'dra yin dus rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i chos shes bya'i khams na med/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i chos shes bya'i khams na med na yang rang bzhin gyis grub pa med pa rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ma shes na spang thub kyi yod ma red/ rang bzhin ma grub par shes pa'i cha nas rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i chos 'di spang thub kyi yod pa yin dus 'di'i skabs la glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma zer dgos yag rgyu mtshan 'di yin pa red/

dri ma zad rung gi cha nas bshad kyi yod red/ 'khrul pa zer dgos yag 'di yang ma rig pa'i sgrib pa yin pa red/ 'di'i nang nas gtso bo rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi dang po ma rig pa bshad dgos kyi yod red/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa/ nyon mongs can gyi ma rig pa dang nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i ma rig pa gnyis bshad pa'i nang nas nyon mongs pa can gyi ma rig pa bshad yong dus 'khrul pa gtso bo 'di da lta rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi dang po ma rig pa sbyar gyi yod pa 'di yin pa red/ 12 sbyangs 'bras ngos bzung ba/ dri ma rnams sbyangs pa la brten nas sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu yod red pas zer na/ sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu yod red/ sbyangs pa las thob pa'i 'bras bu 'di ma 'ongs pa la ngo bo stong pa chos sku/ rang bzhin gsal ba longs sku/ 'gag med du shar ba sprul sku 'di sku gsum nas 'bras bu'i thob thub kyi red ces lab pa red/ sbyangs pa dang 'bras bu 'di nas rang stong gi cha nas bshad na chos sku bshad yod red/ gzhan stong gi cha nas bshad na gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis bshad yong dus sku gsum yang 'di 'dra sbyar nas bshad na yang 'grig gi yod red/ dri ma dang bral ba chos sku dri ma mtha' dag dang bral ba'i dri ma de yang ye nas zad pa dri ma thams cad ye nas zad pa yin na yang 'di ngo ma shes pa red/ lam la brten nas sbyang yong dus dri ma glo bur ba zad yong ba red/ 'di skabs la glo bur bral dag ces lab pa red/ rang bzhin rnam dag dang glo bur dri dag gnyis bshad kyi yod red/ rang bzhin rnam dag zer yag 'di sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la yod yod pa red/ 'di yang chos nyid 'di chos can gyi tshul gyi rnam par yod pa red/ chos nyid kyi tshul gyis chos nyid 'di sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la yod red de chos nyid de nyid ngo shes kyi yod ma red/ ngo ma shes yong dus chos nyid 'di ga 'dra zhig yod red ces bshad yong dus sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la yod stangs 'di chos can gyi tshul du yod red ces lab pa red/

chos can gyi tshul du yod pa yin dus lam sbyangs yong dus chos nyid mngon du 'gyur nas rtogs yong ba red 'dug a/ 'o 'di yin dus rang bzhin rnam dag zer yag 'di skyon gyi cha nas bshad yong dus rang bzhin rnam dag ces bshad pa red/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po zer gyi red/ rigs kyang zer gyi red/ khams kyang zer gyi red/ 'di mngon du 'gyur yong dus 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur yong dus 'di la glo bur dri dag ces lab pa red/ 13 chos sku bstan pa/ chos sku mngon 'gyur shog ces chos sku zer yag 'di'i chos sku gsum gyi nang nas gtso bo spang bya thams cad zad pa'i bral cha nas bshad yong dus gtso bo bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mthar thug gi 'bras bu chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab/ mthar thug pa'i ye shes gang la mnga' ba'i chos sku/ skyon thams cad zad pa yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa 'di bshad pa red/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i nang la/ shes bya'i bud shing skam po ma lus pa// bsregs pas zhi de rgyal rnams chos sku ste// de tshe skye ba med cing 'gags pa med// sems 'gags pa de sku yis mngon sum mdzad// ces gtso bo sems 'gag pa la bzhag yod red/ 'jug pa nang la 'di bzhag yong dus sems 'gag pa zer yag 'di sems 'di yang ma dag pa'i sems la gtso bo sbyar ba red/ phyag chen skabs la yin na ni/ de khas len gyi yod ma red/ dag pa'i sems dang ma dag pa'i sems gnyis chags dgos kyi red zer/ sems 'gags zer yag 'di gtso bo sems 'di ga ba la go gi yod red zer/ rnam par rtog pa la go ba yin na/ rnam rtog la yang go ba gnyis yod red/ dbu ma bzhi brgya pa'i dgongs pa gtso bo byed pa na/ rnam par rtog pa zer nas tshig yod nas bzung ste la rnam rtog cha tshang la go rgyu yod ma red/ gang red zer na/ zhen yul la 'khrul pa'i log shes 'di gtso bo go dgos kyi red/

bden par zhen pa'i blo bden zhen gyi blo gcig dang*/ bdag tu zhen pa'i blo gcig 'di rnam rtog la bzhag pa red ma gtogs rnam rtog yin tshad tshang ma la go rgyu yod ma red/ ces 'di 'dra bkag bzhag pa yin na ni rnam rtog rtsa nas med na dpe bsags 'gro gi red pa/ 'di 'dra yin dus kun rdzob tu rnam rtog yod red/ kun rdzob tu rnam rtog yod nas 'khor ba la skyon du lta dgos yag gi rnam rtog dgos kyi yod red/ myang 'das la yon tan du lta ya'i rnam rtog dgos kyi yod red/ 'di yin dus 'khor ba la skyon du lta yong dus 'di la brten nas gnyen po bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab la bsten dgos kyi 'dug bsam pa'i rnam rtog dgos kyi yod red/ 'di 'dra bshad yong dus kho go ba len stangs khag khag yod red/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i nang la sems 'gag pa de chos sku zhes bshad yong dus sems 'di gtso bo ga ba bshad pa red zer na/ sems 'di rnam rtog la sbyar nas bshad kyi yod red/ rnam rtog 'di ga ba ngos 'dzin byed dgos red zer na/ bden zhen gyi rtog pa mtha' dag zad pas rtog pa mthar thug cig bshad bsdad kyi 'dug a/ yin na yang phyag chen skabs la 'di 'dra'i skad cha med pa red/ phyag chen skabs su sems la dag ma dag gnyis phye ba'i skad cha zhig bshad nas ma dag pa'i sems 'di gang ltar dbu ma 'jug pa'i skabs nas skad cha 'dod mkhan 'di ka rang red/ ces dag pa'i sems 'di yang 'di 'dra byas nas spyir btang chos sku 'di'i skabs la chos sku zer mkhan 'di ma dag pa'i sems bkag pa'i mjug la dag pa'i sems zer yag gcig tshur sgrub dgos kyi red ma gtogs stong nyid ci yang med pa zhig la bzhag na 'grig gi ma red/ med dgag gi cha nas bzhag na'ang 'grig gi ma red/ 'di yin pa'i skabs la dag pa'i sems zer yag zhig kyang sangs rgyas khams su sku dang ye shes don dam bden pa ye nas rang chas su yod bsdad ya'i gnas lugs shig la go dgos kyi red ces byas nas chos sku gsal cha nas tshur grub yong ba red/

'di yin dus 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ phyag rgya chen po dgag phyogs nas bstan gyi yod red/ sa ra hā yis sgrub phyogs nas ngo bo bstan pa red/ 'di yin dus dag pa'i sems dang ma dag pa'i sems gnyis cha bzhag na khyad par med pa red/ 'di la chos sku mngon 'gyur shog zer yag 'o 'di 'dra byas/ sbyang gzhi/ sbyang bya/ sbyong byed/ sbyangs 'bras zhes bzhi bshad/ 'di'i mjug la lta sgom spyod gsum bshad kyi yod red/ nya sgom don lag tu lon pa'i smon lam mdor bstan pa/ gzhi la sgro 'dogs chod pa lta ba'i gdengs// de la ma yengs skyong ba sgom pa'i gnad// sgom don kun la rtsal sbyong spyod pa'i mchog / lta sgom spyod pa'i gdengs dang ldan par shog / ces lta ba sgom pa spyod pa 'bras bu bzhi bshad nas 'di'i nang nas gtso bo lta sgom spyod gsum bshad kyi yod red 'di nang la/ 1 lta ba bshad pa/ dang po gzhi la zhes lab pa red/ gzhi la sgro 'dogs chod pa'i lta ba'i gdengs// zhes lta ba bzhin du spyir lta ba zer yag gang red zer na/ lta ba rnam dag 'di gang 'dra zhig dgos kyi yod red zer na/ lta ba rnam dag 'di thar pa thob par byed pa la lam ma nor ba byed pa zhig /gtso bo lta ba yin pa red/ mthong tshul ma nor ba zhig dgos kyi yod red/ lta ba zer yag 'di nges shes shig la go dgos/ gtso bo lta ba zer yag 'di nges shes shig red/ 'di 'dra'i nges shes yang dag pa 'di ga ba la thag chod dgos kyi red zer na/ sbyor lam chos mchog chen po'i skabs su thag chod dgos kyi yod red/ sbyor lam chos mchog chen po'i skabs la thag chod nas thag chod pa'i don dag 'di sa dang po la mngon du 'gyur ba yin pa red/ 'di skabs la nyon mongs pa spang thub kyi yod red/ 'di yin dus gzhi la sgro 'dogs ga re chod dgos red/ gzhi zer ba 'di'i skabs la gzhi 'di gnas lugs la go ba red/ gnas lugs la sgro 'dogs chod dgos pa ma gtogs 'di'i gzhi 'di da lta nga tsho so so skye bo'i gnas skabs kyi gzhi zer yag skad cha ma yin pa byas/

gzhi zer ba 'di gnas lugs la go rgyu yin pa red/ gzhi gnas lugs la don dam pa'i bden pa la sgro 'dogs chod dgos red/ sgro 'dogs zer na/ the tshom 'dra po zer dgos kyi red/ sgro 'dogs zer na/ yin min gyi ldog pa zhig la sgro 'dogs zer gyi yod red/ med pa la yod par sgro 'dogs pa red/ sgro 'dogs zer yag 'di/ yod pa zhig la med red zer na skur ba btab pa red/ med pa zhig la yod red ces lab na sgro 'dogs pa red/ gzhi la sgro 'dogs ga re chod dgos red zer na/ gzhi'i gnas lugs don dam pa'i bden pa la yon tan gyi cha nas bshad na yang red/ ngo bo'i cha nas bshad na yang red/ rnam grangs kyi cha nas bshad na yang red/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i thog nas bsam blo btang na'ang red/ ga ba bsam blo btang na'ang gzhi'i gnas lugs 'di la nges shes dgos pa red/ theg pa thun mong skabs nas bshad pa yin na yang*/ dper na/ nyan thos 'dra po cha bzhag pa yin na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bden bzhi'i blang dor gsungs pa red/ sdug bsngal shes par bya ba dang*/ kun 'byung spang bar bya ba dang*/ 'gog pa thob par bya ba dang*/ lam bsten par bya ba gsungs pa red/ 'di 'dra po 'di yang nyan thos pa'i lugs la gzhi la sgro 'dogs chod pa'i lta ba zhig red/ 'di mngon du 'gyur na 'bras bu 'gog pa'i bden pa thob kyi yod red/ 'di 'dra po la nyan thos pa'i gzhi la sgro 'dogs chod pa'i lta ba red/ theg chen gyi skabs su yin na ni dbu sems gnyis kyi skabs la yin na yang spyir btang dngos gnas drang gnas 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'di bdag 'dzin yin pa dang*/ bden par grub pa yin pa dang*/ de spangs pa'i cha nas mthar thug la 'bras bu sku gsum mngon du byed rgyu yod pa 'di thag chod na/ sems kyi steng la nges shes rnyed na/ 'di la yang dag pa'i lta ba zhig la theg pa chen po'i sgro 'dogs chod pa'i lta ba red/

da lta phyag rgya chen po'i skabs la/ gzhi la sgro 'dogs chod pa'i lta ba 'di sems kyi gnas lugs thad ka la bsam blo btang dgos red/ sems kyi gnas lugs 'di phyag rgya chen po'i skabs su/ tshig 'di la gzhi skye ba med pa/ gdangs 'gags pa med pa/ rtsal sna tshogs su 'phro ba zer nas gzhi gdangs rtsal gsum bshad kyi yod red/ gzhi skye ba med pa 'di dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i dgongs pa dang gcig pa yin pa red/ gzhi la skye ba med pa/ gdangs 'gag pa med pa 'di/ gzhi la skye ba med na yang de'i steng nas phrin las kyi 'jug pa nyi shu rtsa bdun la sogs pa dang*/ de ga nang bzhin gyi bral smin gyi yon tan drug cu re bzhi la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad skye rung gi cha nas bshad kyi yod red/ de nas rtsal sna tshogs su 'phro yong dus de'i thog nas ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar la longs sku dang sprul sku gnyis kyi dang*/ dag dang ma dag gi sems can gnyis kyi snang ba la mdzad pa phrin las rgyun mi chad pa/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis gtso bo gyur pa'i sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku yi mdzad pa rgyun mi chad pa skyong thub kyi yod red/ rtsal sna tshogs su 'phro ba zhes bshad kyi yod red/ thun mong gi 'di 'dra'i zhes bshad yong dus 'di skabs su sgro 'dogs chod zer yag 'di thag chod pa'i skad cha gcig yin pa yin dus thag chod yag 'di ga ba chod dgos kyi red zer na/ lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs dgos kyi yod red/ rdzogs yag 'di sbyor lam chos mchog chen po yin pa red/ des thag chod yag 'di yang*/ rten 'brel bslu ba med pa dang*/ stong pa khas len bral ba gnyis so so la zhen song ba ma yin pa/ ngo bo gcig la tha dad med pa rtogs thub pa zhig dgos kyi yod pa red 'dug a/ 'di yin dus sgro 'dogs chod yong dus spang bya'i skyon gyi cha thams cad zad tshar na yang 'di'i nang la gsal stong dbyer med kyi rang bzhin yon tan 'di yod pa zhig ngos 'dzin byed dgos kyi yod sa red pa/

'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang*/ stong pa nyid ni ston pa'i mdo// rgyal bas ji snyed gsungs pa 'di// de dag kun gyis nyon mongs bzlog / khams 'di nyams par byed ma yin// zhes gsungs pa red/ 'di zer ba'i skabs la bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad stong nyid du gsungs pa red/ stong nyid du gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gang red zer na/ stong pa nyid du ston pa'i mdo 'di rgyal bas ji snyed gsungs pa 'di gtso bo 'di ga re gsungs pa red zer na/ nyon mongs bzlog yag gi ched du gsungs pa red/ stong pa nyid zer yag 'di ma gtogs 'di la zhen/ zhen pa'i cha nas zhen dgos yag cig dang 'di mthar thug yin pa'i cha dang*/ 'di dngos gnas drang gnas kyi gnas lugs kho rang mthar thug yin pa'i cha nas gsungs pa red 'dug /stong nyid zer yag 'di ga re red zer na/ stong pa nyid zer yag 'di gnyen po'i thog nas gsungs pa red/ gnyen po 'di ga re red zer na/ stong pa nyid 'dis gnyen po 'dis nyon mongs pa spang yag ched du gsungs pa red/ sgrib gnyis spang pa'i ched du bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa red 'dug /'di red ma gtogs/

khams ni nyams par byed ma yin// gsungs pa red/ nyon mongs thams cad zad pa'i zad cha la mthar thug de la gsal stong gnyis med kyi rang bzhin gyi gnas lugs 'di ma bcos pa'i shes pa'am tha mal gyi shes pa 'di nyams par byed kyi ma red gsungs pa red 'dug /'di chos dbyings bstod pa'i nang la yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus/ khams 'di nyams par byed ma yin// gsungs pa red/ 'di yin dus sgro 'dogs chod zer yag 'di 'dra zhig la sgro 'dogs chod dgos red 'dug a/ kho phyag chen ltar rigs pas sgro 'dogs chod pa red/ dbu ma'i skabs su yang skad cha khag khag yin pa red/ kho lta ba zer yag 'di nges shes shig dgos kyi yod red/ nges shes 'dis thag chod dgos pa zhig dgos kyi yod red/ rje rin po ches gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi/ lam gtso rnam gsum skabs la/ snang ba rten 'byung bslu ba med pa dang*// stong pa khas len bral ba'i go ba gnyis// ji srid so sor snang ba de srid du// da dung thub pa'i dgongs pa rtogs pa med// zhes snang ba rten nas 'byung ba'i bslu ba med pa rten 'brel gyi chos dang*/ de'i steng la khas len med pa'i stong nyid kyi lta ba gnyis po 'di/ snang zer ba'i skabs su stong pa 'di brlag /stong pa zer ba'i skabs su snang ba brlag song ba yin na/ des da dung yang thub pa'i dgongs pa rtogs ma thub pa red gsungs pa red/ nam zhig res 'jog med par cig car du// rten 'brel mi bslur mthong ba tsam nyid las// nges shes yul gyi 'dzin stangs kun zhig na// de tshe lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs pa lags// zhes gsungs pa red/ 'di zer ba'i skabs su kho nyi ma gcig la nam zhig na yang res 'jog med pa/ snang zer ba'i skabs su stong pa lhag ma song ba/ stong pa zer ba'i skabs la snang ba brlag ma song ba/ snang stong gnyis gcig la gcig grogs su 'char ba shes nas/ 'di gnyis gcig grogs su slebs thub pa yin na/

chos thams cad rten 'brel tsam zhig gi snang ba gcig dang red pa/ ma gtogs don la nges shes la 'di red 'di ma red bsam pa'i 'dzin stangs gang yang med pa mar 'dzin stangs thams cad gzhig pa zhig slebs song na/ 'di'i skabs la lta ba'i dpyad pa 'di rdzogs pa yin gsungs pa red/ de lta bu'i dpyad pa rdzogs zer na'ang ma zer na'ang sgro 'dogs chod zer ba'i don dag snying po 'di sgro 'dogs chod yag 'di kho sa dang po'i skabs tshogs sbyor chen po'i skabs su nas sgro 'dogs chod 'gro ba yin pa red/ 'di 'dra yin pa'i skabs la yang kho rtsa ba gzhi 'di la bzhag dgos kyi red/ 'di'i steng nas thun mong ma yin pa'i rtogs pa mchog ldan gyi nyams kyi skad cha bshad yong dus/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tha mal gyi shes pa ma bcos pa'i rang ngo la gang yod pa 'di ma sgrib pa gsal por mthong thub pa zhig yod na/ 'di sgro 'dogs chod pa'i lta ba'i gdengs/ zhes lta ba 'di la bzhag pa red/ rje btsun mi las/ lta ba 'di stong pa'i ye shes la bzhag yod red/ lta ba stong pa'i ye shes 'di 'o 'di 'dra byed nas/ 2 sgom pa bshad pa/ de la ma yengs skyong ba sgom pa'i gnad// da 'di 'dra'i lta ba 'di la ma yengs bar skyong ba dgos ba red 'dug /da phyag chen skabs su g.yeng ba med pa 'di sgom gyi dngos gzhi la gsungs pa red/ g.yeng ba med pa 'di sgom gyi dngos gzhi yin pa red/ dngos gzhi ga re red/ sgom yag red/ sgom zer na yang sgom dgos kyi yod red/ de nas sgom song na/ sgom pa 'di gcig pa red/ mnyam par 'jog dgos pa red/ sgom ga re red/ mnyam par 'jog dgos ba red/ ma g.yeng bar skyong dgos ba red/ 'di la 'bogs 'don dgos ba red/ btsan sa zin dgos pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus 'di 'dra'i lta ba 'di la ma yengs bar lta ba 'di la g.yeng shor song na/ lta ba 'di skyon can chags 'gro yag gi nyen kha yod pa red/

lta ba 'di la ma g.yeng ba'i ched du lta ba'i steng la rgyab skyor byed mkhan 'dra po ma song na'ang sgom dgos pa red 'dug a/ mnyam par bzhag pa de'ang sems ma yengs pa/ ma yengs pa 'di yang skyong thub pa zhig dgos pa red 'dug /ji srid mngon par rdzogs pa sangs ma rgyas kyi bar la 'di 'dra'i rtogs pa 'di skyong thub dgos pa red 'dug /'di byung na sgom pa'i gnad red song ba red/ mnyam par 'jog pa'i gnas 'dra po zhig red/ 3 spyod pa bshad pa/ spyod pa 'di 'dra'i sgom yag po chags song na/ 'di 'dra'i steng la btsan sa zin song na sgom don kun la rtsal sbyong*/ zhes 'bogs thon nas rtogs pa mchog tu 'gro gi yod red/ rtse gcig spros bral ro gcig sgom med nas 'gro ba 'di yod red pa/ rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyi thog nas 'gro yong dus rtse gcig chung 'bring che gsum nas byed nas/ sgom gang red/ sgom med chos sku'i rgyal sa'i bar du 'di 'dra byed nas ya rim pa bzhin du rtogs pa 'di 'bogs 'don thub kyi yod red/ 'di la rtsal sbyong ba zer gyi red/ rnal 'byor pa'i lam la rtsal sbyong yong dus rtogs pa 'bogs 'don chags yong ba red 'dug /spros pa'i mchog phyag rgya chen po'i gzhi la sgro 'dogs chod pa'i lta ba dang*/ 'di la ma g.yeng ba byed nas rtse gcig tu sgom thub pa 'di sgom pa'i gnad dang*/ 'di yar 'bogs 'don nas rnal 'byor rim pa bzhin du rtogs pa 'bogs 'don byed thub na/ de nas rtsal sbyong thub na 'di spyod pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ba 'di lta sgom spyod pa'i gdengs dang ldan par shog /ces da gdengs zer yag 'di gang red/ so so la nges shes dgos ba red 'dug a/ gdengs zer yag 'di spobs pa dang nges shes la mtshon par byed thub pa zhig la gdengs zhes lab pa red/ gdengs dang ldan par shog / da lta ba shes dgos red/ da lta ba yang mar 'grel rkang ched du re re bzhin du ma sbyar na/

yang kho gsal po byas nas sbyong ma thub pa red/ 'o na khyod kyis mgo la lta sgom spyod gsum bshad yong ba'i lta ba 'di yang bskyar gsal du gtong dang zhes lab pa red/ 'di gsal du btang ba'i skabs su/ ta lta bas sgro 'dogs gcod pa/ chos rnams thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul te// sems ni sems med sems kyi ngo bos stong*// stong zhing ma 'gags cir yang snang ba ste// legs par brtag nas gzhi rtsa chod par shog / 1 snang ba thams cad sems su grub pa/ zhes chos rnams thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul te zhes pa 'di yang*/ rje btsun mi la ras pas/ bla ma mar pas dang po snang ba thams cad sems su ngo sprod/ sems stong pa la ngo sprod/ stong pa lhun grub la ngo sprod/ lhun grub rang grol du ngo sprod pa red/ ces gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis 'di'i skabs la yang*/ phyag chen gyi 'gro stangs gcig pa yin pa red/ dang po snang ba thams cad sems su ma grub na/ sems rang bzhin med pa grub thub kyi ma red/ zhes mdo sde rgyan gyi nang la/ sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas// de nas sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs// blo dang ldan pas gnyis po med rig nas// de mi ldan pa chos kyi dbyings la gnas// zhes sems las gzhan med pa grub dgos pa red/ snang ba thams cad sems su grub pa la snang ba thams cad sems kyi steng la thag bcad dgos pa red/ gang ltar thag bcad dgos kyi yod red/ snang ba thams cad sems yin pa la nges shes drangs dgos pa red/ snang ba thams cad sems su grub stangs la sems tsam pa'i lta ba bsten na yang 'grig gi yod red/ 'di khyad par med pa red/ sems tsam rnam bden pa dang*/ rnam rdzun pa yi lta ba yongs rdzogs la slob sbyong byas na/ snang ba thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin pa thag chod thub kyi yod red/ da lta'i snang ba 'di thams cad kho sems kyi rang rtsal 'dra po zhig gi thog nas ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod red/

phyag chen skabs la rba rlabs 'di rgya mtsho las 'byung ba red/ thim yang rgya mtsho la phar thim gyi red ma gtogs rba rlabs las rgya mtsho so so yod ma red/ 'di nang bzhin gyis da lta'i chos thams cad kyang rtsa ba 'di ga nas byung ba red zer na/ sems nyid rang rtsal du ngo ma shes nas rang snang la yul du zhen/ rang rig la bdag tu zhen song ba red/ sems kho rang la yul du zhen/ sems kho rang la yang bdag tu zhen/ sems kho rang bdag dang yul du zhen nas 'khrul yong ba yin pa yin dus der brten nas yong gi yod pa red/ 'di yin pa'i skabs la sems kyi rang rtsal 'di sems kyi rang rtsal du shar ba'am sems kyi rang rtsal du snang ba'i 'khor 'das kyi cho 'phrul 'di sems kyi rang rtsal yin pa ngo shes na/ thag chod tshar ba red/ gang ltar sems 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad 'di sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin pa thag chod pa red/ 2 'khor bar 'khor tshul bstan pa/ sems nyid kyi rang rtsal 'di 'khor 'das kyi cho 'phrul 'di thams cad sems nyid kyi rang rtsal ma yin pa sems las logs su gyur pa zhig 'dug bsam nas/ sems las tha dad pa rgyang chad du snang yong dus 'khor ba dang po 'di nas 'go btsugs pa yin zer ba red/ ga dus nas 'go btsugs pa red zer yag med pa red/ dus la yang 'dzin na skyon slebs yong gi yod red/ 'di 'dra byas nas 'khrul song ba red zer yag med pa red/ phyag chen skabs la spyir btang gi nang pa'i skabs la yod ma red/ dus la thog ma yod ma red/ dus la thog ma med dus sems can thams cad ga dus 'khrul ba red zer na/ ga dus 'khrul zer na'ang 'di skyon red/ 'di 'dra yin dus sems nyid rang gsal kho rang ga dus ngo ma shes na/ de dus 'khrul pa red/ sems nyid rang gsal de ngo ma shes nas ye gdod ma nas 'khrul 'khrul ba red/ sems nyid rang ngo shes na/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod nang la gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis/

skad cig gcig gis bye brag phye// skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas// zer yag 'di red/ gang ltar phar bltas na 'khor ba red/ tshur bltas na myang 'das red/ 'di gnyis kyi bar du kho skad cig gcig gis bye brag phye thub pa red/ sems kyi rang gsal ngo shes na/ 'di yin dus chos rnams thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul zhes bshad yong dus rnam 'phrul zer yag 'di gang red/ sems kyi rang rtsal sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pa red/ rba rlabs 'di rgya mtsho'i cho 'phrul yin pa nang bzhin gyis sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pa red/ bag chags sam bag chags rnam pa sna tshogs bsags pa'i cho 'phrul la brten nas 'byung ba de'ang kun gzhi rnam shes kyi steng la sems tsam pa yis de ma thag pa'i yid dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i yid ces byed nas khas gnyis len gyi yod red/ de ma thag pa'i yid zer yag 'di kun gzhi'i steng la nyon mongs pa'i rnam par shes pa tshogs drug ste yul la phar 'jug /de las tshur ldog nas 'jug ldog gi bya ba byed bcug mkhan 'di de ma thag pa'i yid yong gi yod red/ nyon mongs pa'i yid zer yag 'di kun gzhi rnam shes kyi steng la de ma thag pa'i yid 'di'i bya ba byed yong dus nyon mongs pa'i yid 'di yar dkrugs byas nas chags sdang gi rnam rtog 'di yong gi yod red/ chags sdang gi rnam rtog 'di la nyon mongs pa'i yid dang*/ chags sdang gi rnam rtog la brten nas las bsags pa 'di de ma thag pa'i yid bzhag nas 'di gnyis kyi bag chags 'di kun gzhi'i steng la bzhag na/ bdag po brgyab nas bag chags rnam pa sna tshogs bsags pa'i stobs kyis nyer len la brten nas kun gzhi'i steng nas bag chags gzhan dbang gi rnam shes 'di tsho 'byung ba yin zer ba red/ 3 'khrul gzhi gzhan dbang bstan pa/ 'khrul gzhi gzhan dbang bshad kyi yod red/ 'khrul gzhi gzhan dbang thams cad 'byung ba yin zhes bshad pa red/

lam gyi skabs su sgrub stangs shig byed na 'grig gi red/ mthar thug sgrub stangs shig byas na yang 'grig gi yod sa ma red/ sems kyi rnam 'phrul sgrub stangs 'di khag khag red/ 'di 'dra yin dus chos rnams thams cad sems kyi rnam 'khrul te// zhes chos thams cad 'di sems kyi rnam 'phrul red ma gtogs sems las logs su 'gyur ba yod ma red/ ces thag 'di yi sgang la chod pa byas/ 'di gsal tshul gang red/ da lta'i snang ba 'khor 'das kyi sems kyi cho 'phrul gyi snang ba 'di thams cad sems kho rang gi rang rtsal red/ ces lab pa red/ sge'u khung la shel rdog rdog bzhag na nyi ma shar yong dus 'di'i kha dog rnam pa sna tshogs khang pa'i nang la shar yong ba red/ 'di nang bzhin gyi 'di'i kha dog phyi la yod ma red/ nang la'ang yod ma red/ ga ba yang yod ma red/ kho rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa tsam la brten nas shar yong ba red ma gtogs 'di'i nyi ma ma shar ba'i skabs la 'di'i kha dog ga ba 'dug /'ja' 'di ga ba 'dug zer nas btsal gyi yin na rnyed kyi med pa/ yin na yang kho shel dang gcig /khang pa dang gnyis/ nyi ma'i 'od dang gsum mnyam du 'dzoms yong dus de'i rkyen la brten nas kha dog 'ja' tshon mang po mthong thub kyi yod red/ 'di nang bzhin gyi kho de ma thag pa'i yid 'di kun gzhi rnam shes kyi steng na nyon mongs pa'i yid 'dis yar dkrugs yong dus de'i bag chags bsags pa'i nyer len la brten nas dag pa'i gzhan dbang dang*/ ma dag pa'i gzhan dbang thams cad mthong thub kyi yod ces bshad kyi yod red/ dag pa'i gzhan dbang zer mkhan 'di khas len mi len yang gnyis yong gi yod red/ ma dag pa'i gzhan dbang gtso bo bshad dgos kyi yod red/ chos rnams thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul te// da 'o na 'grig gi 'dug 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul red 'dug /sems kyi cho 'phrul lam sems kyi bag chags kyis stobs kyis snang ba ma gtogs phyi la yod ma red/

phyi la yod red bsam nas 'dzin bsdad yag 'di 'khrul pa red bzhag /da ngas ha go song 'grig gi 'dug /phyi rol gyi snang ba thams cad bden par grub pa yod ma red/ bag chags a 'thas su shor nas gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa la 'dod yon longs su spyod yag 'di 'byung ba red bzhag /da 'di dngos nas bden par med pa bden pa red bzhag / 4 sems tsam pas bden grub 'dod pa nor ba/ sems 'o na bden par grub pa ma red pas zer lab na zhes lab pa red/ snang ba thams cad sems su grub tshar song*/ snang ba thams cad sems su bsgrubs zin nas sems bden par sgrub pa skyon slebs yong gi yod red/ 'o na sems bden par grub pa red 'dug a zhes sems tsam pas sems bden par grub pa khas len gyi yod red/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo sde sa bcu pa'i nang la/ khams gsum po 'di ni sems tsam mo// zhes byed nas sems tsam pa'i grub mtha' 'di yong gi yod pa yin dus 'di yang kho rang tshos go ba log nas 'byung ba red/ khams gsum po 'di ni sems tsam mo zhes pa 'di yang khams gsum gyi sems tsam 'di bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'o khams gsum gyi byed pa po 'di sems red 'dug bsam nas byed pa po sems yin pa sgrub yong ba red 'dug /sems tsam pa'i go ba la bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa 'di ma red/ khams gsum po 'di ni sems tsam mo zhes khams drug gi snang ba'i gzhi 'di snang gzhi sems tsam gyis snang gi yod red ma gtogs/ 'di las gzhan pa'i 'jig rten bkod pa po lha dang dbang phyug tshangs pa la sogs pa med par bkag pa'i don dag la snang gzhi sems tsam zhig yin gsungs pa red ma gtogs sems nyid kyis bzo ba yin zer nas byed pa po sems yin pa sgrub kyi yod ma red/

yin na yang sems tsam pa'i go ba len yong dus go ba nor nas byed pa po sems red bzhag /lha dang dbang phyug la sogs pa 'di red mi 'dug /da byed pa po sems red 'dug bsam nas sems 'di byed po la khas len pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus skyon 'di 'byung ba yin dus sems 'di bden par grub pa khas blangs nas snang gzhi sems tsam zhig bden par grub pa med na ri bong gi rwa nang bzhin ci med cang med snal ma med pa'i snam bu nang bzhin chags kyi red/ skyon chen po yong sa red/ snang srid sems tsam bden pa grub pa yin sa red bsam byas nas 'khrul yong dus dbu ma pa thams cad kyis dgag pa rgyab yong ba red/ sems bden par grub pa khas len yag 'di bden par grub pa'i tshad cig bzhag dgos kyi red/ bden par grub zer yag 'di las sla po yod ma red/ bden par grub stangs shig dgos kyi red/ bden par grub pa'i tshad cig dgos kyi red/ bden par grub tshul zhig gis bshad dgos kyi yod red/ ces bshad yong dus bden par grub pa'i tshad 'di bzhag ma thub pa byung ba red/ khong tshos gal srid gcig bzhag na yang lung rigs dang ma mthun pa byung ba red/ phyin ci log pa'i lta ba chags yong ba red/ phyin ci log pas sgrub stangs yin dus btsan sa nas ma bzung na/ kho phar 'gag song na sra bo byas bzung ma thub yin dus nang pa'i dngos gnas kyi nang la 'jug yong ba red/ 'di yin dus rang lugs 'di'i skabs la ga re sgrub kyi ma red zer na/ sems ni zer ba'i skabs su/ la las kyi bka' dang po bden bzhi chos 'khor gyi skabs la grub kyi 'dug /sems med zer ba'i skabs la bka' bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor grub/ sems kyis stong zer dus bka' tha ma legs par rnam 'byed kyi chos 'khor bskor nas 'grel pa rgyab mkhan zhig yod red/ 'di 'dra bshad yong dus sems ni zer ba'i skabs la bka' dang po'i skabs la bcom ldan 'das kyis sems yod par gsungs pa red/

phung po yod par gsungs pa red/ khams yod par gsungs pa red/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ phung po lnga ni khur ro// khur 'khur ba po ni gang zag go/ zhes byas nas gtso bo yod par bsgrub kyi yod red/ bka' bar pa'i skabs la sems med zhes byas nas med pa zer gyi yod red/ 5 thal rang gnyis kyis rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i go ba len tshul/ 'di la yang dbu ma rang rgyud pas go ba len stangs shig dang*/ dbu ma thal 'gyur pas go ba len stangs gnyis yod red/ spyir btang 'di la dbu ma rang rgyud pa 'dra po zhig cha bzhag pa yin na ni/ spyir btang gi med pa'i chos thams cad 'di kun rdzob tu rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa red/ bden par ma grub pa red/ don dam pa la bden par ma grub red/ yin na yang kun rdzob tu rang bzhin gyis grub pa red ces bshad kyi yod red/ 'o dbu ma thal 'gyur pas ni/ 'di ma red ces bden par grub na bden pa gnyis kar gyi ngor grub dgos kyi red/ ces bden par ma grub pa'i chos shig yin na kun rdzob dang don dam gnyis ka la grub dgos kyi ma red/ ces byas nas bden gnyis cig car ba thog nas bshad yong*/ bden gnyis so sor phye yod ma red/ dbu ma rang rgyud pas bden gnyis so sor phye nas bshad yong gi yod red/ 'di bshad yong dus don dam par skye ba med de/ zhes byed nas dgag bya la don dam gyi khyad par sbyar yong dus don dam pa la bden par grub pa yod ma red/ kun rdzob tu chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pa red ces lab pa red/ rang bzhin gyis grub mkhan tshig 'di yang go ba gnyis phye ba red/ dbu ma thal 'gyur pas rang bzhin gyis grub zer dus bden par grub pa la go ba len pa red/ dbu ma rang rgyud pas rang bzhin gyis grub zer yag 'di ga re go ba red zer na/ tshad mas grub pa zhig la go ba len gyi red ma gtogs rang bzhin gyis grub pa yin na/

bden par grub pas khyab kyi ma red ces lab kyi yod red/ rang bzhin gyis zhes lab yong ba'i skabs la kho rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i chos shig dang po dgos kyi red ma gtogs dper na/ ka ba zhes lab pa'i skabs su ka ba'i gdags gzhi ka ba zhig dang po phar yod dgos kyi red ma gtogs ka bar rtog pa'i blo slebs kyi ma red/ ka ba 'dogs par byed pa la ka ba'i tha snyad btags pa la ka ba dang*/ ka ba rtog pa'i blo 'di dang po ka ba btags sa dang*/ ka ba'i tha snyad gdags gzhi 'di la rang bzhin gyis grub pa zhes lab kyi yod red ma gtogs bden par grub pa'i skad cha ma red ces bshad nas rang bzhin gyis grub pa dang*/ bden par grub pa gnyis la khyad par phye nas skad cha zhig bshad kyi yod red/ dbu ma thal 'gyur bas rang bzhin gyis grub pa dang bden par grub pa gnyis khyad par mi 'dug ces lab pa red/ rigs pas dpyad yong dus/ rang bzhin gyis zer ba'i skabs la rang bzhin zhes pa'i don dag la bsam blo btang na/ gang ltar tshad mas grub pa red/ tshad mas grub pa zer yag 'di 'phags pa'i shes pa la bltos nas tshad mas grub pa bshad dgos red/ 'jig rten pa'i blo la bltos nas tshad mas grub pa skad cha bshad yag yod ma red/ 'di 'dra bshad yong dus 'phags pa'i blos dpyad na ni bden pa gnyis ka'i ngo la tshad mas grub pa'i chos mthong gi mi 'dug /ces bshad yong dus rang bzhin gyis grub pa dang bden par grub pa gnyis la khyad par mi 'dug /ces khyad par zhig phye rgyu yod red/ 6 sems med 'dod tshul/ gang ltar yin na'ang 'dra min na yang 'dra sems med zer ba'i 'di skabs su sems med stangs kyi tshad 'di shes dgos red/ sems med zer yag 'di spyir btang sems yod ma red/ ces lab pa ma red/ sems yod red/ rtsa ba shes rab kyi nang la/ 'gag pa med pa skye med pa// chad pa med pa rtag med pa// 'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa//

tha dad don min don gcig min// spros pa nyer zhi/ zhes bshad pa red/ 'di bshad yong dus med med zer yag 'di bcom ldan 'das kyis spyir kun rdzob tu 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang skye ba red gsungs pa red/ sems yod pa red sems yod red/ 'khrul pa yod red/ nor ba yod red/ thar pa yod red/ 'khor ba yod red/ de ka nang bzhin gyi 'gro ba yod red/ 'ong ba yod red/ thams cad yod red/ 'di yod ma red lab pa yin na mngon sum du skur pa btab pa red/ 'di kun rdzob tu skur pa btab na bden pa gnyis las nyams kyi red/ bden pa gnyis las nyams pa'i gang zag la thar pa med gsungs pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus 'o na med zer yag 'di ga re red/ sems med zer yag 'di khyad gzhi bye brag pa ga re sbyar dgos red/ khyad gzhi bye brag pa 'di don dam par med ces lab dgos pa red/ yag shos 'di yin pa red/ 'phags pa'i blo la bltos na mnyam bzhag la de kho na nyid sems pa'i ngo la med/ ces mnyam par bzhag pa'i blo'i ngo la med/ chos thams cad yod med dpyad pa'i blo'i ngo la bltos na yod ma red ces byas nas/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi ngo la yod ma red/ gang ltar med pa'i med pa 'di khyad gzhi bye brag pa zhig sbyar nas med pa zhes grub pa red ma gtogs spyir kun rdzob tu sems yod ma red lab pa yin na/ skur pa btab pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus bka' bar pa'i skabs su sems zer ba'i skabs su sems 'di rang bzhin gyis grub pa med/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa med zer yag 'di ga ba sbyar dgos pa red zer na/ 'phags pa'i blo la bltos dgos pa red/ 'phags pa'i blo zer ba ga 'dra yod red zer na/ 'phags pa'i blo 'di chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab cig la bzhag dgos pa red/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab 'di ga ba yong gi red zer na/ mngon sum du rtogs pa'i blo 'di mthong lam skabs su yong gi red/
