mthong lam skabs su slebs yong dus mthong lam skabs su chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab 'di'i ngo la sems zhes pa 'di mi 'dug ces lab pa red/ sems zhes pa 'di mi 'dug /sems rang bzhin gyis grub pa mi 'dug zhes lab pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus kho lam gyi skabs su grub yong dus spyir nga tshos grub mtha' so sor phye ba yod red/ bka' brgyud/ rnying ma/ sa skya/ dge lugs grub mtha' bzhi'i nang nas skad cha bshad stangs khyad par yod red/ ri bo dga' ldan pa 'dra po yin na ni kun rdzob tu chos thams cad rang rang gi ngo bos stong gi ma red/ kun rdzob tu dper na/ chos thams cad kyi rang rang ngo bos stong gi ma red/ bden par grub pas stong gi red/ ces chos la bden grub kyis stong dgos red ma gtogs rang rang ngo bos stong gi ma red/ ka ba ka bas mi stong*/ ka ba bden grub kyis stong pa zhal gyis bzhes kyi yod red/ yin na yang rang lugs la mi bskyod rdo rjes dgongs pa gtso bo bzhag yong dus/ brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje dang 'bri gung skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyis/ sgom pa'i don dam rnam par nges pa'i lugs gtso bo byed nas bshad yong dus 'di gnyis kyi dgongs pa la yang*/ rang bzhin yod med dpyod pa'i sa mtshams la slebs yong dus kho 'phags pa'i blo la bltos nas/ rnal 'byor pas chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi ngo la chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub bam ma grub ces bshad yong dus dbu ma pa rang dbu ma pa yin pa'i cha nas/ khas len kyang dbu ma pa yi khas len yin pa'i cha nas/ rang bzhin yod med dpyad pa'i rigs pas tshad mas bsgrub yong dus ka ba'i ngo bo ka ba ka bas stong pa dang*/ ka ba'i bden grub kyis stong pa gnyis la khyad par yod ma red/ ces 'di'i khyad par phyed kyi 'dug a/ ka ba ka bas mi stong*/ ka ba bden grub kyis stong zer yag 'di ma gtogs spyir 'jig rten pa'i blo la bltos pa yin na ka ba ka bas stong gi ma red/

ces ka ba bden grub kyis stong pa 'di ni 'jig rten pa'i blo la yang ka ba bden grub kyis stong gi ma red ces lab pa red/ ka ba bden grub kyis stong gi ma red/ 'jig rten pa'i blos ka ba bden par 'dzin na yang gzhi kho rang gi ngo bo ni kho kho rang ngo bos stong stong pa red/ ces bshad na'ang ma bshad na'ang*/ 'phags pa'i blos chos thams cad la rab tu dpyad pa'i gnas skabs la mnyam bzhag chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab kyis chos thams cad bden par grub dang ma grub pa la rigs pas dpyad pa'i sa mtshams la ka ba'i ngo bo stong pa ka ba ka bas stong pa dang*/ ka ba bden grub kyis stong pa gnyis la khyad par med par bshad kyi yod red/ 'o 'di yang grub mthas 'dzin stangs shig gi khyad par yong gi yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus phar lab dus/ 'di skabs la yong dgos yag 'di sems med ces pa'i tshig 'di kha thug la bka' bar pa'i dgongs pa gtso bo bkral yong dus bcom ldan 'das kyis/ gzugs stong pa'o// stong pa nyid gzugs so// gzugs las stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no// stong nyid bzhi sbyor gyi rim pa dgongs pa gtso bo bzhag nas bshad yong dus khas len dus 'di 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi lugs srol zhig dang*/ 'phags pa thogs med kyi dgongs pa bkral tshul gnyis 'byung ba red/ 'di byung yong dus 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa 'di 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdo sde dgongs pa gtso bo byed nas bshad yong gi yod pa dang*/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi mdo gtso bo byed nas bshad yong dus 'di la dgongs pa len stangs gnyis byung ba red/ dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi mdo 'di dbu ma rang stong pa thams cad kyis ni sems tsam pa yi mdo sde bzhag gi yod red/ dbu ma gzhan stong pa thams cad kyis ni/ dbu ma gzhan stong sgrub byed kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i mdo sde zhig la bzhag gi yod red/

dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi mdo 'di de 'dra yin dus go ba la gnyis yong gi yod red/ da lta 'di skabs la dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi mdo sde gtso bo bzhag yong dus sems med ces pa 'di rang stong gi thog nas bshad yong dus rang stong dang*/ gzhan stong gnyis te kun rdzob stong tshul gyi thog nas khyad par bshad yong dus sems med pa dang*/ sgrub stangs gcig pa gcig kyang red/ gang ltar sems med zer ba'i skabs la sems rang bzhin gyis med pa zhig la bshad dgos pa red ma gtogs spyir sems med zer na 'grig gi yod ma red/ 'di bka' bar pa byed/ 7 rang lugs kyi sems kyi ngo bo stong tshul bshad pa/ sems kyi ngo bos stong zhes byas nas byed sgra brgyab yong dus bka' gsum pa'i skabs la ngo bos stong zhes lab pa red/ ngo bos stong zer ba'i skabs la ga re red zer na/ sems kho rang kho rang stong nyid red song ba zhig la go rgyu ma yin pa sems kyi ngo bo la gzhan glo bur gyi dri mas tshur stong pa byas bshad dgos ba red/ 'di skabs la rgyud bla ma'i dgongs pa gtso bo bshad dgos pa red/ sems kyi ngo bo la zhes gzhan glo bur gyi dri mas tshur stong pa red/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi gnas lugs ye gdod ma nas kho yon tan yang ldan/ ye gdod ma nas skyon kun zad pa zhig yin pa yin dus 'di 'dra'i sems kyi ngo bo 'di la glo bur gyi dri mas ye gdod ma nas stong stong pa red ces lab pa red/ 'khrul pa'i gnas skabs la yang sems kyi ngo bo la glo bur gyi dri mas stong pa red/ ma 'ongs pa la mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas nas skyon thams cad zad/ yon tan thams cad mngon du 'gyur ba'i gnas skabs la yang skyon thams cad kyis sems kyi ngo bo la stong bsdad kyi yod red/ glo bur 'khrul pa'i gnas skabs la yang sems kyi ngo bo la glo bur dri mas stong stong pa red/

ga tshad cig 'khrul/ ga tshad cig nyon mongs pa 'ching ba kun ldan yin na yang*/ kho rnam pa'i sgo nas 'ching ba kun ldan chags bsdad kyi red ma gtogs/ ngo bo'i cha la sgrib thub kyi yod ma red/ gal srid ngo bo'i cha nas sgrib na thar pa thob rung gi ma red/ gnyen po bsten na yang nyes pa glo bur gyi dri ma zer mkhan 'di kho kho rang kho rang gi ngo bos stong gi red/ rnam pa dbye ru med pa'i stong pa nyid de gang red zer na/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid bshad kyi yod red/ dus 'khor skabs su/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid gang red zer na/ rnam pa dbye ru mi rung ba red/ de 'dra rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid 'di bla na med pa'i chos ye gdod ma nyid nas yon tan yar ldan yin pa yin dus/ de la glo bur gyi dri mas rnam pa kun tu stong bsdad kyi yod red/ bla na med pa'i chos 'di rang gi ngo bos stong gi ma red/ 'di yin dus shin tu rnam par dpyad pa'i skabs su/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab mthar thug pa'i ye shes 'di bden par grub ces bshad kyi yod red/ 8 gzhan stong pas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bden grub tu bzhed tshul/

gzhan stong pas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de bden grub yin zhes bshad kyi yod red/ de 'dra'i bden grub yin zer yag 'di bden par grub pa de yang*/ kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad bden par grub bam ma grub zer yag gi 'di'i bden grub 'di ma red/ gtsang mi gtsang gnyis ka'i mtha' las 'das pa'i gtsang ba dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal gnyis las pha rol tu phyin pa'i bde ba dam pa pha rol du phyin pa dang*/ bdag bdag med gnyis kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i bdag dam pa'i pha rol du phyin pa dang*/ rtag mi rtag gnyis kyi mtha' las 'das pa'i rtag pa dam pa'i pha rol du phyin zhes zer nas rgyud bla ma'i nang nas gtsang bde rtag bdag bzhi bshad kyi yod red/ 'di'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i bden grub re re bzhag gi yod red/ 'phags pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs pa'i ngo la bden grub bshad kyi yod red/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab mthar thug pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo la skye 'gags 'pho 'gyur dang bral ba'i dbyings kyi cha 'di la bden grub ces bshad yong ba red 'dug /'di 'dra yin dus ngo bos stong zer ba'i skabs la kho kho rang kho rang stong cha nas bshad bsdad pa ma yin pa/ 'di la glo bur gyi dri mas stong pa'i cha la ngo bos stong pa zhes lab kyi yod red/ 9 stong nyid rten 'brel du grub pa/ stong zhing ma 'gags cir yang snang ba ste// zhes gsungs pa red/ zung 'jug sgrub pa red/ stong pa dang rten 'brel gnyis te zung 'jug tu sgrub dgos pa red/ 'di gnyis bral gyi ma red ces gsungs pa red/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang*/ rtsa ba shes rab kyi skabs la/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma yin pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// de'i phyir stong nyid ma yin pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// zhes dang po chos thams cad rten 'brel du sgrub/ rten 'brel du bsgrubs nas stong pa nyid sgrub kyi yod red/

spyir las dang po pas stong pa nyid kyi rtags kyis rten 'brel bsgrub yag 'di las sla bo yod ma red/ yin na yang las dang po pa la rten 'brel gyi rtags kyis stong nyid bsgrub yong na/ tog tsam dka' las khag po yod red gsungs pa red/ dbu ma pa thams cad kyis rten 'brel gyi rtags kyis stong nyid sgrub yag 'di dka' las khag po yod pa red 'dug /stong pa nyid kyi rtags kyis rten 'brel sgrub yag 'di tog tsam las sla bo yod gsungs pa red 'dug /las sla stangs 'di ga 'dra yin na ha go ma song*/ so sos bsgrub dgos pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus/ stong zhing ma 'gags cir yang snang ba ste// zhes stong yang ngo bo la stong pa zer ba'i skabs la ci med cang med phor pa stong pa nang bzhin nam mkha' stong pa nang bzhin red pas/ gang yang med pa nag thom me 'dra po 'jug 'gro ba zhig la stong pa zer gyi yod red pas zer na/ ma red ces lab pa red/ kho kho rang ngo bos stong pa yin na yang yon tan gyi cha bral smin gyi yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa 'di phrin las kyi 'jug pa nyi shu rtsa bdun la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan 'di gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad 'di dgag thub kyi ma red/ sems can gyi khams la 'jug thub kyi red/ sems can gyi khams la snang thub kyi red/ sems can gyi khams la shar thub kyi red ces zer ba red/ shar gyi yod red/ gang ltar sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa phrin las 'di rgyun chad med pa/ yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*// ji ltar re ba yongs skong ba// de bzhin gdul bya'i smon lam gyi// dbang gis rgyal ba'i skur snang ngo*// zhes gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis gang ltar yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che la yang rnam rtog dang 'bad rtsol la sogs pa med na yang mdzad pa dang phrin las 'di rgyun chad med par skyong thub kyi yod red/

dbu ma 'jug pa'i nang la yang*/ chos sku mngon du chud tshar ba'i skabs la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa phrin las rgyun chad 'gro gi ma red pas zer na/ ma red/ ga re yod red zer na/ ji ltar rdza mkhan stobs chen ldan pas 'di// yun ring cher 'bad bskor bas 'khor lo ni// de tshul da lta skye ba med bzhin du// 'khor zhing bum pa la sogs rgyur mthong ltar// zhes byas nas gang ltar rdza bum mam rdza ma bzo mkhan thams cad kyis rdza ma bskor yong dus/ dang po dka' las rgyab nas bskor ra rgyab dgos kyi red de gang mtshams zhig la kho rang gis bskor tshar dus 'bad rtsol la bltos mi dgos par 'khor 'gro gi red/ 'di nang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas kyis kho slob pa lam zhugs kyi gnas skabs la smon lam chen po brgya dang lnga bcu la sogs pa dang lnga brgya la sogs pa btab yod red/ de'i nyer len la brten nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas zin pa'i skabs su sku gsung thugs yon tan bral smin gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sems can gyi khams la yang 'jug thub kyi yod red/ ces lab pa red/ cir yang snang ba ste 'di yin dus legs par brtags nas zer ba'i skabs la legs par ga re brtag dgos ba red/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis 'di skabs la legs par brtag yag 'di so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad dgos ba red 'dug /so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab 'dis legs par brtag yong dus gnas lugs kyi gzhi rtsa chod thub kyi red/ gnas lugs kyi gzhi rtsa zer na/ gnas lugs kyi mtshang rig thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ gzhi'i rtsa ba chod thub kyi red/ 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba ga re yin pa 'di thag chod thub kyi red/ ces gnas lugs kyi rtsa ba 'dra po 'di ga ba thug bzhag /'di thag chod thub kyi red gsungs pa red 'dug /chos nyid kyi rang rtsal 'di kho nye bar snang ba'i chos nyid kyi dbyings 'di bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin pa yin dus 'di'ang thos bsam sgom gsum gyis rim pas sbyangs nas/

gnas lugs 'di mngon du ma byas na mi 'jug pa yin dus/ legs par yang nas yang du brtag zer ba'i skabs su spyir btang gi brtag dpyad btang stangs la gnyis yod red/ 10 dpyad sgom dang 'jog sgom gyi khyad par/ paṇḍi ta'i dpyad sgom dang ku su lu yi 'jog sgom zhes byas nas brtag dpyad btang stangs gnyis yod red/ brtag dpyad btang gin btang gin byed nas rigs pas brtag dpyad btang nas lung rigs la brten nas brtag dpyad btang gin btang gin dpyad stangs gcig /de lta bu'i brtag dpyad btang bzhag pa 'di mnyam bzhag gi steng la tshur bzhag nas sgom pa'i thog nas sgom pa mngon sum gyis skye ba'i ngo la nyams myong gi steng nas brtag dpyad btang stangs gnyis yod pa red/ nges shes skyes yag la phyi ma 'di nges par du 'gro dgos kyi yod red/ de'i rgyu'i rtsa ba 'di lung rigs kyi dpyad pa sngon du 'gro dgos ba red/ 'di 'dra brtags nas gzhi rtsa 'di chod par shog /gsungs pa red bzhag /chos thams cad snang ba sems su grub/ 'di'i mjug la sems rang bzhin med pa'i stong pa nyid la bsgrub kyi red/ stong pa nyid la gtan la phabs zin nas stong dang rten 'brel zer yag 'di zung 'jug yin pa zhig grub nas gang ltar stong pa nyid zer yag 'di dang*/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zer yag gi chos gnyis po 'di phan tshun gcig gi grogs la yong gi yod pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di mar gsal bshad byed nas stong dang rten 'brel gnyis po 'di la 'gal ba med pa/ stong dang rten 'byung zung 'jug yin pa bshad pa red/ yang 'di la yang gsal cha phye ba red/ dang po snang ba sems su sgrub pa zer yag 'di/ chos rnams thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul te// zer yag tshig 'di chos rnams thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul te zer yag gi tshig 'di mar yang 'grel bshad yong gi yod red/ 'di'i 'grel bshad 'di dang po snang ba thams cad sems su sgrub stangs 'di ga 'dra byed nas bsgrub kyi yod red/

snang ba thams cad sems yin pa dang snang ba sems su thag bcad yag la chos nyid kyi rang rtsal 'di nye bar snang ba'i yul dang yul can gyi 'khrul tshul 'di ngo ma shes na/ 'khrul pa spang 'dod kyi blo skye gi ma red/ ces 'di 'khrul pa spang 'dod kyi blo ma skyes na/ 'di la bsten pa'i thar pa thob 'dod kyi blo skye gi ma red/ nges 'byung gi bsam pa skyes yag yod ma red/ 'di 'dra yin dus dang po 'khrul pa 'di ngo shes dgos pa red/ 'khrul pa la yang mang po yod red/ mang po yod pa'i nang nas dang po yul dang yul can gyi 'khrul tshul 'di thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'dra po 'di bshad kyi yod red/ bye brag smra ba nas bzung ste gsang sngags bla med kyi bar la 'khrul tshul thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'di ga ba gtan la phab kyi yod red zer na/ yul dang yul can gnyis kyi thog nas bzhag gi yod red/ yul yul can gyi 'khrul tshul ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod red/ 'khor ba'i chos dang myang 'das kyi chos gnyis yong gi yod red/ spyir btang chos la rags pa 'khor ba'i chos dang*/ phra ba rnam byang gi chos zhes byas nas chos la gnyis yod red/ rags pa 'khor ba'i chos 'di sems snang yin pa gtan la phab ma thub na/ phra ba rnam byang gi chos sems snang yin pa gtan la phab thub kyi ma red/ rags pa 'khor ba'i chos 'di ga nas 'byung ba red zer na/ sems la dag pa'i sems dang ma dag pa'i sems zhes dbye ba gnyis phye ba red/ rags pa 'khor ba'i chos 'di ma dag pa'i sems kyi snang ba la brten nas yong gi yod pa dang*/ phra ba rnam byang gi chos 'di dag pa'i sems la brten nas 'byung ba yin pa 'di bshad kyi yod red/ kun gzhi kun gyi gzhi yin 'di// mya ngan 'das pa'i gzhi ma'ang yin// zhes bshad pa'i skabs la yang kun gzhi la dag pa'i kun gzhi dang ma dag pa'i kun gzhi gnyis phye ba'i lugs srol byed nas skad cha bshad yong dus/

ma dag pa'i kun gzhi la brten nas rags pa 'khor ba'i chos snang yag dang*/ dag pa'i kun gzhi la brten nas phra ba rnam byang gi chos mthong tshul zhig gi rim pa gnyis bshad dgos yag 'di 'dra byas yong gi yod red/ 'di yin dus dang po rags pa 'khor ba'i chos 'di sems snang du gtan la phab thub na/ sems snang phra ba rnam byang gi chos 'di yang sems kyi rtsal snang yin pa 'di shugs la rtogs thub kyi red/ ces 'di yin dus gal che shos 'di dang po rags pa 'khor ba'i chos 'di grub/ dngos bstan dang shugs bstan gnyis 'dra po zhig byed nas dngos bstan gyi thog la rags pa 'khor ba'i chos 'di sems snang du gtan la phabs/ de nas shugs la phra ba rnam byang gi chos 'di yang sems kyi rtsal yin pa 'di kho rang bzhin gyis go thub kyi red/ ces dngos shugs kyi go ba 'dra po gnyis yong gi yod pa yin dus dang po dngos la rags pa 'khor ba'i chos 'di yul dang yul can gyi 'khrul tshul la brten nas 'di sems snang gtan la phab yag 'di red bzhag / tha snang ba thams cad sems su thag gcod pa/ yod ma myong ba'i rang snang yul du 'khrul// ma rig dbang gis rang rig bdag tu 'khrul// gnyis 'dzin dbang gis srid pa'i klong du 'khyams// ma rig 'khrul pa'i rtsad dar chod par shog / 1 rang snang la yul du 'khrul par bstan pa/ yod ma myong ba'i zhes lab pa red/ yod ma myong zer yag 'di spyir btang ga re yod ma myong ba red zer na/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad 'di so so skye bos dbang shes kyi yul du mthong yag gi rgyu tshogs drug gi shes pa so so skye bo'i gtso bo 'di tshad ma 'dra po ga ba bzhag yod red zer na/ tshogs drug gi shes pa la bzhag gi yod red/ kun rdzob bden pa gtso bo bshad pa'i skabs su/ kun rdzob bden pa gtso bo bshad yong dus tshogs drug gi shes pa 'di bzhag gi yod pa yin dus tshogs drug gi shes pa'i yul du gyur pa'i yul drug po 'di kho rang gshis la yod bsdad yag gi chos shig red pas/

kho don dam pa'i ngo bo la bden par grub bsdad pa'i chos shig red pas/ 'phags pa rnams kyi mnyam bzhag la rab tu mi gnas pa'i ngo bo la/ gal te so so skye bo'i mthong tshul tshad ma 'di 'phags pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs yul du gyur pa'i 'phags pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs yul la yang 'di lta bu tshad ma yod red pas zhes bshad yong dus/ yod ma myong ba red ces lab yong dus don dam dbang btsan po byed nas bshad kyi yod pa red 'dug /kun rdzob dbang btsan po byed nas bshad kyi yod ma red/ don dam du dbang btsan po bshad yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus kun rdzob bden pa dang don dam pa'i bden pa gnyis bshad yong ba'i nang nas gtso che shos 'di skabs la don dam pa'i bden pa 'di gtso bo dbang btsan po byed nas bshad yong dus dbu ma pas shin tu dpyad pa'i gnas skabs la/ rigs pas shin tu dpyad pa'am mnyam bzhag gis rab tu dpyad pa'i ngo la chos rab rnam 'byed kyi shes rab 'di'i ngo la skyes yong dus/ da lta rags pa 'khor ba'i chos dbang shes drug gi yul du gyur pa'i tshogs drug gi shes pa'i yul du gyur pa'i yul drug gi snang ba 'di thams cad 'di yod red pas/ da lta'i snang ba ltar rang bzhin gyis yod pa red pas zer na/ 'o 'di yod ma red ces lab pa red/ ma myong zer yag rgyu mtshan 'di kho ye gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba red ma gtogs mnyam bzhag gis dpyad pa btang*/ mnyam bzhag pa'i ngo la dang po yod/ mnyam bzhag sgom yong dus mnyam bzhag gis med pa bzo bzhag pa 'di 'dra yang ma red/ dbu ma pas rigs pas ma dpyad pa'i skabs la so so skye bo'i mthong tshul dbang btsan po byed nas bshad yong dus 'jug shes drug gi yul du gyur pa'i chos 'di bden pa yod/ yin na yang rigs pas dpyad yong dus chos nyid rigs pas shin tu dpyad yong dus 'di'i ngo la tho bas bum pa bshig pa nang bzhin gyis rigs pas dpyad ngo la chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'am rigs pas dpyad ngo la ma grub pa'i chos thams cad dang po grub/

de nas rigs pas dpyad ngo la ma grub song ba 'dra po red pas zer na/ 'di 'dra yang ma red/ gshis kho rang gi ngo la rigs pas dpyad na yang 'dra/ ma dpyad na yang 'dra/ 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag gis gzigs na yang 'dra ma gzigs na yang 'dra/ gang ltar chos nyid kho rang gi gnas tshul dbang btsan po byed nas bshad yong dus da lta'i mthong tshul 'di ga re zer na/ 'khrul pas btags pa'i chos shig red ma gtogs don dam pa la da lta mthong tshul 'di 'dra po yod ma red/ ye gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba'i rgyu mtshan yin pa yin dus yod ma myong zhes lab pa red/ myong zer yag 'di dang po yod/ phyis su gnyen po la brten nas med pa phyin pa yin na/ 'o 'di 'dra'i yod ma myong ba zhes tha snyad sbyar gyi ma red/ 'di 'dra zhig yin pa yin na chos nyid dbang btsan po byed nas bshad thub kyi ma red/ blo kun rdzob la yang mngon sum du bsnyon pa red/ kun rdzob la skur pa btab na/ don dam pa la skur pa rang bzhin gyis btab kyi red/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i nang la/ slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyi lam las ni//

phyi rol 'gyur la zhi ba'i thabs med do// de dag kun rdzob de nyid bden las nyams// de las nyams pas thar pa sgrub yod min// zhes kun rdzob bden pa las nyams pa'i gang zag de la don dam pa'i bden pa rtogs pa'i go skabs yod ma red/ ces don dam pa'i bden pa rtogs pa'i go skabs med pa yin na/ bden pa gnyis las nyams pa red/ bden pa gnyis las nyams pa'i gang zag la 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis gsungs pa'i thar pa 'di thob kyi ma red/ gsungs pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus thar pa mtshan nyid pa thob yag la dbu ma rin chen phreng ba'i nang la/ thar pa mtshan nyid pa thob pa la yul can ga re dgos kyi red zer na/ yul yul can 'khrul ma myong ba'i shes pa zhig gtan la phab thub dgos kyi red/ ces byas nas rin chen phreng ba'i dgongs pa gtso bo bshad kyi yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus thar pa mtshan nyid pa thob yag cig dgos kyi yod na/ yul can stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba 'di phyin ci ma log pa zhig dgos kyi yod pa yin dus/ yul can stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba de lta bu 'di yang rtogs par byed pa la dang po nges shes tshad ma dgos kyi yod red/ 'di 'dra'i nges shes tshad ma 'di yang gang 'dra zhig yong dgos kyi yod red zer na/ de nas dngos gnas drang gnas kyi mnyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'di'i gzigs ngo la chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis yod ma myong ba'i lta ba 'di lta ba mthar thug yin pa red/ lta ba yang dag pa 'di yin pa red/ dbu ma'i lta ba yang 'di yin pa red/ lta ba phyin ci ma log pa yang 'di yin pa red/ mdo sngags gnyis ka'i lta ba yang 'di yin pa red/ sngags kyi skabs su yang lta ba de lta bu 'di gtan la phab pa'i thog nas sngags kyi phyin ci ma log pa'i sa lam dang*/ nyams len chos 'di de'i steng la bzhag gi yod red ma gtogs phyin ci ma log pa'i lta ba de lta bu zhig sngon du ma song na/

sngags kyi lta ba gtan la phab thub yag med pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus yod ma myong ba zhes pa 'di yin pa red 'dug / yod ma myong na 'o na rang snang yul du ga 'dra byas nas 'khrul pa red ces zer na gsungs pa red/ yod ma myong ba'i rang snang yul du 'khrul// zer yag 'di rang snang bshad pa'i skabs su sems kyi 'od gsal sems kyi gnas lugs 'di kho ye gdod ma nas gsal stong zung 'jug gi yon tan las ma 'das pa yin pa red/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi ngo bo red/ gsal stong zung 'jug dang gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis yod pa red/ gsal stong zung 'jug dang gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis yod na yang*/ 'od gsal sems kyi rdo rje de nyid rang gi ngo bo rang rtsal gyis ma rig nas rang gi ngo bo 'di rang rtsal gyis ma rig pa red ma gtogs 'khrul bcug mkhan 'dra po 'di 'dra med pa red/ ga re red zer na/ 'khor 'das zer mkhan 'di sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pa red/ 'khor 'das 'di dag sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pa yin dus/ sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pa la yin par ngo ma shes nas de lta bu'i dngos gnas drang gnas pha rol la yul dang yul can tha dad pa'i tshul gyis grub 'dug bsams byas nas/ rang snang gi yul 'di rang snang gi rtsal yin pa chos nyid kyi rang rtsal yin pa ngo ma shes nas yul du 'khrul song ba red gsungs pa red/ rang snang yin pa ngo shes na/ de nas grol ba red/ rang snang yin pa ngo ma shes yong dus 'khrul pa'i 'go btsugs pa red/ gzung 'dzin rtog pa 'di'i skabs la dang po 'go btsugs pa yin zhes bshad pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus 'di yang 'du byed yid kyi g.yo ba la brten nas rgyu rkyen lta bu snang yong dus phan tshun rgyu rkyen las dang nyon mongs pa la brten nas las nyon la brten nas rgyu rkyen rten 'brel gyi snang ba 'di shar yong dus kun gzhi'i steng la bag chags rnam pa sna tshogs pa bsags nas 'khrul tshul gyi rtsa ba 'di dang po kun gzhi zhes khas len dgos kyi yod red/

kun gzhi'i steng la de ma thag pa'i yid dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i yid zer mkhan gnyis 'byung nas yul du 'khrul tshul 'di yang yul du 'khrul zer yag 'di gnyis yong gi yod red/ de ma thag rkyen zer yag gi de ma thag pa'i yid 'dis ga re yong gi red/ de ma thag pa'i yid 'dis rnam shes 'di skye bcug nas rnam shes 'di skyes nas yul la mtshams sbyor byed kyi yod red/ 'di'i nus pa 'di kun gzhi'i steng la bdag po rgyab bcug gi yod red/ de ma thag pa'i yid 'dis ldang 'jug byed nas ldang 'jug 'di'i steng la 'o kho ldang 'jug la brten nas skye 'gag rnam shes yul las skye 'gag byed pa'i skabs la de'i sa bon 'di kun gzhi'i steng la bdag po rgyab bcug gi yod red/ nyon mongs pa'i yid zer yag 'dis kun gzhi 'di nyon mongs pa can du byed pa red/ spyir btang kun gzhi zer yag 'di ngo bo lung ma bstan pa red/ 'jug shes drug po gang gi phyogs su yang ma lhung ba zhig dgos kyi yod red/ yin na yang nyon yid kyis kun gzhi la nga'o bsam pa'i ngar 'dzin gyi rtog pa 'di kun gzhi la 'dzin yong dus kun gzhi la nga'o snyam du 'dzin yong dus de ma thag pa'i yid 'dis kun gzhi'i steng na rnam par shes pa tshogs drug 'di skye bcug /rnam par shes pa tshogs drug 'di yul la skyes nas de lta bu'i kun gzhi rnam par shes pa tshogs drug po 'di skyes nas de'i nyon mongs pa can du byed bcug mkhan 'di nyon mongs pa'i yid 'di slebs pa red/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad khas len pa dang ma len pa rnam gzhag mang po yong gi yod red/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad khas len pa'i dbang du byas nas bshad yong dus de'ang nyon mongs pa'i yid dang*/ kun gzhi rnam shes zhes gnyis bshad yong dus yid la spyir btang nas gnyis bshad pa red/ de ma thag pa'i yid dang nyon mongs pa'i yid ces bshad yong dus kun gzhi'i steng na rnam shes tshogs drug 'di skye bcug mkhan 'di su red zer na/

de ma thag pa'i yid red/ rnam shes tshogs drug po 'di nyon mongs pa can du byed mkhan 'di su red zer na/ nyon mongs pa'i yid red ces bshad yong ba red/ 'o 'di 'dra yin dus 'di 'dra skyes yong dus rang snang yul du 'khrul zer yag 'di yin dus bcom ldan 'das kyis dang po kun gzhi ma gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di yin pa red/ de yang*/ len pa'i rnam par shes pa zab cing phra// sa bon thams cad chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bab// bdag tu rtog par gyur na mi rung zhing*// de ni byis pa rnams la ngas ma bstan// zer yag 'di gang ltar 'phags pa'i lam ma rtogs kyi bar la 'phags sa ma thob pa'i bar la kun gzhi la nyon mongs pa'i yid 'dis kun gzhi la nyon mongs pa can du 'dzin pa red/ nyon mongs pa can du byed pa yin pa red/ bdag tu zhen pa yin pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus bdag 'dzin skye bcug yag gi rgyu mtshan 'di 'dra byed nas 'byung ba red gsungs pa red/ 'di yin dus rang snang yul du 'khrul zhes 'khrul stangs 'dra po 'di 'dra yong gi yod red/ de yang ga 'dra red ces zer na/ sems nyid rang gis rang la yul du gzung*/ sems nyid 'di rang rtsal yin pa red/ sems nyid rang rtsal yin dus sems nyid rang gis rang la yul du bzung yong dus 'khrul song ba red/ 'khrul yag 'di sems nyid rang gis rang la yul du bzung nas 'khrul ba red/ sems nyid rang gis rang la yul du ma bzung na/ 'o 'di chos nyid kyi rang rtsal red ces byed nas rgya mtsho 'di rba rlabs 'di rgya mtsho'i cho 'phrul yin pa shes thub na/ 'di dang 'dra ba rba rlabs rgya mtsho'i cho 'phrul yin pa shes pa ltar du sems nyid kyi rang rtsal yin/ sems nyid kyi rang rtsal yin pa 'khor 'das 'di sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pa'ang ngo shes thub na/ grol ba yin pa red/ 'di ngo ma shes yong dus 'o gzung yul du 'khrul pa red/ gzung ba'i yul du 'khrul zer yag 'di yul du 'khrul zer yag 'di gzung ba'i yul drug la 'khrul pa yin pa red/

2 rang rig la bdag tu 'khrul par bstan pa/ ma rig dbang gis rang rig bdag tu 'khrul// ma rig pa'i dbang gis rang rig gzhi med rtsa bral yin pa ma rtogs nas yul bzung mkhan 'di la bdag lta zhugs yong ba red 'dug a/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags thams cad 'di dang po sa bon thams cad kyis skyes yong dus kun gzhi zer mkhan 'di yid 'di gnyis kyi rten 'dra po zhig red/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags thams cad 'dzin pa'i cha nas kun gzhi la mtshams mtshams sa bon thams cad pa zhes ming btags kyi yod red/ sems tsam pa'i skabs sa bon thams cad pa zer ba'i skabs su ga re red zer na/ kho kun gzhi yid 'di gnyis kyi rten 'dra po zhig chags/ kho las dkar nag ga 'dra zhig bsags na yang 'di'i bag chags thams cad 'di kho sang nyin/ tshogs shing dus la babs pa na// 'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur// zer yag 'di da lta tshogs shing dus la ma babs kyi bar la 'phro brlag ma btang ba bdag po rgyab kyi yod red/ yid dang kun gzhi gnyis po 'di phan tshun rgyu rkyen gyi snang ba 'dra po zhig byung nas rgya mtsho las rba rlabs nang bzhin yong nas 'khor 'das kyi 'khrul pa thams cad 'di skyes kyi yod pa red/ 'di skyes yong dus 'di thams cad kyi skyes bcug mkhan rtsa ba ga re red zer na/ nyon mongs pa'i yid de yong gi yod red/ 'di yin dus kun gzhi las yid g.yo yong dus phyi la yul drug /nang la shes pa drug ces yul drug dang shes pa drug ni tha snyad 'go btsugs pa red/ 'di gnyis 'di don la tha dad du grub pa yod ma red de don la tha dad yod red bsam byed nas med bzhin du snang yong dus dang po snang ba zhes lab pa red/ 'di snang bsdad pa 'di rtog pa'i yid dang 'brel yong dus mched pa zhes yong gi yod red/ de'i rang mtshan du zhen yong du thob pa zhes snang mched thob gsum 'di 'dra byed nas dang po 'khor ba 'khrul tshul 'di phyag chen skabs la 'di bshad kyi yod red/

snang mched thob gsum la brten nas/ 'di yin dus 'khor 'das yul drug dang shes pa drug ste phyi rol la don du bden pa grub pa dang*/ tha dad pa yod ma red de tha dad pa yod pa ltar du dang po snang yong ba red pa/ snang tshul gyi thog nas bshad yong dus dang po snang ba bshad pa red/ tha dad pa red 'dug /tha dad pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas nyer len 'di 'dra red bzhag zer nas/ rgyu rkyen la bsam blo btang nas 'di la dus drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa rtog pa'i yid dang 'brel yong dus 'di snang ba mched pa zhes lab pa red/ 'di la brten nas las bsags/ de nas las kyi kun 'byung bsags nas gtso bo 'di las bsags nas don la rang mtshan du zhen nas las dngos su bsags yong ba 'di ga re zer na/ thob zhes snang mched thob gsum gyi thog nas thob yong ba yin dus ma rig pa'i dang po 'di 'dra zhes 'byung ba red bshad kyi yod red/ 'di yin dus ma rig pa'i dbang gis zhes ma rig pa de lta bu la brten nas rang rig zer yag 'di ga re red/ 3 sems tsam pas 'dod pa'i rang rig dang mi 'dra tshul/ rang rig 'di gzhi med rtsa bral red/ sems tsam pa'i skabs nas bshad pa'i rang rig 'di 'dra po go rgyu yod sa ma red/ 'di skabs kyi rang rig 'di/ 'di 'dra yin dus 'di skabs la rang rig zer yag 'di so so rang rig pa'i ye shes la go dgos ba red ma gtogs sems tsam pa'i rang rig bzhag na 'grig gi yod ma red/ 'di la skyon yod red/ dbu ma pas zhe drag bkag yod red/ 'di skabs la ga re zer na/ rang rig zer yag 'di so so rang rig pa'i ye shes zer yag 'di gang ltar/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skye mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// ces byed nas stong tshul gyi thog nas bshad yong dus smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol tu phyin pa/ dang po ma skyes pa/ tha ma ma 'gags pa/ nam mkha'i ngo bo nang bzhin yin pa gtan la phab nas stong nyid sgang la gtan la phab nas gsal cha nas bshad yong dus/

so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// da gsal cha nas bshad yong dus so so rang rig pa'i ye shes zer yag 'di gang ltar nyams myong gi tshul gyis nyams su myong ba'i tshul gyis mngon sum du rtogs dgos ba red ma gtogs dpe dang tha snyad dang tshig gi thog nas mtshon dgos na/ mngon sum du myong ma thub pa/ brda'i thog nas ngo sprod dgos na'ang mngon sum du rtogs thub yag gi thabs shes yod ma red/ mtshon byed dpe 'dra po zhig bkod na'ang mngon sum du rtogs pa'i thabs yod ma red/ tha snyad dang brjod bya gang gis thog nas kyang rtogs thub kyi yod ma red/ yin na yang ga re zer na/ rang gis de lta bu zhig gi dang po rjes thob rjes su mthun pa'i tshul gyis rtogs/ de'i rjes la mngon sum mngon gyur gyi tshul gyis rtogs yong dus de'i steng la mngon sum du nyams su myong nas phyin ci ma log pa'i ye shes sam shes rab la brten nas mngon sum du nyams su myong ba'i rtog bral ma 'khrul pa'i shes pa mthar thug pa 'di la brten nas rang rig byas nas dpe bzhag pa red/ so so rang rig pa'i nyams su myong ba ma gtogs gzhan gyis mtshon du med pa nyams su myong ba'i tshul gyis rtogs dgos pa de lta bu 'di rang rig 'di gzhi med pa dang rtsa ba dang bral ba zhig rtogs thub pa yin na/ rang rig yang dag pa rtogs thub pa red/ gzhi med rtsa bral du rtogs ma thub nas ma rig pa'i dbang gis rang rig la bdag lta zhugs song ba red/ yul gzung mkhan 'di rang rig red 'dug a/ bsam yong ba red 'dug a/ rang rig 'di la bdag lta zhugs zer yag 'di yul gzung mkhan 'di dang po mgo la yul 'di chos nyid kyi rang rtsal yin pa ngo ma shes nas chos nyid kyi rang rtsal 'di sems kyi 'khrul snang yin pa ngo ma shes nas sems las tha dad du zhen/ 'di la 'di gzugs so// 'di sgra'o// 'di dri'o snyam pa'i rtog pa 'di rang rig la 'khrul yong ba red/

rang rig gzhi med rtsa bral yin pa ma shes dus 'di yul bzung mkhan 'di rang rig red bzhag bsam byas nas rang rig la bdag tu zhugs yong ba red/ bdag lta zhugs nas 'khrul yong ba red/ 'di 'dra yin dus dang po yul 'khrul tshul 'di 'dra yin pa dang*/ gnyis pa rang rig la bdag tu 'khrul tshul 'di yin pa red/ 'di yin dus rang snang ngo ma shes pas yul du 'khrul/ rang rig gzhi med rtsa bral ma shes pas bdag tu bzung ba po yul bzung ba po la zhen nas bdag tu 'khrul song ba red/ 4 gnyis 'dzin gyis 'khor bar 'khyams par bstan pa/ gnyis 'dzin dbang gis srid pa'i klong du 'khyams// 'di 'dra yin dus 'di 'dra gnyis su 'dzin pa'i yul dang yul can gnyis su med bzhin du gnyis su 'dzin yong dus/ 'di 'dra thob yong dus don dag 'di ma dag pa'i skabs la gtso bo 'di kun gzhi rnam shes 'di bshad yong dus kun gzhi dang*/ las nyon gnyis su med bzhin du gnyis su 'dzin pa'i dbang gis gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa 'dis yul srid pa'i klong du 'khyams pa red/ ces srid pa'i klong zer na srid pa khams gsum 'khor ba'i klong du 'khyams pa red/ yul chos nyid kyi rang rtsal ngo ma shes nas yul du 'khrul/ rang rig la gzhi med rtsa bral du ma shes nas bdag lta zhugs nas 'khrul yong dus gnyis su 'dzin yong dus 'khrul yong ba red 'dug /kun gzhi 'di la brten nas 'khrul yong ba red/ 'di ga dus bzlog gi yod zer na/ kun gzhi 'di ma bzlog gi bar la rgyun mi chad par yang snang yong gi yod red/ mdo sde lang kar gshegs pa'i nang la/

rnam par shes pa yid las 'byung*// yid ni kun gzhi las 'byung zhing*// kun gzhi las ni chos rnams so// rba rlabs bzhin du rnam par g.yo// zer yag gi lung 'di gtso bo dang po rnam shes la brten nas yid 'byung ba dang*/ yid de yang gang las byung ba red zer na/ kun gzhi las byung ba'i tshul bshad pa red 'dug /kun gzhi las 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad snang gi yod pa yin dus rba rlabs bzhin du rnam par g.yo ba red ces 'khrul stangs 'dra po 'di 'dra byed nas lang kar gshegs pa'i nang la gsungs yod red/ 'di yin dus gnyis su 'dzin pa'i dbang gis srid pa'i klong du 'khyams pa red gsungs pa red/ dag yong dus kun gzhi 'di ngo bo kun gzhi'i gnas lugs rtogs yong dus ngo bo stong pa red/ rang bzhin gsal ba 'di nyon mongs pa'i yid 'di rtogs tshar na/ rang bzhin gsal ba rtogs thub kyi red/ rnam shes 'di'i rang bzhin rtogs thub pa yin na rnam pa 'gag med du shar thub pa'i sku gsum 'di kun gzhi dang gcig /nyon yid dang gnyis/ rnam shes dang gsum po 'di la sbyar yong dus ngo bo stong pa la kun gzhi rnam shes zhes rtogs thub pa dang rang bzhin gsal ba la nyon yid rtogs/ nyon yid dag yong dus rang bzhin gsal ba rtogs thub yag dang*/ rnam shes dag yong dus rnam pa 'gag med du shar thub pa sku gsum 'di kun gzhi dang gcig /rnam par shes pa dang gnyis/ nyon mongs pa'i yid dang gsum du sbyar yong dus 'di 'dra zhes sbyar gyi 'dug /ma rtogs pa'i skabs su kun gzhi rnam shes dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i yid dang*/ rnam par shes pa zer nas yong gi yod red/ 'di rtogs dus kho ngo bo stong pa/ rang bzhin gsal ba/ rnam pa 'gag med du shar ba rtogs thub kyi red ces gsungs pa red 'dug / rtogs dus ga dus rtogs kyi red zer na/ kun gzhi 'di ma bzlog gi bar la rgyun ma chad pa snang gi yod red/

nam kun gzhi 'di bzlog pa yin na'ang 'di skabs la srid pa'i klong las thar pa yin pa red/ 'di ma bzlog gi bar la srid pa'i klong du 'khyams pa yin pa red/ 'khyams bcug mkhan 'di rtsa ba gang red zer na/ gnyis su 'dzin pa'i dbang gis 'byung ba red 'dug a/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i nang la gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi/ dang po nga zhes bdag la zhen gyur cing*// bdag gi 'di zhes dngos la chags skyes pa// zo chun 'phyan ltar rang dbang med pa yis// 'gro la snying rjer gyur gang de la 'dud// zer ba'i skabs su zo chun 'phyan pa nang bzhin byed nas klong du 'khyams pa srid pa khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'gro ba rigs drug gi skye gnas rnam pa bzhi/ lam rgyud lngas 'dus pa'i 'gro ba'i nang log la zo chun 'phyan pa nang bzhin byed nas 'khor ba la 'khor gyi yod red/ 'di yin dus 'o na 'khor ba la thar pa'i thabs 'di ga 'dra zhig la bsten dgos kyi red zer na/ ma rig 'khrul pa'i rtsad dar chod par shog gsungs pa red/ 'di skabs la ma rig 'khrul pa'i zer ba'i ma rig 'di gtso bo la nyon mongs pa can gyi ma rig pa dang*/ nyon mongs can ma yin ma rig pa zhes gnyis bshad kyi yod red/ 'di nang la gtso bo 'di gnyis ka la sbyar dgos pa red/ 'di skabs kyi ma rig pa 'di nyon mongs pa can gyi ma rig pa 'di yang ma rig pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'i ma rig pa gnyis kar mdor bsdus sbyar dgos pa red 'dug /ma rig 'khrul pa'i rtsad dar chod zer na 'khor ba'i 'khrul tshul 'di dang po ma rig pa yin pa ngo shes dgos ba red/ 5 snang mched 'thob gsum gyi thog nas bshad pa/ ma rig pa la go ba sbyar stangs mang po yod red/ da lta phyag chen skabs la bshad yong dus gtso bo snang mched thob gsum gyi thog nas bshad yong dus/ 'khor ba 'khrul tshul 'di dang po chos nyid rang rtsal la yul du 'khrul/ rang rig la gzhi med rtsa bral du ma rtogs pas yul gzung ba po bdag tu 'khrul yong dus/

de la brten nas snang mched thob gsum gyi rim pa 'khor tshul 'di bshad yong dus 'di phyag chen skabs la ma rig pa ngos 'dzin byed stangs 'di 'dra bshad kyi yod red/ snang mched thob gsum gyi thog la yin dus 'di'i ma rig pas 'khrul ba'i mtshang 'dra po 'di rig yong dus 'khor ba'i 'khrul tshul 'di rtsad dar chod yong ba red/ yul thams cad 'di chos nyid kyi rang rtsal yin pa ngo shes yong dus sems nyid kyis/ rang rig 'di yang bdag rtog zhugs/ bdag rtog zhugs bsdad yag 'di 'o 'di skyon yin pa shes nas rang rig gzhi med rtsa bral yin pa ngo shes yong dus grol ba yin pa red/ ces gsungs pa red/ skad cig gcig gis bye brag phye// zer yag 'di gsal snang yin pa red/ mngon sum du rtogs pa'i blo la go/ rjes mthun gyis rtogs pa'i blo ni yong gi ma red pa/ ma rig 'khrul pa'i rtsad dar chod par shog /zer yag 'di yin pa red/ 'di yin dus rags pa 'khor ba'i chos 'di gsal snang du gtan la phab yong dus 'di'i shugs kyis phra ba rnam byang gi chos 'di yang shugs bstan la gtan la phab dgos ba red 'dug /phra ba rnam byang gi chos ga re yin na'ang sku dang zhing khams kyi snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang po yong gi yod red/ rnam byang gi chos 'di thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'di/ dag pa'i sems 'di las ma 'das pa yin pa red/ gong la sems la dag dang*/ ma dag gnyis kyi dbye ba phye yong dus dag pa'i sems kyi 'khrul bral las ma 'das pa red/ dag pa'i sems kyi rang rtsal yin pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus phra ba rnam byang gyi chos 'di thams cad kyang rtsa ba 'di chos thams cad 'di/ dag pa'i sems kyi rang bzhin red/ sems nyid la dri bcas kyi skabs la sems dang*/ yid dang*/ rnam par shes pa gsum bzhag gi yod red/ sems tsam pa'i skabs la red 'dug a/ sems yid rnam shes gsum 'di dri bcas kyi skabs la bzhag gi yod red/

phyag chen skabs la dri bral gyi skabs la sku gsum gyi rnam par bzhag gi yod red/ sems dag pas chos sku bzhag /yid dag pas longs sku la bzhag /rnam shes dag pas sprul sku la bzhag nas gang ltar sems yid rnam shes gsum 'di dag pa'i cha la sku gsum gyi rang bzhin bshad kyi yod red/ 'di 'jog yong dus ma rig 'khrul pa 'di'i skabs la de nas rtsad dar chod thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ phyag chen ngos nas byas pa yin na gzhi skye ba med pa/ gdangs 'gag pa med pa/ rtsal sna tshogs su 'phro ba/ zhes 'di yin pa'i skabs la sems dag pa mthong 'ong ba'i skabs la gzhi skye ba med pa rtogs/ de nas yid dag pa rtogs yong ba'i skabs la gdangs 'gag pa med pa rtogs/ de nas rnam shes dag pa rtogs yong dus rtsal sna tshogs su 'phro ba rtogs nas sku gsum lam du 'khyer ba red/ sku gsum lam du 'khyer ba'i thog nas ma rig 'khrul pa'i rtsad dar bcad thub pa red gsungs pa red 'dug / gnyis pa 'di la mtha' bral gsum gyi chos nyid rtogs tshul 'di 'o da 'di 'dra'i gnas tshul gtan la phab bsdad yag gi chos nyid kyi rang rtsal zer yag 'di chos nyid kyi rang bzhin 'di/ da yod med kyi mtha' spong ba/ yod pa ma yin rgyal bas kyang ma gzigs// med pa ma yin 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi// 'gal 'du ma yin zung 'jug dbu ma'i lam// mtha' bral sems kyi chos nyid rtogs par shog / 1 yul can rang bzhin med par gtan la phab pa/ ces sems rang bzhin med par gtan la phab thub dgos kyi red/ yul rang bzhin med par gtan la phab tshar nas yul can rang bzhin med par gtan la phab dgos kyi yod red/ 'di yang gtan la ma phab na yul rkyang pa'i rang bzhin yod ma red ces bzhag bzhag na yang sems 'gog pa yar lhag 'gro yag red/ 'di 'dra yin dus 'di rang bzhin med par gtan la phab yag la mdo sde rgyan gyi dgongs pa gtso bo byas nas/ sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas//

de nas sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs// blo dang ldan pas gnyis po med rig nas// de mi ldan pa chos kyi dbyings la gnas// zhes dang po sems las gzhan med pa yul thams cad 'khrul tshul ngo shes/ gnyis pa yul can 'khrul tshul ngo shes yong dus/ yul can kho rang rang bzhin gyis yod red dam ma red ces byas nas gong la bshad pa 'di de'i rang bzhin med pa gtan la phab yong ba red/ rgyan stug po bkod pa'i nang la/ sems med tsam po'ang yod ma yin// zhes gsungs pa red/ sems yod pa ga ba ga ba/ sems med pa yang med gsungs pa red 'dug a/ sems med tsam po'ang yod ma yin// sems yod med gnyis kyi mtha' las 'das pa gtan la phab thub kyi yod red/ sems med pa 'di yang tshad dang gzhal du med par rgyan stug po bkod pa'i nang la gsungs yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus/ yod pa ma yin rgyal bas kyang ma gzigs// med pa ma yin 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi// 'gal 'du ma yin zung 'jug dbu ma'i lam// mtha' bral sems kyi chos nyid rtogs par shog /ces yod pa ma yin rgyal bas kyang ma gzigs zhes 'di zer ba'i skabs su tshig kho rang gi kha thug la go ba len pa yin na bshad rgyu khyad mtshar bo 'dra po zhig yod red/ yod pa'ang ma yin med pa'ang ma yin zhes bshad bsdad mkhan 'dra po gcig /yin na yang don dag la ga re zer na sems rang bzhin med par gtan la phab yag 'di 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad 'di sems nyid kyi rang rtsal red/ sems nyid kyi rtsal 'dra po zhig red/ 'di yin dus sems nyid kyi rang rtsal yin dus sems kho rang sems nyid 'di gzhi med rtsa bral du ma phab na/ tan tan gyi mtshan 'dzin gyi drwa ba spong thub kyi yod ma red/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang*/ mtshan ma med par ma rtogs par// khyed kyis thar pa med par gsungs// de'i phyir khyed kyis theg chen las// 'di ni tshang bar bstan pa lags//

zhes bshad yong dus mtshan med ma rtogs pa la thar pa mtshan nyid pa mi thob pa gsungs yag rgyu mtshan 'di mtshan med 'di ga re zer na/ 'di skabs la sems kyi steng la mtshan 'dzin phra ba 'di spangs ma thub na gsungs pa red/ sems la bcom ldan 'das kyis dper na/ yum gyi nang la gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi/ sems ni sems ma mchis te/ sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba'o// zer yag 'di 'dra'i gnas tshul 'di ma rtogs pa'i bar la mtshan 'dzin phra ba 'di spang thub kyi ma red/ ces mtshan 'dzin phra ba 'di spangs ma thub na/ thar pa mtshan nyid pa thob mi thub pa gsungs pa yin pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus yod pa ma yin zer yag 'di don dam pa la zhes lab pa red/ sems nyid kho rang bden pa red pas zer na/ sems nyid kho rang don dam pa la bden pa yod red pas zer na/ don dam pa'am 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi ngo la sems nyid kho rang yang bden pa yod red pas zer na/ bden pa yang yod ma red/ rdzun pa yang yod ma red/ bden rdzun gang gi ngor yang yod pa ma yin gsungs pa red 'dug /bden pa'i ngo la yang yod pa ma red/ rdzun pa'i ngo la yang yod pa ma red/ ces sems nyid don dam pa'i bden pa gtso bo bshad yong dus 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag gis gzigs pa'i ngo la sems nyid kho rang don dam pa la bden rdzun gang gi ngo la yang yod pa ma yin/ zhes yod pa ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di ga re 'grig pa red zer na/ rgyal bas ma gzigs pa'i chos gsungs pa red/ rgyal bas kyang ma gzigs zhes rgyal bas kyang ma gzigs zer na/ rgyal ba la khungs gtugs dgos yag rgyu mtshan 'di rgyal ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad kyi yin lugs phyin ci ma log pa gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa tshad ma yod red/ 'di 'dra'i mkhyen pa tshad ma yod mkhan gyis chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab mthar thug pa mnga' ba'i ston pa bcom ldan 'das skyes bu tshad ma de lta bu 'dis sems yod pa ma yin pa sems 'di yod pa ma gzigs pa red/

'di las lhag pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di sgrub yag med pa red/ yod pa ma yin zer yag rgyu mtshan 'di spyir btang gi sems yod ma red zer ba ma yin pa don dam dbang btsan pa'i sgo nas bshad yong dus don dam pa'i bden pa dbang btsan po byed na 'grig gi 'dug /don dam pa'i bden pa dbang btsan po'am 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag gi gzigs pa 'di yi ngo la/ gzigs ngo de ltar yod pa ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gzigs pa'i phyir/ zhes rgyu mtshan 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi ngo la ma gzigs pa yin pa red/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gzigs zer yag 'di bcom ldan 'das skyes bu tshad ma yin pa'i cha nas bshad yong ba red/ mkhyen pa tshad ma yod pa'i cha nas ma gzigs pa red/ 2 'khor 'das kyi gzhi bstan pa/ 'o na bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang ma gzigs pa yin dus sems med pa red pas/ 'o na med pa red pas zer na/ med pa yang ma red/ med pa ma yin 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi// zhes kun rdzob tu yang sems med pa ma red/ ces yang bden pa gnyis la sbyar dgos pa red/ bden pa gnyis la ma sbyar na/ sems yod pa yang ma red/ med pa yang ma red zer na/ kho rang spyir btang gi gnas lugs kyi thog nas bshad yong na kho ma 'grig pa yod ma red de yin na yang*/ ngo sprod yong dus bden pa gnyis la ma sbyar dus tog tsam ca zing po yod pa red 'dug /da spyir btang gi ngo thog kho rang la bshad yong dus chos nyid kho rang dbang btsan po byed nas bshad yong dus nyams su myong ba'i tshul gyis bshad yong dus kho don dam pa dang*/ kun rdzob tu zhes 'di 'dra bshad dgos yag gang yang med pa red/ kun rdzob tu med pa yang ma red/ don dam pa la yod pa'ang ma red/ ces 'di 'dra lab ma dgos pa red/ kho ga re zer na/ chos nyid kyi gnas lugs 'di mthong tshar dus kho bden gnyis gang gi ngo la yang kho gcig pa dgos kyi yod red/

yin na yang ngo sprod yong dus 'di 'dra byas ma bshad na/ lta ba la nor nyen yod red/ 'di 'dra yin dus 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ stong pa nyid la lta nyes na// shes rab chung rnams phung par 'gyur// gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis lta ba nyes pa chags pa yin na/ shes rab chung ba'i skabs stong pa nyid kyi gnas tshul ji bzhin du mthong ma thub na/ nyes skyon chen po yong gi yod red/ ces 'di 'dra yin pa yin dus bden pa gnyis la sbyar dgos pa red/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bden pa gnyis la ma bstan pa'i chos med pa yin dus bden pa gnyis la sbyar nas bshad yong dus don dam par bden pa yod pa ma yin/ zhes sems nyid bden pa yod pa ma yin/ zhes kun rdzob tu med pa yang ma yin zhes kun rdzob tu med pa ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ga re bshad yag yod red pas zer nas rgyu mtshan 'di 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi zhes lab pa red/ mar 'khor ba 'khor mkhan yod red/ yar mya ngan las 'das pa thob mkhan yod red/ 'di yong mkhan 'di rtsa ba gang red zer na/ rtogs pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba las thar pa red/ ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba la 'khrul pa yin pa red/ 'di byed bcug mkhan 'di ga re red zer na/ sems 'di yod nas byung ba red ma gtogs/ 'di 'dzin pa'i sems zhes pa 'di rtsa ba nyid nas med pa yin na/ kun rdzob tu yang med pa yin na/ 'khor ba 'khor mkhan yong gi ma red/ myang 'das thob mkhan yong gi ma red pa/ 'di 'dra yin dus bden gnyis rtogs pa la brten nas mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/ bden gnyis ma rtogs pa la brten nas 'khor ba zhes yong gi yod red/ 'di med na kho 'di sgrub thub yag ma red/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis chos dbyings bstod pa'i nang la gsungs pa nang bzhin/

khams yod na ni las byas pas// sa le sbram dag mthong bar 'gyur// khams med na ni las byas pas// nyon mongs ngal ba tsam du zad// ces khams yod na ni las byas na yang dper na/ gser la bsregs bcad brdar gsum byed yong dus sa le sbram mthong thub kyi yod red/ dka' las rgyab na yang don dag yod red/ ces khams rtsa ba nyid nas med pa yin na 'khor 'das thams cad kyi bya ba byed thub yag gi gzhi 'dra po zhig rtsa ba nyid nas med pa yin na/ nyon mongs pa ngal ba tsam zhig red ma gtogs thar pa sgrub pa la dka' ba spyad pa don mi 'dug gsungs pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis dgongs pa gtso bo ston yong dus 'di red ces gsungs kyi yod red/ 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi zer yag 'di red pas/ de ga nang bzhin gyi dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab nang la/ rgyal ba rnams kyis stong pa nyid// lta kun nges par 'byin pa gsungs// gang dag stong pa nyid lta ba// de dag sgrub tu med par gsungs// zhes gsungs pa red/ bcom ldan 'das kyis stong pa nyid gsungs dgos yag rgyu mtshan 'di ga re red zer na/ lta ba nges 'byin gyi gnyen po la gsungs pa red/ lta ba thams cad lta ba ngan pa 'di sun 'byin pa'i ched du gsungs pa red/ 'di yin dus stong pa nyid la phyin ci log tu zhen song ba yin na/ de ltar sgrub tu med par gsungs pa yin pa red/ 'di yin dus med pa las gzhan gsungs pa yin na mi 'grig pa red/ med pa kho na la zhen pa yin na sa ra hās gsungs pa red/ dngos por 'dzin pa phyugs dang 'dra ba ste// dngos med 'dzin pa de bas kyang ni blun// zhes gsungs pa red/ 'di yin pa'i skabs la yang med pa zer yag gi med pa'i tshad 'dra po 'di yag po byas nas ma shes na/ spyir yod ma red ces lab bzhag na 'grig gi yod ma red/ yang yod red ces bshad na yang yod pa'i tshad 'dra po zhig sgrub ma thub na/

mi 'grig pa red 'dug /'di yin dus bden pa gnyis la sbyar yong dus don dam par sems nyid don dam par bden par ma grub pa red ces 'di ma grub ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang 'dra po chos thams cad kyi yin lugs phyin ci ma log par gzigs pa'i bden gnyis kyi gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par gzigs pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen pa tshad ma 'dis ma gzigs pa red/ med pa yang ma yin te/ mngon sum la skur pa btab pa red/ 'khor ba 'khor mkhan yod red/ myang 'das thob mkhan yod red/ 'khor 'das kyi bya ba 'di gang la brten nas 'byung ba red zer na/ sems nyid yod pa la brten nas 'byung ba red/ ces 'di sgrub yong ba red 'dug /'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi/ 3 zung 'jug dbu ma'i lam bstan pa/ 'o na 'gal 'du red pas zer na/ sems 'di yod med gnyis ka la bshad yag 'dra po zhig yod pa ma yin zer dus yang med bsdad mkhan 'dra bo zhig 'dug /med pa ma yin zer ba'i skabs la yang yod bsdad mkhan 'dra po zhig bshad bsdad kyi 'dug /'di 'dra yin dus kho yod med gnyis ka sems chos shig gi steng la 'gal 'du 'dra po zhig chags bsdad kyi 'dug zer na/ 'gal 'du ma yin te zung 'jug dbu ma'i lam red/ ces sems kyi gnas lugs 'di ni dper na yod med gnyis ka la bshad pa yin na khyed rang gzhi gcig la dngos po chos gnyis mi srid pa yin pa yin dus ngo bo bdag gcig pa zhig la chos gnyis mi srid pa yin dus 'di 'gal 'du chags 'gro gi red/ sems la dwogs pa za yag 'di kho tan tan yong gi red de/ yin na yang sgro skur rtag chad kyi mtha' 'gog pa tsam gyis yod pa la sgro 'dogs pa dang*/ med pa la skur pa btab pa'i rtag chad kyi mtha' 'gog pa tsam zhig bstan pa red ma gtogs mtha' 'di 'gags tshar ba'i skabs su yang de lta bu zhig dgos kyi red/ ces tshur sgrub yag gang yang med pa red/

dbu ma'i lam gyi skabs la/ kun rtog thams cad phar spangs tshar ba'i skabs su kho thar pa ga re yod pa 'di tshur mngon dus byed pa red ma gtogs 'di phar spangs pa'i shugs la 'di tshur sgrub dgos red zer yag skad cha gang yang med pa red/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ kun rtog thams cad spangs pa'i phyir// stong nyid bdud rtsi 'thung byed de// gang zhig de la zhen gyur pa// de yang khyed kyis spangs pa lags// zhes bshad yong dus kun rtog thams cad spangs tshar ba'i mjug 'di la da rung yang stong pa nyid zer yag cig yod red sems byas nas zhen pa yin na de yang mi 'grig pa red/ de yang bcom ldan 'das khyed kyis spangs pa lags gsungs pa red/ 'di yin dus 'gal 'du ma yin zung 'jug zer yag 'di ga re/ kun rdzob bden pa dang*/ don dam bden pa gnyis po'am snang tshul dang stong tshul gnyis po 'di/ 'di ni zung du 'jug pa zhes lab pa red/ zung du 'jug pa dbu ma'i lam zhes dbu ma zer yag 'di/ rtag chad gnyis kyi mtha' spangs pa yi lam dbu ma zhes lab pa red/ yod pa la zhen pa 'di rtag pa red/ med pa la zhen pa 'di chad pa yin pa red/ 4 yod med gnyis kyi mtha' sel tshul/ 'di 'dra yin dus snang ba dang stong pa gnyis byas snang bas ga re dgag pa red zer na/ snang bas med mtha' sel ba yin pa red/ stong pas ga re byas pa red zer na/ yod mtha' sel ba red/ nga tsho spyir btang gi chos lugs mang che bas 'di rang gsung gis yod red ba/ snang stong zung 'jug zhes bshad yong dus zung du 'jug yag 'di snang bas med mtha' sel thub yag dang*/ stong pas yod mtha' sel thub pa red/ yin na yang rje rin po ches/ yang 'di las log ga zhig byas nas stong pas med mtha' sel thub yag dang*/ snang bas yod mtha' sel thub pa zhig gi thog nas gsal cha zhig gsung gi yod red/ 'di yang tshig 'di la snang zhes bshad yong dus gzhi kho rang bden pa ma grub pa'i cha nas bshad yong dus snang zer yag gi kho rang gzhi kho rang bden par ma grub pa tshig gis mtshon thub kyi red/

ces 'di 'dra yin dus snang zhes pa'i tshig kho rang gis kyang yod pa'i mtha' sel thub kyi red/ stong zer dus stong gzhi zhig bshad dgos ba red ma gtogs stong gzhi med par stong pa yong gi red ces 'di yin dus stong zer yag 'di yang kho ga re/ med mtha' zhig sel thub kyi red ces lab pa red/ yod pa'i shugs kyis tshur yong thub kyi red/ yang tshig 'di yang bkral stangs ma 'dra ba zhig yong gi yod red/ 'di gnyis gcig pa yin pa red/ gang ltar ga ba sbyar na yang 'di 'dra yin dus zung 'jug dbu ma'i lam zer ba 'di phar sgro skur gyi rtag chad kyi mtha' phar bkag nas de nas mtha' de dag gang la yang ma zhen pa mtha' 'di gang du yang grub rgyu med pa grub rgyu yi chos rdul tsam yang med pa zhig la dbu ma'i lam zhes lab pa red/ zab mo'i lam zer ba 'di mtha' thams cad 'gog pas lam dbu ma 'di la de nas mtha' bral sems kyi chos nyid rtogs par shog /de lta bu 'di'i steng la slebs nas zhes 'di nas mtha' dang bral ba sems kyi ngo bo 'di ga re red/ mtha' bzhi dang spros pa brgyad la sogs pa gang gi ngo bo la yang yod ma red/ de med pa yin dus/ mtha' bral sems kyi chos nyid rtogs par shog /gsungs pa red 'dug /sems kyi chos nyid zer yag 'di sems kyi rang bzhin sems kyi ngo bo sems kyi mtshan nyid ga re yin na yang sems kyis ma bcos pa 'di rtogs par shog gsung ba red/ na yin min gyi mtha' spong ba/ 'di yin zhes pa gang gis mtshon pa med// 'di min zhes bya gang gis bkag pa med// blo las 'das pa'i chos nyid 'dus ma byas// yang dag don gyi mtha' ni nges par shog / 1 don dam par gang gis kyang mtshon mi thub pa/ de yi gong la bshad pa 'di spyir btang gcig pa gcig kyang red/ yin na yang tog tsam zhig mi 'dra ba 'di/ 'di yin zhes pa gang gis mtshon pa med// ces 'di yin zer ba'i skabs la chos nyid kyi gnas tshul 'di la stong pa nyid zer nas lab na yang red/

skye ba med pa zhes lab na yang red/ spros pa dang bral ba red ces lab na yang red/ don dam pa zhes lab na yang red/ de nang bzhin ming ga tshod mang po btags na yang don dam par ming ga tshod mang po btags na yang ga tshod cig btags/ ga tshod bsnyad/ ga tshod byas na yang gnas lugs kyi rang bzhin de mtshon thub kyi ma red ces lab pa red/ dpe gang gis kyang mtshon thub kyis ma red/ brjod pa gang gis kyang mtshon thub kyis ma red gsung ba red/ dpe dang*/ tshig dang*/ tha snyad thams cad las 'das pa yin pa red/ dpes mtshon thub kyi ma red zer ba 'di mtshon mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di gang red zer na kho kun rdzob tu blo kun rdzob pa'i yul las 'das pa yin pa red/ blo kun rdzob pa'i yul las 'das pa/ don dam pa'i bden pa 'di gnyis 'dzin gyi nang log la ji bzhin du rtogs mi thub pa yin pa red/ 'di rtogs mi thub pa yin dus kho dpe gang gis kyang mtshon mi thub pa/ brjod pa gang nas kyang 'das pa yin pa red/ phra phyir thos pa'i yul min te// don dam yin phyir bsam bya'i min// chos nyid zab phyir 'jig rten pa'i// sgom pa la sogs yul ma yin// zhes rgyud bla ma la gsungs pa yin dus shin tu phra ba'i cha nas 'jig rten pa'i thos pa'i yul ma yin zhes/ phra phyir thos pa'i yul min zhes don dam pa yin pa'i phyir na 'jig rten pa'i bsam pa'i yul las 'das pa red/ chos nyid shin tu zab pa'i phyir na 'jig rten pa'i sgom pa las 'das pa red zer/ 'di 'dra yin dus gang gis kyang mtshon mi thub pa yin gsung ba 'di yin pa red/ 2 don dam par gang gis kyang bkag mi thub pa/ 'di min zhes bya gang gis bkag pa med// dbu ma'i skabs su bden pa gnyis bshad yong ba'i skabs su skye ba bkag gi yod red/ gcig yod ma red zer gyi yod red/ du ma yod ma red zer gyi yod red/ bden pa grub pa yod ma red zer gyi yod red/

mtha' thams cad bkag bsdad kyi yod red/ mtha' thams cad bkag yong ba'i skabs su mtha' bkag pa de'i nang log la chos nyid kho rang bkag thub kyi red pas zer na 'di bkag thub kyi ma red/ bkag mi thub pa yin dus de ma yin zhes bya ba gang gis kyang bkag thub kyi ma red zer ba red/ stong pa nyid kyi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa gtan la phab yong dus de nas bden par ma grub pa dang*/ snang tsam zhig red ma gtogs kho rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa gtan la phab yong dus gang yang yod ma red/ gcig kyang yod ma red/ du ma yang yod ma red/ rtag pa yang yod ma red/ chad pa yang yod ma red/ ces rtag pa dang chad pa thams cad bkag yong dus 'di'i nang la chos nyid 'di bkag 'gro gi red pas zer na bkag thub kyi ma red ces lab pa red/ chos nyid kho rang bkag thub kyi yod ma red/ 'di yin dus bkag kyang thub kyi yod ma red/ kho ga tshod cig bkag pa yin na yang gcig du bral la sogs par rtag pa dang chad pa la sogs par ga tshod bkag na yang chos nyid 'di phar gsal du btang yag dang*/ chos nyid la phar thag nye ru 'gro yag gi thabs shig bstan bsdad kyi yod red ma gtogs chos nyid bkag thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ dbu ma rgyan gyi nang la/ yang dag tu na spros pa yi// tshogs rnams kun las de grol yin// skye la sogs pa med pa'i phyir// skye ba med la sogs mi srid// gsungs 'dug a/ 'o 'di 'dra yin dus yang dag pa la dgag bya 'gog byed thams cad dang bral ba yin pa red/ chos nyid kyi gnas lugs kyi steng la dgag bya yod ma red/ 'gog byed yod ma red/ sbyang bya yod ma red/ sbyong byed yod ma red/ sbyangs 'bras gang yang yod ma red/ chos nyid gnas lugs kyi steng la dbu ma bden gnyis kyi nang la/ skye ba la sogs bkag pa yang*// yang dag pa dang mthun pa'i phyir// zhes/ yang dag pa dang mthun phyir 'dod//

ces lab yong ba'i skabs su skye ba med pa la sogs bkag yag 'di yang dag pa dngos po yang dag pa'i mtha' dang mthun pa tsam zhig thog nas bkag pa red ma gtogs/ don dam pa la dgag bya 'gog byed kyi mtha' thams cad dang bral ba zhig bshad dgos kyi yod red/ 'di red ma gtogs yang dag pa la dgag bya dang 'gog byed gnyis med pa red/ 'di yin dus 'di yin zhes mtshon mi thub pa byas/ 'di min zhes byas nas chos nyid kyi steng la pha bkag yag med pa/ 'di 'dra'i chos nyid 'di ga re zer na blo las 'das pa red ces lab pa red/ 3 chos nyid blo las 'das par bstan pa/ blo zer ba 'di blo kun rdzob pa'am blo gnyis 'dzin can/ blo gnyis su 'dzin pa'i blo'am blo kun rdzob pa'i blo las 'das pa yin gsungs pa red/ blo las 'das pa'i chos nyid/ chos nyid zer yag 'di ye gdod ma nas gshis la 'pho 'gyur med pa'i cha nas chos nyid ces lab pa red/ 'dus ma byas pa zer na'ang gcig pa red/ gang ltar skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba'i cha nas 'dus ma byas pa zer ba red/ 'dus ma byas zer yag 'di skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba/ kho spyir btang gi btags pa'i tshig cig red/ kho skad cig ma ma yin pa'i chos shig la/ 'dus ma byas zhes btags kyi yod pa yin dus/ de lta bu bden gnyis nang la yang*/ yang dag tu na gnyis med de// 'di ni spros pa med pa yin// 'jam dpal gyis ni yang dag zhus// rgyal ba'i sras pos mi gsungs bzhugs// gsungs pa red/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rgyal ba'i sras po la zhus yong dus spros pa med pa'i mtha' 'di ga 'dra zhig red ces zer nas bka' 'dri zhus yong dus rgyal ba'i sras pos ma gsung nas bzhugs pa red/ ma gsung nas bzhugs dgos yag rgyu mtshan gang red zer na/ kho skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba'i gshis kho rang la 'pho 'gyur dang bral ba yin pa yin dus/ 'di dpe dang*/

tshig dang*/ tha snyad kyi thog nas mtshon ma thub pa yin dus ma gsung bar bzhugs yong ba red 'dug /ma gsung bar bzhugs yong dus ma gsung bar bzhugs pa gang yin pa de gsung rgyu med nas gsung ma thub nas ma gsung bar bzhugs pa ma red/ yin na yang gsung bya gsung byed dang bral yong dus ma gsung bar bzhugs pa yin pa red/ ma gsung bar bzhugs pa gang yin pa de yang dag don gyi mtha' ni nges par shog gsungs pa red/ 4 yang dag don gyi mtha' ngos bzung ba/ yang dag pa'i don gyi mtha' zer ba 'di gang red/ chos thams cad kyi mthar thug gi skyel sa 'dra po 'di red/ chos thams cad kyi mthar thug gi babs sa'am skyel sa 'dra po 'di yang dag pa'i mtha' yin pa red/ chos nyid kyi gzigs pa dbang btsan po byas nas bshad yong dus chos nyid gzigs pa'i ngo la mthar thug gi kho rang babs sa 'dra po ga re yod pa 'di yang dag pa'i mtha' yin pa red/ 'di yin dus mdo sngags gnyis kyi skabs la lta ba la khyad par med pa red/ 'di skabs la dgag bya med pa dang bsgrub bya med pa/ dgag sgrub gnyis kyi mtha' las 'das pa'i chos nyid gnas lugs 'di dbang btsan po bshad yong dus/ spyir lam gyi rnam grangs che chung mang nyung gi khyad par dang zab mi zab kyi khyad par phran bu yong gi red/ lam lta ba 'gro stangs kyi thog la yang mdo sngags gnyis la khyad par med pa red/ dus 'khor skabs la/

phra rab rdul gyi chos las 'das// zer ba 'di gang ltar phra rab rdul gyi chos 'di kun rdzob kyi blo kun rdzob pa'i chos las 'das dgos ba yin pa dang 'di 'dra 'di 'phags pa ye shes kyis gzigs pa kho na'i yul du 'gyur ba ma gtogs 'jig rten pa'i blo kun rdzob kyi blo'i spyod yul du 'gyur ma thub pa yin pa'i cha nas phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid de gsung ba red/ 'di yin dus chos thams cad kyi mthar thug gi skyel sa 'dra po 'di spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i gnas lugs de'i steng la nges par shog ces nges par shog zer yag 'di nges shes skye thub par shog gsungs pa red/ nges shes skye bar byas pa la dang po tshad ma sngon du 'gro dgos kyi yod red/ tshad ma med na nges shes skye thub kyi ma red/ pa stong dang rten 'byung zung 'jug mi 'gal bar bstan pa/ 'di nyid ma rtogs 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'khor// 'di nyid rtogs na sangs rgyas gzhan na med// thams cad 'di yin 'di min gang yang med// chos nyid kun gzhi'i mtshang ni rig par shog / 1 ma rtogs dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams par bstan pa/ 'di ma rtogs pa'i de lta bu'i gnas lugs 'di sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la yod red/ yin na yang ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba la 'khor ba yin pa red/ rang gi rang chas su yod red/ yin na yang ma rtogs pa red/ 'di yin dus ma rtogs 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khor/ zhes ma rtogs zer yag 'di ga re/ yod nas ma rtogs pa red ma gtogs med nas ma rtogs pa ma red/ rang la ye gdod ma nas rang chas su yod red/ rang chas su yod na yang ma rig pa dang*/ las dang nyon mongs pas sgrib pa'i dbang gis ma rtogs pa yin pa red/ rgyud bla ma'i nang log la/ dpe dgu dang don dgu yis gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis thog nas sgrib song ba yin pa red/ 'di bla ma'i man ngag dang*/ thabs khyad par can la bsten nas bshad yong dus tsam pa la/

de nas rtogs yong ba red/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla mas dus thabs ston pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'di/ bla mas dus thabs ston pa dang*/ bdag gi bsod nams gnyis la brten nas rtogs dgos pa yin pa red/ 'di rtogs na 'khor ba las thar pa yin pa red/ 'di ma rtogs kyi bar la 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khor ba yin pa red/ don med par 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin pa red/ rang gi rang bzhin rang 'khor ba la thar yag gi thabs kyi chos nyid kyi gnas tshul 'di rang la rang chas su yod par rmongs pa'i dbang gis ma rtogs nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khor/ 'di skabs la rten 'brel lugs 'byung gi thog nas 'khor yong ba red/ ma rig pa nas rga shi'i bar la mar rten 'brel gyi lugs 'byung gi tshul gyi 'khor ba la 'khor tshul bshad pa red/ 'di nyid rtogs na zhes 'di 'dra'i gnas tshul 'di rang la ye gdod ma nas rang chas su yod pa 'di rtogs/ rang la 'du 'bral med pa zhig gi thog nas yod pa rtogs thub pa yin na sangs rgyas gzhan na med/ ces sangs rgyas rang gi sems nas rnyed pa yin pa red/ 'di skabs la lugs ldog gi rten 'brel la brten nas sangs rgyas pa/ rten 'brel lugs ldog gi thog nas sgrub pa yin pa red/ 2 rang la yod pa'i gnas lugs las sangs rgyas gzhan na med pa/ sangs rgyas gzhan na med zer yag 'di sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob yag gzhan dag gcig na 'gro sa gang yang med pa red/ gang ltar rang la yod pa'i gnas lugs 'di mngon du 'gyur yong ba'i skabs su sangs rgyas thob pa yin pa'i cha nas sangs rgyas gzhan du sgrub mi dgos pa red/ rje btsun mi las dwags po la gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis/ lta ba yin pa nges kyi sems la ltos// sems las gzhan pa'i lta ba btsal ba ni// gyad kyi nor 'tshol dang 'dra bo ang nge lha rje ston pa ba//

gsungs pa 'di rang gi sems la ltos gsungs pa red/ ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// sems nyid cir yang grub pa med// grub pa med pa'i sems nyid la// sna tshogs snang ba ngo mtshar che// zer yag 'di da ga rang gi sems la blta dgos yag dang*/ de nas sems kho rang la blta zer dus ga re red yul dang yul can 'dra po blta rgyu ma yin pa/ yul dang yul can gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis blta dgos pa yin pa red/ yul ci yang ma grub pa la yul can gyis ci yang mi mthong ba'i tshul gyis blta dgos pa red/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyang ma gzigs/ ma 'ongs pa'i chos thams cad kyang gzigs par mi 'gyur/ da lta ba'i chos thams cad kyang mi gzigs pa'i gzigs pa chen po zer nas bshad dgos yag 'di gzigs pa chen po 'di/ yul dang yul can gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis rtogs dgos pa zhig ma gtogs/ yul dang yul can gnyis su 'dzin pa'i thog nas rtogs pa yin na sems la/ yul dang yul can gnyis su sems la sems kyis blta yong dus gnyis su 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis rtogs pa yin na/ de nas rang rig la sems dbu ma pa'i dgag pa ga re rgyab pa de yong gi yod red/ de skabs la skyon 'di 'dra yin dus sangs rgyas gzhan na med zer yag 'di/ rang gi rang chas su yod bsdad pa'i chos nyid kyi gnas lugs sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal dang*/ stong pa nyid zung du 'jug pa'i chos nyid kyi gnas tshul 'di/ rang gi sems la ye nas 'du bral med pa'i tshul gyi yod pa 'di lta bu 'di/ bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas rtogs thub pa yin na de nas sangs rgyas sems la rnyed pa red gsungs pa red/ da lta 'pho ba'i rim pa'i nang la/ 'pho bya 'pho byed med pa'i bya btang gis// lus gnas ye shes brjod med phyag rgya che// de las gud na sangs rgyas gzhan na med// rang grol dwags po bka' brgyud 'grub gyur cig

/ da de las gud na sangs rgyas gzhan na med pa rtogs dgos yag gi rgyu mtshan 'di/ rang gi sems da lta nga rang tsho'i nyon mongs pa'i rnam rtog 'ching ba kun ldan yod bsdad pa 'di snang tshul tsam gyi thog nas 'khor ba'i 'khrul tshul zhig bshad bsdad kyi yod red ma gtogs/ 'di yi rang bzhin gyis yang dag pa rtogs thub pa yin na 'di rang gnas lugs sam don dam pa'i yin lugs 'di rang yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi rtogs thub pa yin na/ 'di rang bzhin 'di 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin 'di lta bu 'di rtogs na/ don dam pa'i rang bzhin rtogs thub pa yin na sangs rgyas gud na med pa dang*/ sangs rgyas sems la rnyed pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di bshad pa red 'dug / 3 chos dbyings dgag sgrub thams cad dang bral ba/ 'di yin dus thams cad 'di yin 'di min gang yang med/ nga tsho grub mtha' 'dra po zhig la bstun byas khas len gyi 'dzin mtshams 'dra po zhig la bsam blo btang nas 'di red/ gnas lugs zer na 'di 'dra zhig red/ 'khor ba zer mkhan de 'dra zhig yod red/ myang 'das zer na 'di 'dra zhig yod red zer nas ga tshod rgya chen po bshad/ ga tshad lung mang po drangs/ ga tshad rigs pa mang pos bsgrubs na yang kho rgyu mtshan zhe drag yod ma red gsungs pa red/ de 'dra red zer nas nga rang tshos ga tshod bshad nas bsgrub bsdad pa yin na yang kho bsgrub thub yag yod ma red/ de ma red zer nas ga tshod bkag pa yin na yang bkag thub yag yod ma red/ chos dbyings kyi gnas lugs 'di ni dgag grub thams cad las bral ba yin pa red/ 'di 'dra yin dus gnas lugs zer yag 'di 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab yod red/ khyab thub kyi yod red/ rgyud bla ma nang la/ sa ni chu dang chu rlung la// rlung ni mkha' la rab tu gnas// mkha' ni rlung dang chu dag dang*// sa yi khams la gnas ma yin// nam mkha' sa chu me rlung de yang gcig gi gcig la nam mkha' la sa chu me rlung gis bya ba byed kyi yod red de nam mkha' la sa chu me rlung gis gos ma thub pa'i dpe zhig bshad 'dug a/

de bzhin du nyon mongs pa'i yid dang rnam par shes pa la sogs pa thams cad kyis nga rang tsho'i sems la sgrib bsdad kyi yod red de/ yin na yang sems kho rang ga ba yin na yang rnam par shes pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis ma gos par sems nyid kho rang ni rnam par shes pa'i tshogs thams cad las tha dad par rnam pa kun tu ldan yod red zer nas/ rgyud bla ma la dpe dang dpe can gyis thog nas brgyab yod red/ 'di gcig pa yin pa red/ de 'dra yin dus gnas lugs kho rang 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab bsdad yod red/ ma khyab pa'i chos gcig kyang med pa red/ phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched la sogs pa thams cad de yang nga rang gi sems nyid steng du brten yod red de/ sems nyid de'i ngo la phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched kyis yar gos thub kyi yod ma red/ sems nyid 'dis 'khor 'das kyi phung po khams dang*/ skye mched la phar dbang du byed thub kyi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus gnas lugs kyis 'khor 'das thams cad la khyab bsdad pa yin pa'i phyir na thams cad la 'di yin 'di min zer nas gang yang bkag thub yag med pa red/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang*/ rten cing 'brel byung ma yin pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// de phyir stong nyid ma yin pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// zhes bshad yong dus chos thams cad rten 'brel du bsgrub/ de yi phyir na stong pa nyid yin pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad song a/ de 'dra yin dus rten 'brel yin pa'i cha nas stong nyid sgrub yong dus de yin pa bsgrub yag dang*/ de min pa bkag yag gang yang med pa red/ 4 kun gzhi bde gshegs snying po'i mtshang rig par bstan pa/ don dag ngo ma ga re rtogs dgos red zer na/ chos nyid kun gzhi'i mtshang ni rig par shog /gsungs pa red/ de skabs la kun gzhi zer ba'i kun gzhi 'di sems tsam pa'i skabs nas bshad pa'i kun gzhi 'di go rgyu yod ma red/

spyir btang kun gzhi zer ba 'di bde gshegs snying po la kun gzhi zer ba'i tha snyad cig yod red/ stong pa nyid la kun gzhi'i sgra sbyar ba'i skabs shig kyang yod red/ de nas yang sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi rang bzhin de la yang kun gzhi zhes pa'i tha snyad sbyar gyi yod red/ byams chos nang la rgyud bla ma'i skabs la de 'dra yin dus de skabs la chos nyid zer yag 'di rnam thar sgo gsum la sbyar na 'grig gi yod red/ dbu ma thal 'gyur pa'i skabs la/ rgyu mtshan ma med pa/ 'bras bu smon pa med pa/ ngo bo stong pa nyid gsum la sbyar nas chos nyid bshad pa dang*/ kun gzhi zer ba 'di rgyu mtshan ma med pa/ 'bras bu smon pa med pa/ ngo bo stong pa nyid gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa'i mthar thug gi gsal stong zung 'jug de la kun gzhi sbyar nas rgyu rkyen 'dra po zhig la sbyar nas bshad kyi yod sa red/ de 'dra yin dus rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i chos 'khor 'das kun la khyab bsdad yag gi gnas lugs 'di/ mtshang 'dra po mtshang zer na gnad ka 'dra po 'di rig bsdad par shog gsungs pa red/ rig par shog zer ba 'di rig thub par shog gsungs pa yin pa red/ mthong thub pa yin par shog / pha de ltar brtags pas gzhi rtsa chod par smon pa/ snang yang sems la stong yang sems yin te// rtogs kyang sems la 'khrul yang rang gi sems// skyes kyang sems la 'gags kyang sems yin pas// sgro 'dogs thams cad sems la chod par shog / 1 snang stong thams cad sems yin par bstan pa/ sems zer ba 'di yang spyir btang gi nga tshos snang stong dbyer med zer gyi yod red/ grags stong dbyer med zer gyi yod red/ rig stong dbyer med zer gyi yod red/ bde stong dbyer med zer gyi yod red/ mang po zhig la dbyer med dbyer med mang po rgyab kyi yod red/ yag shos 'di ga ba brgyab kyi yod red zer na sems kho rang gi steng la brgyab kyi yod red/

'khor 'das kyi snang tshul 'dra mi 'dra mang po ga tshod snang gi yod na yang de thams cad rtsa ba 'di sems las byung ba yin pa red/ dang po sems las byung ba yin pa red/ sems las tshur 'phros pa yin pa red/ sems kyi rtsal snang yin pa red/ sems kyi rang rtsal yin pa red/ sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pa red/ de 'dra yin dus snang tshul ga 'dra zhig yin na yang ma dag pa 'khor ba'i chos snang ba red/ dag pa sku dang ye shes kyi snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang po bshad kyi yod red/ de ga re snang ba yin na yang de thams cad de sems kyi cho 'phrul red/ sems kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa red lab pa red/ stong zhes bshad yong ba'i skabs su de ma yin pa'i chos shig gzhan gnas su stong pa nyid sgrub myong ba 'dra po ma yin pa da lta khyod rang gis bshad bsdad yag gi sems kyi snang tshul 'di lta bu 'di rang stong pa nyid bshad kyi yod red/ de yang stong zer yag gi stong de rang gi ngo bo stong pa rang rang gi ngo bos stong pa 'di 'dra po go rgyu ma yin pa don dam pa'i gnas lugs de la gzhan kun rdzob pa'i glo bur gyi 'khrul pa'i dri mas stong pa'i cha de la bshad pa red 'dug a/ de yang sems rang yin gsungs pa red/ snang yang sems la stong yang sems yin te// 2 'khrul rtogs thams cad sems yin par bstan pa/ rtogs kyang sems la 'khrul yang rang gi sems// gnas lugs kyi don dam pa'i bden pa de mngon sum du rtogs nas 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag la brten nas chos thams cad kyi yin lugs de phyin ci ma log par rtogs nas de nas 'bras bu thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mngon du byas nas mngon du byas yag de yang rtsa ba sems la brten nas byung ba red/ sems kyis steng nas rtogs dgos yag red/ sems la ma brten pa'i rtogs bya med pa red/ ma rtogs nas bag chags dang las dang nyon mongs pa'i mtshams sbyar nas ma rig pa la brten nas dper na 'khor ba'i rten 'brel lugs 'byung gi thog nas 'khor ba 'khrul tshul de yang rtsa ba sems la brten nas 'byung ba red/

rtogs pa de yang sems la bzhag dgos pa red/ 'khrul na yang rang gi sems red/ sems kyi steng nas snang tshul 'dra mi 'dra 'byung ba red ma gtogs/ rtogs pa dang 'khrul pa gnyis ka de yang log gcig nas zur du 'byung ba ma yin par da lta'i 'khrul snang de ka rang sems red/ da lta'i 'khrul snang de yin par shes na de rtogs pa red/ de gnyis ka yang rtsa ba sems kyis byas pa red/ sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pa red/ sems kyi byed las yin pa red/ 3 skye 'gags thams cad sems yin par bstan pa/ de ka nang bzhin gyi/ skyes kyang sems la 'gags kyang sems yin te// skyes zer yag 'di rnam rtog sna tshogs pa skyes kyi yod red/ de ka nang bzhin gyi gang dang gang yin na yang chos thams cad la nga tshos dang po skye 'gags gnas gsum 'di med par ma rtogs kyi bar la skye 'gags gnas gsum gyi steng la 'bad dgos rgyu yod red/ de 'dra yin dus skye ba yang rtsa ba sems la brten nas yong gi yod pa dang*/ skyes tshar nas 'gags pa yod pa red/ 'gag pa yang rtsa ba sems la brten nas 'byung ba red/ de 'dra yin dus 'khor 'das kyi yon tan zer na yang mi 'dug /'khor 'das kyi chos ga 'dra zhig dang po skye na yang sems kyis thog nas skye dgos kyi yod red/ 'khor 'das kyi chos gang 'dra zhig 'gag pa yin na yang de yang rtsa ba sems kyi steng la 'gag dgos rgyu yod red/ tshogs drug gi shes pa zer na yang mi 'dug /kun gzhi rnam shes zer na yang mi 'dug /nyon mongs pa'i yid zer na yang mi 'dug /de ma thag pa'i yid zer na yang mi 'dug /ga re btags pa yin na yang rtsa ba sems kho rang bzhag dgos pa red/ gtso sems kun 'gro lnga dang*/ sems byung lnga bcu lnga gcig gi thog nas 'gro dgos rgyu yod red/

4 sgro 'dogs thams cad sems la chod par bstan pa/ de 'dra yin dus skye 'gags dang rtogs pa dang 'khrul pa dang snang stong dang ga re yin na yang thams cad rtsa ba sems yin pas/ sgro 'dogs thams cad sems la chod par shog /shes rab kyis kha phar blta nas chos thams cad kyi steng la yang sgro 'dogs gcad yag med pa red 'dug a/ sgro 'dogs sems la chod pa'i rnal 'byor pa zer ba 'di sgro 'dogs 'di sems kyi steng la tshur gcad dgos yag yin pa red/ 'khor 'das kyi rnam gzhag 'di sems kyi steng la tshur sgrub dgos yag yin pa red/ skye 'gags dgag nas gnas tshul du sems kyi steng la tshur bsgrub dgos yag yin pa red/ rtogs pa dang 'khrul pa zer mkhan 'di sems kyi steng la tshur bsgrub dgos yag yin pa red ma gtogs/ snang tshul gyi chos de'i steng la phar kha bskor nas chos pha gi'i steng la phar snang tshul dang gzung ba'i yul gyi steng la phar sgro 'dogs gcad yag med pa red/ 'di bcad pas phan gyi yod ma red/ gzung ba'i yul de yang rtsa ba chos nyid kyi rang rtsal yin dus sems kho rang gi snang tshul la brten nas 'byung ba yin dus sems kho rang gi steng la sgro 'dogs gcod thub na snang tshul thams cad kyang kho sems kyi rang bzhin yin pa rtogs thub kyi red/ de yin dus sgro 'dogs sems la chod zer yag 'di ga re red/ sgro 'dogs zer yag 'di ga re red/ 'di skabs la sgro 'dogs zer yag 'di gtso bo 'di thag gcod yag la bshad pa red/ the tshom yin na yang mi 'dug /gang ltar thag gcod kyi gnas tshul 'di gtso bo 'di sems kyi steng la bcad dgos yag red 'dug /sems kyi steng la bcad thub na 'dzin pa'i sems kyi steng la bcad thub pa yin na gzung ba'i yul 'di rang bzhin med pa rtogs thub kyi yod red 'dug /de 'dra yin dus/ sgro 'dogs thams cad sems la chod par shog

/zer yag 'di sems kyi steng la tshur rtsad dar byed thub pa dang sems kyi steng la tshur the tshom gcod thub pa zhig la gsungs pa red 'dug / ba sgom pas nyams su len tshul mdor bstan pa/ blos byas rtsol ba'i sgom gyis ma bslad cing*// tha mal 'du 'dzi'i rlung gis ma bskyod par// ma bcos gnyug mar rang babs 'jog shes pa'i// sems don nyams len mkhas shing skyong bar shog / zhi gnas dang*/ lhag mthong la sogs pa mgo la yod pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i lam bshad bsdad yag gi sgom gyi rtsa ba 'dra po de la yang*/ dang po sgom mkhan de'i dang po skyon gyi cha thams cad 'di spangs yag la skyon 'di ngos 'dzin byed dgos rgyu yod red/ thun mong gi lam 'di dang po sbyangs dgos rgyu yod red/ thun mong gi lam la ma brten par thun mong ma yin pa'i lam la 'jug thub rgyu med pa yin dus dang po thun mong ba'i lam la brten nas skyon 'di spangs dgos rgyu yod red/ 'di yin dus rtsa ba kho rang la gros byed yin dus/ dang po de la blos byas spang dgos yag bshad pa dang*/ gnyis pa de la yang tha mal pa'i rnam rtog gi rlung gis spangs dgos yag bshad pa dang*/ 'di gnyis spangs pa'i ma bcos gnyug mar skyong yag 'di gsungs yod red/ yin na yang si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi 'grel pa'i nang log la dang po go rim 'dra po bsgrig yong dus/ tha mal 'du 'dzi'i rlung gis ma bskyod par// de tshig rkang dang por bzhag nas/ gnyis pa de la/ blos byas rtsol ba'i sgom gyis ma bslad cing*// gsum pa de la/ ma bcos gnyug ma rang bab 'jog shes pa'i// zer na go bde bo yod red/ tshig gi thog nas 'gros byas na yang*/ tha mal 'du 'dzi'i rlung gis ma bskyod pa 'di las dang po la skyon che shos yin pa red/ des na blos byas kyis rtsol ba'i sgom zer yag 'di/ tha mal 'du 'dzi'i rlung gis rnam rtog 'di tha mal pa'i 'du 'dzi 'di bsgom pa la dang po 'jug pa'i skyon 'di spangs thub pa yin na/

bar du mnyam par bzhag tshul 'di kho rim pas yong thub kyi red/ de yin dus dang po de ga re ha go dgos kyi red zer na tha mal 'du 'dzi'i rlung gis ma bskyod pa de ha go dgos kyi yod red gsungs byas nas tshig rkang dang po de bzhag yod red/ 1 dang po tha mal pa'i 'du 'dzi spong ba/ 'grel pa de'i rjes su 'brang nas de'i lugs srol byas nas bshad na/ de la dang po sgom la 'jug tshul la/ ga re dgos kyi yod red zer na/ de lta bu 'di phyag rgya chen po nyams su len pa'i gang zag la tha mal gyi 'du 'dzi zer ba'i skabs la spyir btang gi tha mal pa'i 'du 'dzi zer yag 'di tshe 'di yi dgra 'dul yag dang*/ gnyen skyong yag dang*/ de ka nang bzhin gyi dpal 'byor bsgrub yag dang*/ longs spyod bsgrub yag dang*/ snyan grags la sogs gang dang gang yin na yang tshe 'di'i che thabs dang*/ 'khor ba'i 'dod yon dang longs spyod la sogs pa la gtso bo chags nas/ de'i steng nas mi tshe skyel nas las ka las bsdad yag 'di gtso bo ga re chags yod red zer na/ tha mal pa'i 'du 'dzi zhes bzhag pa red/ spyir btang 'du 'dzi ngo ma de gtso bo rnam rtog la bzhag pa red/ rnam rtog gi dbang du 'gro nas de'i thog nas 'jig rten gyi spang blang gi las ka 'di rnam rtog gis 'brangs pa red/ rnam rtog gis 'brangs nus pa yin dus 'du 'dzi zer yag 'di gtso bo brel la 'dra po gcig /zang nge zing nge 'dra po gcig /zang nga zing nge de yang gtso bo chags pa dang 'brel ba'i zang zing zhig chags yong dus 'jig rten pa'i zang zing de ga re chags yod red zer na/ chags sdang dang 'brel ba'i rnam rtog gi gnyis 'dzin zhig chags bsdad kyi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus dang po sgom la 'jug yong ba'i skabs su skyon che shos 'di tha mal pa'i 'du 'dzi red/ tha mal zer ba 'di 'jig rten pa'am tha mal 'khor ba tshe 'di'i chags sdang gi rnam rtog dang 'brel bsdad pa'i dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi bya ba de dang*/
