'jig rten chos brgyad gtso bor gyur pa'i bya ba thams cad 'di 'du 'dzi yin pa red/ 2 thun mong thun min gyi sngon 'gro rnams 'du 'dzi spong byed du bstan pa/ de yin dus rlung gis ma bskyod pa zhig dgos kyi yod red/ sems 'di phyag rgya chen po'i steng la tshugs thub yag yong ba la dang po skyon 'di tha mal pa'i rnam rtog red/ tha mal pa'i 'du 'dzi'i rnam rtog 'di 'du 'dzi 'di rlung 'dra po zhig red/ 'di rlung gis ma bskyod pa zhes lab pa red/ ma bskyod pa zer na g.yo 'gul ma btang ba zer dus thun mong gi lam sbyang yong dus nga rang tsho dang po skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste de nas sngon 'gro rnam pa bzhi bskyed kyi yod red/ de nas bzung ste thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la sogs pa bskyed yong dus don dag snying po 'di tsho ga re byed yag red zer na 'du 'dzi'i rnam rtog 'di phar byang yag dang*/ 'du 'dzi'i rnam rtog 'di phar 'gag yag dang*/ 'du 'dzi'i rnam rtog 'di phar bshig ya'i don dag la yin pa red/ de yin dus chos kyi steng la nga rang tsho thun mong gi sngon 'gro phyag 'tshal yag skyabs 'gro bsgom yag dang*/ de ka nang bzhin gyi byang chub kyi sems bsgom yag 'dra ba dang*/ snying rje bsgom yag 'dra po dang*/ lha'i bskyed rim bzlas yag la sogs pa dang*/ lam sbyang yong dus tha mal pa'i 'du 'dzi'i rnam rtog 'di kho rang rang bzhin ngam ngam gyis phar 'gag 'gro yag gi kho la thabs shes dang cha rkyen yod pa red 'dug /de yin dus de skabs la dang po sgom la 'jug yong dus thun mong gi lam sbyang nas 'du 'dzi'i tshogs de ngang gis bkag dgos yag 'di gtso bo bshad kyi yod red/ ngang gis 'gag dgos yag dang ngang gis bshig dgos yag 'di bshad bsdad kyi yod red/ 3 bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams gsum bstan pa/ de yang sems la rnam rtog mang drag na ni sems la gsal cha 'di yong thub kyi yod ma red/

dper na phyag rgya chen po'i skabs su bde dang*/ gsal dang*/ mi rtog gsum zhes gtso bo bshad kyi yod red/ bde ba'i nyams dang*/ gsal ba'i nyams dang*/ mi rtog pa'i nyams gsum zhes bshad kyi yod red/ de bshad yong dus gsal cha yong ba la sems ma bcos pa dgos kyi yod red/ sems ma bcos na gsal/ chu ma rnyog na dwangs/ 'di zer bshad yong dus sems ma bcos pa'i steng la sleb yag la sems 'di kho rang bcos ma ma yin pa'i steng la bzhag thub dgos kyi yod red/ 'du 'dzi mang po bcos nas chags sdang rnam rtog dang 'brel yong dus sems bcos yong ba red/ bzang po la re ba dang*/ ngan pa la dwogs pa byas nas re dwogs rnam rtog zer yag 'di bcos ma'i sems yin pa red/ blo kun rdzob 'di bcos ma'i sems yin pa red/ de 'dra ba'i bcos ma'i sems 'di phar med pa bzo yag la sems 'di ma bcos pa'i steng la slebs dgos kyi yod red/ ma bcos pa slebs yag la las dang po pas lam sang bcos ma'i sems 'di ma bcos pa la kha thug 'gro dgos na 'di dka' las yod red/ ga re zer na tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas goms pa'i dbang gis bcos ma'i rnam rtog la goms bsdad yag dang*/ bcos ma'i rnam rtog nang la ngam ngam shugs shugs kyis 'gro bsdad pa yin dus kho lam sang 'di spang bya de'i steng la gnyen po bsten nas spangs/ de'i rtsa ba thams cad med par bzo yag 'di dka' las khag po yin pa yin dus/ bcom ldan 'das kyis theg pa rim pa yi dbang du byas na yang rnam grangs mang po zhig gsungs yod red/ nyams len gyi rim pa yin na yang las dang po pa'i nyams len/ de nas yar phyin nas gang mtshams zhig la o'u tsam chags pa'i skabs su nyams len byed stangs gcig /brtan pa mthar phyin pa'i skabs su nyams len byed stangs kyi rim pa 'dra po 'di mang po zhig gang zag so so'i khams dang*/ dbang po dang*/ mos pa dang 'tshams pa'i thog nas gsungs kyi yod pa yin dus/

'di tsho yongs rdzogs gtso bo 'di 'du 'dzi'i rnam rtog 'di phar gzhig pa'i don dag la gtso bo 'di bzhag gi yod red/ zhi gnas nas cha tshang de 'dra yin dus phyag rgya chen po'i sems kyi gsal cha dang*/ mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye ba la gegs che shos 'dra po 'di 'du 'dzi yin pa red/ chags sdang gi rnam rtog dang 'brel bsdad pa 'di red/ bdag tu 'dzin pa dang*/ bdag gir 'dzin pa dang*/ bdag gzhan la brten nas dgra dang gnyen la sogs pa'i dbye ba mang po yod/ 'du 'dzi'i rlung gis ma bskyod pa zhig dgos kyi yod red/ de yin dus rtsa ba sems brtan dgos rgyu red 'dug /rtsa ba sems brtan dgos pa red/ 4 bar du blo yis bzos pa'i sgom skyon du bstan pa/ gnyis pa la/ blos byas rtsol ba'i sgom gyis ma bslad cing*// de 'dra po zhig dang po sgom la 'jug tshul 'di 'du 'dzis dben nas/ spyod 'jug nang la/ phyi 'jig rten gyi g.yeng ba dang*/ nang rnam rtog gi g.yeng ba gnyis bshad yod red/ de'i g.yeng ba gnyis po de spangs na 'du 'dzis dben pa dang gcig pa yin pa yod red/ de 'dra yin dus dang po 'jug tshul de'i thog la spangs thub pa 'byung na/ de nas gnyis pa de la blos byas rtsol ba'i sgom gyis ma bslad cing 'phags pa'i mnyam par bzhag tshul dngos 'di bshad kyi yod red mnyam bzhag dngos gnas 'di/ mnyam par bzhag stangs 'di bshad yong ba red/ de yin dus mnyam par bzhag stangs 'di bshad yong dus de la blos byas lab yong dus bcos ma'i blo yis bzos pa'i sgom 'di de skabs la skyon bshad kyi yod red/ 'jig rten pa'i sgom mam blo kun rdzob pa'i bcos ma'i tshul gyis byas bzhag pa'i sgom 'di skyon yin pa bshad kyi yod red/ de nang la de 'dra zhig lus gnad dang*/ sems gnad gnyis 'dra po zhig gtso bo brgyab kyi yod sa red/ lus gnad la gtso bo lus gnad de lus gnas rnam snang chos bdun thog nas rgyab nas gsung gi yod red/

de thun mong gi lam red/ sems gnad de la yang sems ma bcos pa rang babs su skyong yag 'di gtso bo phyag rgya chen po skabs kyi sems gnas 'di thog la bzhag gi yod red/ blo yis byas bzhag pa'i stong yag 'dra po dang*/ blos byas kyis thog nas pha gsal ba la bzhag yag 'dra po dang*/ blos byas kyi thog nas gsal ba dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i tshul 'dra po dang*/ de nas yang ched du rtsol nas rnam rtog phar bkag e thub blta yag 'dra po bkag ya'i thabs shes byed yag dang*/ yang dmigs pa ched du gtad yag 'dra po de 'dra blos byas kyi sgom mang po zhig skyon mang po yod red/ de 'dra yin dus ci gsal ba dang stong pa dang zung 'jug zer yag 'di ga re yin na yang de blos byas pa'i thog nas ma yin pa kho rang rang babs thog nas phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len dang 'brel yong dus/ de'i steng nas kho ngam ngam shugs kyis bcos ma ma yin pa'i nyams len gyi steng la 'gro thub pa byung na/ 'di blos ma byas pa'am bcos ma ma yin pa'i sgom chags thub kyi yod red ma gtogs 'di lta bu zhig bsgom dgos kyi 'dug /de 'dra zhig bsgom na 'di ni de la nges don de 'dra zhig 'dug /de bsgom pa la yang gnyen po de 'dra zhig bsten dgos bsam byas nas bcos ma'i thog nas bzo bsdad pa yin na/ 'di yong yag med pa red 'dug /de yin dus/ rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i nang la/ dngos po med la bsgom pa med// bsgom par bya ba bsgom pa med// de lta dngos po dngos med pa// sgom pa yongs su shes pa'o// zhes bshad yong dus dngos dang dngos med gnyis ka'i mtha' las 'das pa'i sgom zhig la slebs dgos yag red 'dug /de bas na bsgom dngos po dang dngos med/ dngos po'i steng la slebs na ni skyon chen po yin pa red/ dngos po med pa'i steng la slebs na yang dngos med la 'dzin pa yod na skyon chen po yong gi yod red/

de las sdug pa dngos por 'dzin pa las dngos med 'dzin pa sdug ga yin pa red/ de yang sa ra has/ dngos por 'dzin pa phyugs dang 'dra ba ste// dngos med 'dzin pa de bas kyang ni blun// zhes gsungs pa yin dus dngos por 'dzin pa 'di kho dngos 'dzin gyi lta ba zer yag 'di bshig yag las sla bo yod red/ 'phags pa lhas/ bsod nams ma yin dang po bzlog / bar du bdag ni bzlog pa dang*// tha mar lta gzhi kun bzlog pa// gang shes de ni mkhas pa yin// zhes bzhi brgya pa las gsungs yong dus/ bsod nams ma yin pa dang po bzlog yong dus/ las dge ba bsags pa la brten nas 'bras bu bde ba thob yag /mi dge ba bsags na 'bras bu sdug bsngal thob yag yod pa la sogs pa mang po zhig gsungs bsdad kyi yod red/ 'di bsod nams ma yin pa'i las mi dge ba bzlog pa'i don dag la bcom ldan 'das kyis las dkar po la bslab dgos yag gsungs pa red/ bka' bar pa'i skabs su bar du bdag bzlog pa'i skabs su yod pa 'di spang dgos yag red/ bdag tu zhen pa dang bden par zhen pa'i blo de spang dgos kyi yod red de spang na las sla bo yod red/ kho yod pa'i gnyen po la med pa slebs thub kyi yod red/ 'di yod 'dzin gyi gnyen po la med 'dzin bsten dgos pa red/ bdag tu zhen pa'i blo la bdag med bsten dgos pa red/ bden par zhen pa'i blo la bden med bsten dgos pa red/ de las sla bo yod red/ dka' las khag po de ga re red zer na/ bden med du zhen pa'i blo de spangs yag la gnyen po gnyis pa bsten yag med pa red/ de dka' las khag po yod red/ gal srid bden med de bden 'dzin gyi rtog pa'i steng du bden med kyi gnyen po de bsten shes na bden 'dzin gyi rtog pa 'di bshig /de nas bden med kyi gnyen po de la'ang zhen pa med pa'i thog nas bden med yang bden pa yod med gnyis kyi mtha' las 'das pa'i tshul gyis nyams su blangs thub pa yin na gnyen po de yis tan tan gyi bya ba byed thub pa 'byung ba red/

de ma 'byung na bden med du zhen song ba yin na nga rang tsho khog pa'i nang la dug yod dus dug med par gtang yag la sman bsten pa red/ khog pa gsher yag gi don dag la sman btang gi yod red/ khog pa gsher yag gi don du sman bsten yong dus sman kho rang khog pa'i nang la nad kyis mnyam du 'gag song na mi 'di yang srog chad yag ma gtogs med pa yin dus 'di nang bzhin gyi kho dngos med kyi 'dzin pa de'i steng la zhen song ba yin na de nas kyang de la gnyen po gzhan pa bsten yag med pa red/

stong pa nyid la lta nyes na// shes rab chung rnams phung bar 'gyur// ji ltar sbrul la bzung nyes dang*// rig sngags nyes par bsgrubs pa bzhin// zhes mgon po klu sgrub kyis gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi gang ltar yang stong nyid 'di spyir btang gi bden 'dzin bshig yag gi gnyen po red/ stong nyid de bden 'dzin bshig yag gi gnyen po yin na yang stong nyid bsten stangs kyi thog la bsam blo gtang stangs dang stong nyid bsten stangs/ stong nyid ji lta bu'i tshul gyis bsten/ stong nyid bsten par byed pa'i gang zag 'di stong pa nyid 'di nyams su blang med dus ji lta bu'i tshul gyi sgo nas nyams su blang dgos kyi yod ces bshad yong dus/ de'i steng nas yong gi yod pa red 'dug /de 'dra yin dus dngos por 'dzin pa ni skyon red/ dngos med 'dzin na ni de bas kyang skyon che ba yong gi yod pa yin dus dngos dngos med gnyis kyi mtha' las 'das pa'i bsgom gyi steng slebs bsdad kyi yod red/ de slebs yong dus bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'am don dam pa la bsgom bya dang sgom byed mtha' dag dang bral ba zhig yin pa red/ bsgom par bya ba 'di red/ sgom par byed mkhan 'di red byas nas med pa yin pa red/ 'di yin dus phyag chen skabs la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de yang dngos dang*/ dngos med mtha' las 'das pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes shig yong dgos kyi yod sa red/ de ma gtogs dngos po dang dngos med gnyis kyi nang log la rnam par rtog pa'i blo de'i nang la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'di skyes yag yod sa ma red/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zer yag 'di/ de 'dra yin dus blos byas rtsol ba zer yag 'di blos byas pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i rtsol bas sgom gyis ma bslad/ bslad zer ba'i skabs su bslad zhugs song ba ma yin pa/ de 'dra'i mnyam bzhag gi steng la bslad ma zhugs song ba yin na blos byas kyi rtsol ba'i bslad ma zhugs pa yin na bsgom dngos gzhi la slebs thub kyi yod pa red ces lab pa red 'dug

/da sems gnas kyis thog la de 'dra yin dus sgom gyis ma bslad cing gnyis pa de la/ 5 tha ma sems ma bcos rang babs su skyong dgos par bstan pa/ tha ma 'di nyams skyong 'ong dus skyong stangs 'di ga res skyong dgos red zer na/ ma bcos gnyug mar rang babs 'jog shes pa'i// sems don nyams len mkhas shing skyong bar shog /ma bcos pa zhes lab pa red/ ma bcos pa zer na bzo bcos med pa bcas bcos rtsa ba nas med pa/ de 'dra po bzo dgos/ de 'dra po zhig dgos yag med 'gro bsam pa 'dra po/ de 'dra zhig byed dgos med 'gro bsam pa 'dra po/ thabs dang*/ rten 'brel dang*/ sgom dang*/ lta ba ga re yin na yang bzo bcos 'dra po btang bzhag na mi 'grig pa red/ kho gnas lugs kyi steng la ga re yod pa 'di dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kho 'jig rten gyi khams na byon kyang rung*/ ma byon kyang rung kho chos nyid kyi gnas tshul zer yag 'di la sems can gyis kyang bzo bcos btang yag med pa red/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis kyang ji tsam thabs mkhas/ ji tsam zhig dngos gnas drang gnas mdzad pa phrin las dus las g.yo ba med na yang*/ dngos po'i gnas tshul gyi don de la bzo bcos gtang yag med pa red/ bzo bcos gtang yag 'di gnyug ma ma red/ bzo bcos ma gtang ba'i chos nyid yod red/ de la gnyug ma zhes lab pa red/ de 'dra yin dus/ gnyug ma rang babs 'jog shes pa'i/ 6 rang babs kyi sgra don/ rang babs 'jog thun mong ma yin pa'i bka' brgyud pa'i tshig gi khyad chos shig yin pa red/ de la rang babs 'jog zer ba'i skabs su dwags po rin po ches/ 'das pa'i rjes mi gcod/ ma 'ongs pa'i mdun mi bsu/ da lta ba'i shes pa bzo bcos med pa de'i steng la rang babs su bzhag dgos pa red gsungs pa red/ 'di zer ba'i skabs su gang zer gyi yod red zer na mdor bstan snying po 'di/

da lta'i skabs la dge ba'i rnam rtog yin na'ang red/ mi dge ba'i rnam rtog yin na'ang red/ 'di mi dge ba'i rnam rtog red zer nas ched du rtsol ba'i thog nas phar bkag yag ni yod ma red/ 'di dge ba'i rnam rtog red zer nas de la tshur dang du blang yag yod ma red/ ga re byung na yang bzang po yi yon tan 'byung na yang red/ ngan pa'i skyon yin na yang red/ 'di kho rang gang shar rjes med du skyong ba 'byung ba yin na rdo tsha bo steng du kha ba phog pa nang bzhin/ ci gang shar rjes med du 'byung ba yin na/ de la rang babs su 'jog pa red/ de ma gtogs bcas bcos mang po ma dgos ba red/ bcas bcos mang po byed na rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye yag la bgegs chen po byed pa yin/ 'di yin dus rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes skyes yag la bgegs che shos 'di bzo bcos btang yag yin pa red/ rnam rtog gis bcas bcos mang po byed yag red/ lta ba'i sgro 'dogs gcod zer yag 'di sngon du 'gro dgos red ma gtogs sgom gyi dngos gzhi skyong yong dus sgro 'dogs gcod yag med pa red/ sgro 'dogs bcad zin pa'i don ma nor ba de'i steng la mnyam par bzhag yong ba red/ de'i steng la mnyam par bzhag yong dus kho rang gnas lugs kyi steng la ga re yod pa de'i steng la kho ma bcos pa bzhag yong ba red ma gtogs yang 'di skyon red bzhag /'di bzang po red bzhag zer nas de la rnam rtog gi bslad bzhugs pa yin na/ de yang skyon yin pa red/ sku gsung thugs gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la yang 'dzin pa yod na 'di yang 'di skabs su skyon yin pa red/ sgrog pa la gser gyi thag pas sgrog pa dang*/ lcags kyi thag pas sgrog pa gnyis la khyad par med zer nas rje btsun mi las gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi don dag snying po yi steng la kho bzang zhen yin na'ang red/ ngan zhen gyi rtog pa yin na'ang red/

dngos gnas drang gnas kyis 'khor ba'i chags 'dzin dang zhen 'dzin thog la sems zhen pa yin na'ang red/ dngos po'i gnas tshul thabs las 'das pa red/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba de bsam gyis mi khyab pa red/ bsam pa yin na'ang red/ gang ltar de thams cad ga re red zer na/ kho 'dzin zhen nang la 'gro gi yod red/ 'di yin dus 'di spang dgos pa dang*/ 'di phar bzhag dgos pa dang*/ de 'dra la bltos nas ma bcos zhes gnyug ma zhes gnyug ma zer yag 'di bzo bcos ma btang ba/ rang babs 'jog zer yag 'di dus gsum gyi rnam rtog gi thog la 'das pa'i bsam blo btang yag /ma 'ongs pa'i mdun bsu yag /da lta ba'i shes pa bzo bcos 'di med pa rang babs su bzhag thub pa zhig 'byung ba red ma gtogs/ dgos ni dgos/ de 'dra zhig dgos kyi yod red ma gtogs/ 'das pa'i rjes bcad/ ma 'ongs pa'i mdun bsu na 'di ni rang babs ma 'byung ba red/ rang babs zer yag 'di kho ga re yod pa de'i steng la bzhag zer ba red 'dug a/ man ngag la gnad dang ldan pa de 'dra po zhig dgos kyi red/ de 'dra yin dus/ sems don nyams len mkhas shing skyong bar shog /de 'dra yi don la sems don nyams len de mkhas nas skyong dgos par shog lab pa red 'dug /man ngag de gnad dang ldan pa zhig dgos kyi yod red/ 7 phyag chen ha shang gi lta ba dang mi 'dra tshul/ de yang la las phyag chen lugs srol 'di dus gsum gyi rnam rtog thams cad bkag gi 'dug /dus gsum yid byed thams cad bkag gi yod pa yin dus de skabs la gnyug ma rang babs 'jog ces tha snyad de 'dra lab pa red ma gtogs don dag 'di rgya nag ha shang gi lta ba dang khyad par mi 'dug zer nas dgag pa rgyab mkhan snga rabs pa mang po byung yod red/ phyi rabs pa yang mang po byung yod red/ mkhas pa/ yin na yang don dag snying po 'di bka' brgyud pas 'di'i skabs la bka' brgyud pas 'dod pa'i yid byed/

yid la byed mi rung zer ba 'di yid byed byed mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan bshad bsdad pa 'di yid la byed pa zhig yod/ yid la bya rgyu zhig yod/ yid la byed mkhan zhig yod nas bkag pa yin na skyon 'di yong gi yod red/ gtan nas bkag yod red/ 'di nor 'khrul yong gi yod red/ 'di ma yin pa gang ltar 'di'i skabs la ga re bshad bsdad kyi yod red zer na dus gsum gang du'ang yid la byed mkhan dang*/ yid la bya rgyu dang*/ yid la byed pa po yod ma red/ gnas lugs kyi steng la de med pa yin dus gang shar na yang*/ gang rtogs na yang*/ gang snang na yang*/ gang shar gang snang thams cad 'di zhen med du skyong dgos kyi red/ de ma gtogs pha gi 'di yod ma red zer nas bkag pa de skad cha bshad kyi mi 'dug a/ 'o na ga re zer na yid la byed zer yag 'di tha snyad red/ de yang rnam par rtog pa'i blo red/ gnas lugs kyi steng la slebs yong dus/ yid la byed mkhan dang yid la bya rgyu gang yang yod ma red zer red 'dug a/ kho rang bzhin gyis grub pa yod ma red/ de blos byas red/ yid la byed pa zhig yod na 'di blos byas red/ yid la bya rgyu zhig yod na de mthar thug ma red/ de 'dra byas nas yid la byed pa de gang shar zhen med du skyong ba gcig /gang shar zhen med du shes tsam zhig la yid byed/ yid la byed pa da lta dang bral ba gsungs pa red ma gtogs yid la byed rgyu zhig yod nas btags pa yin na skyon 'di dngos gnas yong gi yod red/ de nas 'di dbye ba phye yag 'di gal chen po red 'dug /de 'dra yin dus dus gsum gyi yid la byed pa mtha' dag dang bral yin dus/ rgya nag ha shang gis ga re lab kyi yod red zer na/ ha shang gi kho bzang po'i rnam rtog kyang bkag dgos kyi red/ ngan pa'i rnam rtog byung na yang bkag dgos pa red/ sprin dkar pos nyi ma bsgrib na yang sgrib pa red/

sprin nag pos bsgrib na'ang sgrib pa red/ khyi dkar pos so brgyab na yang khrag 'don gyi red/ khyi nag pos so brgyab na yang khrag 'don gyi red/ de 'dra yin dus kho dge ba yin na'ang red/ mi dge ba yin na'ang red/ kho gang ltar ga re yin na yang rnam par rtog pa zhig dang 'brel bsdad pa red/ gang ltar sprin dkar po yin na'ang red/ nag po yin na'ang red/ nyi ma sgrib pa ni gcig pa gcig kyang red/ de 'dra yin dus bkag dgos kyi red/ rnam rtog gang 'dra shar song na yang de yang ched du bkag dgos kyi red zer nas gnyen po bsten stangs la yang mang po zhig sbyar nas khong tshos bshad kyi yod sa red/ de gnyis la 'dra gi yod ma red de skabs la/ de 'dra yin dus bya byed dang dus gsum gyi sgo nas dus gsum gyi dbye ba zhig dang bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba gnyis phye ba'i thog nas bsam blo btang na de'i skyon de ka rang yong gi yod red de/ yin na yang de'i skabs la dngos gnas drang gnas kyi da lta/ rgyud bla ma las gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba'ang cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// gang ltar dus gsum gyi yid byed mtha' dag las 'das pa'i rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de'i nang la mnyam par bzhag bzhag pa ma zad pa'i rang babs su mnyam par bzhag bzhag pa red/ bzang po zer nas yon tan gyi thog nas mnyam par bzhag na yang de la zhen pa med pa red/ ngan pa'i rnam rtog mang po zhig shar song na yang de la 'o 'di skyon red bsam pa'i skyon du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog med pa red/ bzang por rtog pa'i blo dang*/ ngan par rtog pa'i blo thams cad las 'das pa'i gnas lugs rang babs de'i steng la slebs yong dus bzang po zer yag de'ang ming dang tha snyad tsam zhig red/ ngan pa zer yag de'ang blo yis 'dzin tshul zhig dang*/

tha snyad tsam zhig red ma gtogs/ don la bzang po dang ngan pa zer ba thams cad las 'das pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes so so rang rig pa'i nyams su myong ba ma gtogs/ gzhan gyi brda dang*/ tshig dang*/ tha snyad kyis bstan dgos na bstan rgyu med pa'i snying po zhig slebs yin dus de la yid byed dang bral ba'i tha snyad btags yin dus dpyad pa chen po 'dra po zhig yong gi yod sa red/ 8 sems don nyams len mkhas shing skyong bar smon pa/ 'o de 'dra'i thog nas/ sems don nyams len mkhas shing skyong bar shog /dang po bsgom la 'jug pa'i skabs su tha mal 'du 'dzi khams tha mal pa'i 'du 'dzi'i rnam rtog 'di spang dgos pa gal che ba/ bar du dngos gnas mnyam par bzhag yong dus lus gnad dang sems gnad gnyis kyi thog nas gzhung 'dra po srang nas bsgom ga 'dra zhig rgyab na yang*/ blos byas kyis bsgom 'dra po la ma song ba/ bcos ma ma yin pa'i sgom steng la slebs thub pa/ tha ma nyams 'di skyong 'ong dus kho gang shar zhen med kyi thog nas bskyang ba ma gtogs bzang po la 'thob yong bsam pa'i re ba/ 'di ngan pa zhig slebs mi yong bsam pa'i dwogs pa/ de 'dra'i re dwogs gang yang med pa kho gang shar zhen med ngang nas bskyang thub pa yin na 'di dngos gnas drang gnas kyi phyag rgya chen po'i skabs nas bshad bsdad yag gi sgom dngos gzhi de de 'dra'i thog na yong thub kyi yod sa red/ gnyug ma rang babs 'jog shes pa'i/ 'di gsum 'di yag po skyong shes na/ thog tha bar gsum du de lta bu'i thabs khyad par can dang ldan na/ sems don gyi man ngag /nyams len gyi man ngag 'di gnad dang ldan pa zhig chags thub kyi yod pa red/ gnad dang ldan pa 'di la mkhas thub pa byung ba yin na/ mkhas pa chags thub/ de nas 'bras bu'i phyag rgya chen po de mngon du 'gyur thub kyi red ces lab pa red/ skyong zer yag 'di/ ma 'ongs pa na 'bras bu'i phyag rgya chen po de mngon du gyur yag 'di/

de nas lam gyi phyag chen la brtson dgos ba bshad pa red/ skyong stangs de 'dra yin pa red 'dug /dang po'i skabs su sems kyi dmigs pa dang*/ de nas re ba dang*/ dwogs pa zer yag 'dra po dang*/ de nas tshogs pa zer yag 'dra po mang tshogs mang po'i nang la bsdad yag 'dra po/ 'di tsho mang po zhig spangs dgos kyi yod sa red/ gal che shos 'dra po 'di/ de'i nang nas sa paṇa gyi 'grel pa'i nang log la ya/ tha mal 'du 'dzi'i rlung gis ma bskyod pa zer yag 'di rtsa che shos yin/ 'di yag po zhig skyong thub pa yin na/ de nas bar du mnyam par bzhag tshul dang*/ nyams skyong yag la las sla po yod red/ kun gyi rtsa ba dang po 'di 'du 'dzi'i rnam rtog 'di red/ 'di spang yag la thabs shes byed dgos pa red ces gsungs pa red 'dug /da de la dpe 'dra po yang gcig /a ba dhū tī yi lung gcig drangs nas/ ser skya mo dang chu skyar sbrul// nags na ri dwags tshogs rnams dang*// zhes re ba spang dgos pa dang*/ de ga nang bzhin gyi 'du 'dzi spang dgos pa dang*/ gcig pur gnas na nyams rtogs yag po skyes thub pa dang*/ de ga nang bzhin gyi gang du song yang rtsod pa'i gnas yin pa/ de 'dra'i 'khor ba'i skyon rang bzhin mang po zhig ngo sprod 'dra po byas nas 'di spangs pa'i thog la tha mal 'du 'dzi'i rlung gis ma bskyod pa zer nas rgyab yod red/ 'di tsho la go sla po yin dus zhu mi dgos pa byed/ de'i rjes la zhi gnas red/

ma zhi gnas kyi nyams rtogs skye tshul/ phra rags rtog pa'i dba' rlabs rang sar zhi// g.yo med sems kyi chu bo ngang gis gnas// bying rmugs rnyog pa'i dri ma dang bral ba'i// zhi gnas rgya mtsho mi g.yo brtan par shog / 1 phra rags kyi rnam rtog zhi dgos pa/ phra rags zer yag 'di phra ba zer na ni phra bo byas/ rags pa zer yag 'di sbom po la go ba red/ de 'dra yin dus phra rags zer yag 'di kho gang ltar sgom gyi skyon zhi gnas la slebs yong dus kho skyon 'di yod pa red/ rnam pa kun tu kho thun mong ba yin na'ang red/ thun mong ma yin pa yin na'ang red/ kho ga ba yin na'ang red/ bshad yag kho dang po sgom la 'jug yong ba'i skabs la zhi gnas dgos kyi red/ zhi gnas slebs yag la dngos gnas drang gnas phra rags kyi rnam rtog 'di nges par du spang dgos yag 'di yin pa red/ de yang jo bo rjes/ 'jig rten bya ba dag la phar bltas pas// byas pa thams cad don med rtsod pa'i rgyu// gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi 'jig rten bya ba de la phar blta yong dus byas pa thams cad don med kyi rtsod pa zhig mthong yong dus/ su la bltas na'ang mi 'dug pas// rang gi sems la lta ba goms par gyis// rang gi sems la lta ba sgoms// zhes de'i skabs la lta ba 'di zhi gnas la go ba yin ma gtogs lhag mthong gi bsgom pa med/ de 'dra yin dus rang gi sems la lta ba goms par gyis/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi thog nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyi steng la slebs yong dus 'jig rten bya ba de la dang po phar blta yong dus byed pa thams cad don med pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yin pa mthong yong dus gang la bltas kyang snying po med pa mthong yong dus de'i rgyu ga ba mthong ba red zer na/ gtso bo 'di rang gi sems la lta ba bsgom dgos red/ 'jig rten pas lam sang lhag mthong bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab rtogs thub kyi ma red pa/

de 'dra yin dus lhag mthong bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab rtogs par byed pa la de la med du mi rung ba'i rten khyad par can 'di zhi gnas yin pa red/ de 'dra yin dus rang gi sems kyi lta ba zer yag 'di lta ba 'di skabs kyi lta ba 'di zhi gnas la go ba red/ 'o de 'dra byas nas des gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi thog mar zhi gnas de la dmigs bcas kyi thog nas 'jug stangs yod red/ dmigs med kyi thog nas 'jug stangs kyang yod red/ gang yang dmigs bcas dmigs med go rim byas nas mar 'jug stangs kyang yod pa red/ gang ltar 'di kho skabs su babs pa gang dgos na yang so so'i 'dod pa red/ mtha' gcig tu dang po dmigs bcas dgos kyi yod red/ de nas dmigs med dgos kyi red zer lab yag gang yang yod ma red/ 2 rnam rtog phra rags ngos bzung tshul/ yin na yang dmigs bcas dmigs med gang yin na yang khyad par mi 'dug /dang po sgom kho na la 'jug yong dus/ skyon 'dra po zhig ga re yod red zer na/ rnam rtog phra rags 'di red/ phra ba dang rags pa 'di/ mdzod kyi lugs srol la/ phra rags kyi rnam rtog gi skad cha bshad stangs dang*/ da re de'i skabs la skad cha bshad stangs 'di tog tsam khyad par zhig bzhag gi yod sa red/ phra rags zer yag 'di spyir btang gi mdzod kyi skabs la yin na ni spyir btang gi rtog dpyod gnyis la bzhag yod red/ rtog pa 'di rnam rtog rags pa la bzhag /dpyod pa 'di phra ba la bzhag yod red/ rtog pa thams cad rtsing zhib nyid bshad yod red/ rtsing zhib de 'dra zhig la bzhag yod red/ de skabs la gtso bo ga re dgos kyi yod red zer na/ nyon yid la rtsol ba dang bcas pa'i thog nas yul la 'jug yong ba 'di rnam rtog rags pa la bzhag /'jug zin pa 'di slar de la yang dpyad pa btang yag 'di zhib pa la bzhag yod red/ de 'dra yin dus de 'dra'i phyag rgya chen po'i zhi gnas skyong bar byed pa la de 'dra'i rnam rtog phra rags gnyis po 'di gnyen po zhig la brten nas rnam rtog 'di phar bkag pa yin na mi 'grig par gsungs pa red/

rang sar zhi zhes pa'i tshig 'di/ de 'dra'i rnam rtog 'di sems dang sems byung gi rgyu ba zer na 'grig gi 'dug /thun mong gi skad cha bshad na/ sems dang sems byung gi rgyu ba de lta bu 'di phar gzhig yag la gnyen po bsten nas gnyen po de'i steng du phar spang dgos na dka' las khag po yod red/ de 'dra yin dus de'i skabs la phra ba zer ba'i skabs su rtog pa de la spyir btang gi rtog pa la dpyod pa zhugs pa 'di rags pa la bzhag /rtog dpyod mngon 'gyur du tshogs pa 'di rags pa la bzhag /rtog dpyod mngon gyur du ma tshogs na phra ba bzhag pa red/ phyag chen gyi lugs la ya/ rtog pa dang dpyod pa gnyis zer nas khag khag phye gi yod red/ mdzod lugs la yin na rtog pa 'di rags pa la bzhag /dpyod pa 'di phra ba la bzhag yong gi yod red/ nga rang tsho'i rnam rtog yul la zhugs pa yin dus/ phyag chen skabs su rnam rtog yul la zhugs yong dus rtog dpyod gnyis ka yul la 'jug pa mngon 'gyur du tshor thub na 'di rags pa la bzhag pa red 'dug /'di skabs su rnam rtog rags pa la bzhag pa red/ mtshams mtshams la rtog dpyod mngon 'gyur du ma tshor nas rtog dpyod yul la 'jug stangs shig yod pa red 'dug /de la phra ba bzhag pa red 'dug /de mngon 'gyur du tshor ma tshor zhig gi skad cha red ma gtogs don la rtog dpyod gnyis ka yod pa red 'dug /phra ba la yang rtog dpyod gnyis ka yod red/ rags pa la yang rtog dpyod gnyis ka yod red/ rtog dpyod gnyis 'di yul la dngos su 'jug pa tshor na rags pa/ yul la dngos su 'jug pa ma tshor na phra ba la bzhag pa red/ 'di phyag chen skabs su red bsdad pa yin dus/ de 'dra'i rtog pa'i rba rlabs de gang ltar chu'i rba rlabs de rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs dang 'dra po 'di mang po slebs yong dus/ nga tshor rnam rtog mang po slebs yin dus/ dper na rgya mtsho la rba rlabs mang po yod dus rgya mtsho 'di zhi 'jam gnas thub kyi yod ma red/

rgya mtsho rba rlabs des rgya mtsho 'di dkrogs nas rgya mtsho 'di zhi 'jam gnas thub kyi mi 'dug a/ de nang bzhin gyi da lta nga rang tsho'i phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag gi lugs la yod bsdad pa'i sems kyi zhi bar gnas pa'i sems zhi bde kyi ngo bo la gnas thub yag gi rnam rtog thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i nges shes kyi dbyings/ rnam rtog nye bar zhi ba'i nges shes kyi dbyings kyi thog la phar bsdad mi bcug yag 'di ga res dkrogs bsdad kyi yod red zer na/ nyon mongs pa'i rnam par rtog pas dkrogs bsdad kyi yod red/ de yang rnam rtog phra rags mang po zhig gis dkrogs bsdad pa yin dus de 'dra'i ched du bkag mi dgos pa kho rang sar du 'gag 'gro yag cig la rang sar zhi phyag chen skabs la 'o 'di yin pa red/ ngo bo nyid kyi zhi gnas 'dra po zhig yod sa red/ 'di skabs la spyir btang gi zhi gnas la dbye ba mang po yod pa'i nang nas ngo bo nyid kyi zhi gnas zer yag cig yod red/ de 'dra po yin sa red/ rnam rtog gi tshogs thams cad ngo shes yong dus rnam rtog rang sar nye bar zhi ba 'di de skabs la 'di bshad kyi yod sa red/ ngo bo nyid kyi zhi gnas 'dra po gcig /rang sar zhi/ 3 sems g.yo med du gnas dgos pa/ g.yo med sems kyi chu bo ngang gis gnas// de nas rba rlabs rgya mtsho'i steng la mar zhi yong dus rgya mtsho g.yo gi yod ma red/ rgya mtsho 'di kho rang bzhin gyis g.yo ba med pa bsdad thub kyi yod red/ de dang 'dra ba rnam rtog thams cad 'di kun gzhi rnam shes nang la kun gzhi nang la phar bsdus 'gro ba yin dus/ g.yo ba med pa'i sems/ de skabs la sems 'di kun gzhi la go ba red 'dug /de yang kun gzhi'i chu bo 'di chu bo'i rgyun de yang g.yo ba med par ngang gi gnas kyi red ces lab pa red 'dug /rnam rtog gi spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi yong dus sems kun gzhi de yang g.yo ba med par gnas thub kyi red/

4 zhi gnas kyi skyon spong ba/ bying rmugs rnyog pa'i dri ma dang bral ba'i// sgom gyi skyon 'dra po 'di bying rmugs gnyis 'di red/ bying ba dang rmugs pa/ bying ba zer ba'i skabs su thibs pa'i rnam pa red/ rmugs pa zer ba de'ang thibs pa'i rnam pa 'dra po zhig la gtso bo bying rmugs zer yag gi tshig 'di thibs pa'i rnam pa zhig go dgos rgyu yod red/ 'di zhi gnas kyi gegs gtso bo 'dra po de skabs la bying rmugs 'di yong gi yod red/ 'o 'di yin dus spyir btang zhi gnas la bshes springs nang la/ rgod dang 'gyod dang gnod sems rmugs pa dang*// gnyid dang 'dod la 'dun dang the tshom ste// sgrib pa lnga po 'di dag dge ba'i nor// 'phrog pa'i chom rkun lags par mkhyen par mdzod// bshad yong dus skyon 'dra po lnga bshad kyi yod red/ de yongs rdzogs tshur bsdus pa yin na kho dang po gsum bying rmugs nang la bsdus/ lhag ma kho rgod pa'i nang la 'gro gi yod red/ rgod 'gyod/ gnod sems/ gnyid rmugs/ the tshom/ 'dod 'dun ste lnga yod pa'i nang nas/ 'di gtso bo 'di bying ba dang rmugs pa 'di zhi gnas kyis skyon che shos 'dra po 'di yin pa red/ 'di zhi thub na lhag ma thams cad kho rang bzhin gyis zhi thub kyi red ces bshad pa red/ kho man ngag gi lugs kyi khrid rim nang bzhin byas nas so so so sor gnyen po bsten na 'grig gi yod red/ yang bying rgod kyi rang ngo la blta yong dus de'i ngo bo ma 'jog pa la 'jog dang*/ 'di phyag rgya chen po skabs kyi yang 'di spang bya spang stangs 'di bshad bsdad kyi 'dug a/ rnyog pa'i dri ma dang bral ba'i/ 5 zhi gnas brtan par gnas par smon pa/ zhi gnas rgya mtsho mi g.yo brtan par shog /'di kho yongs grags 'dra po zhig red/ kho zhi gnas la 'jug pa'i yan lag /spyir btang gi gtso bo sems gnas dgu zer ba yod red/

de ka nang bzhin gyi nyer bsdogs su grags pa'i yid byed bdun yod red/ bsam gtan bzhi 'dra po yod red/ mang po yod red/ 'di tsho la kho ga re bsten bsam na yang gnyen po bsten stangs de'i thog la 'gro gi yod red/ kho mtha' bzhi lhung ba de la dmigs bsal gang yang yod ma red/ 'di yin dus de la bsten thub pa yin na/ zhi gnas rgya mtsho mi g.yo brtan par shog /rnam rtog phra rags thams cad 'di rang sar zhi/ de nas g.yo ba med pa sems kyi chu bo/ kun gzhi'i steng la rnam rtog thams cad nye bar zhi bar gnas yong dus rnam rtog gi rba rlabs dang 'dra ba'i sems kyi chu bo kun gzhi chu bo de ngang gis gnas/ de'i steng la sgom rgyab yong ba'i skabs su kho rang kha thug gi gegs byed mkhan 'di bying rmugs yin pa red/ bying ba dang rmugs pa 'ong ba la sogs pa zhi gnas kyi skyon thams cad bral ba'i/ zhi gnas rgya mtsho mi g.yo brtan par shog /zhi gnas 'di rgya mtsho dang 'dra ba red/ rgya mtsho dang 'dra ba mi g.yo bar brtan thub par shog / de nas lhag mthong red/ sems dngos po'i gnas lugs 'di gtso bo skabs la lhag mthong gi sems dngos po'i gnas lugs bshad kyi yod red/ sems dngos po'i gnas lugs bshad yong dus/ tsa lhag mthong gi nyams rtogs skye tshul/ bltar med sems la yang yang bltas pa'i tshe// mthong med don ni ji bzhin lhag ger mthong*// yin min don la the tshom chod pa nyid// 'khrul med rang ngo rang gis shes par shog / 1 blta ru med pa'i sems la yang yang blta ba/ blta ru med pa'i sems la yang yang bltas pa'i tshe lab pa red/ lhag mthong de skabs la/ bltar med sems la yang yang bltas pa'i tshe// zer ba'i skabs blta rgyu zhig yod pa'i sems la bltas pa ma red/ 'di skabs la blta ba'i yul las 'das pas na blta bya lta byed med pa'i cha nas bltar med ces lab pa red/ blta ba'i yul zhig yod sa de la bltas pa yin na ni kho lhag mthong yang dag pa slebs thub kyi yod ma red/

blta rgyu med pa'i don de skabs la bltar med zer ba'i skabs la blta ba'i yul las 'das/ blta mkhan yang med/ blta bya yang med pa'i de 'dra'i gnas lugs shig gi steng la slebs yong dus bltar med lab pa red 'dug a/ blta ru med pa'i sems dngos po'i gnas lugs de nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa'i blo'am/ yang bla ma'i man ngag dang sgom byung gi shes rab kyis yang nas yang du bltas pa'i skabs su nga rang tsho'i mig gis bltas pa nang bzhin ma yin pa byas/ de nas de la mnyam bzhag gi blo yis lta dgos pa red/ mig gis lta ba nang bzhin byas nas dngos nas blta rgyu yod ma red/ yin na yang 'di 'dra po byas nas rang gi mig la rang gi mig gis tshur blta ba nang bzhin byed nas de tsam la byed dgos kyi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus de 'dra zhig byas nas mnyam par bzhag pa'i blo'i thog nas bltas na'ang red/ gang ltar gtso bo 'di bla ma'i man ngag dang 'brel yag 'di gal chen po red/ bla ma'i man ngag dang*/ lhag par rang gis de'i steng la bla ma'i man ngag gi steng la thos bsam sgom gsum gyi nang nas sgom byung gi shes rab kyis yang nas yang du de la bltas pa'i tshe/ blta bya lta byed med pa'i tshul gyis bltas pa'i tshe/ de ma gtogs blta bya lta byed yod pa'i tshul gyis bltas pa ma red/ 2 mthong bya med pa'i don mthong ba/ blta bya lta byed med pa'i tshe blta bya blta byed med pa'i tshul gyis bltas yong dus mthong bya mthong byed med pa'i tshul gyis don mthong gi yod red/ mthong med mthong ba dang bral ba'i don gyis mthong gi red lab pa red/ mthong ba dang bral ba'i don nam mthong ba med pa'i don ni ji bzhin lhag ger mthong*/ ji bzhin zer ba'i skabs la gnas tshul ma nor ba gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin du'am yin lugs ji lta ba bzhin du ma nor bar ji lta ba bzhin du lhag ger mthong*/ lhag ger zer na bar du sgrib mkhan med pa red/

gnas lugs kyi don la sgrib mkhan med dus lhag ger mthong yong ba red/ gnas lugs kyi don la nyon mongs pa'am glo bur gyi dri mas bsgrib bsdad pa'i skabs su lhag ger mthong mi thub pa red 'dug /de la sgrib mkhan med yong dus lhag ger mthong*/ 3 sgro skur gyi don la the tshom chod par smon pa/ 'di mthong nas gnas lugs kyi don de la 'di yin 'di min 'di yod pa red 'di med pa la sogs pa'i sgrib g.yog dang bral ba red/ 'o de 'dra yin dus yin pa dang*/ min pa dang*/ yod pa/ med pa la sogs pa sgro skur gyi don la the tshom chod pa red/ de 'dra'i the tshom ma chod bar du lta ba'i rtsod pa mang po yong gi yod red/ red zer yag dang*/ ma red zer yag lta bu/ 'di red zer/ 'di ma red zer/ de 'dra byas nas 'dzin pa yin na de'ang skyon red zer/ de 'dra byed nas 'dzin na skyon med 'gro bsam bsam 'dra po skyon gyi thog la bsam blo mang po yong bsdad pa 'di the tshom ma chod pa yin pa red/ gnas lugs kyi steng la dngos gnas drang gnas kyi bla ma'i man ngag dang sgom byung shes rab la brten nas dngos gnas lhag mthong bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab de'i steng la nges shes skyes yong dus mthong yong dus gnas lugs dang gsal ba dang rjen par mthong yong dus/ yin pa dang min pa/ yod pa dang med pa la sogs pa thams cad la the tshom gyi sgro skur 'di chod yong ba red/ med par sgro 'dogs pa dang*/ yod par skur pa 'debs pa'i the tshom chod thub kyi red/ 'di chod yong dus 'di ni 'khrul pa med pa'i don 'di rang ngo rang gis shes pa'i tshul du gsal bar myong ba red/ de skabs la rang ngo rang gis shes zer yag 'di lhag mthong ye shes skyes yong dus so sos mthong thub yag cig la bshad bsdad pa red 'dug /mthong thub pa'am rig thub pa/ gsal bar myong thub pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi gsal bar mthong thub pa/

lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyis gsal bar mngon sum du myong thub pa zhig la go ba red 'dug /'khrul med rang ngo rang gis shes par shog /'di'i skabs la gzhi rtsa chod pa red/ 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa chod pa/

tsha gzhi rtsa gcod pa/ yul la bltas pas yul med sems su mthong*// sems la bltas pas sems med ngo bos stong*// gnyis la bltas pas gnyis 'dzin rang sar grol// 'od gsal sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs par shog / 1 gang shar gyi ngo bo la blta bas sems su mthong ba/ de'i skabs la yul la zer ba'i skabs la yul 'di phyi'i yul drug la sogs pa gang shar gyi snang ba ga re yin na yang de thams cad blta yag red 'dug /blta yul 'di zer yag med pa red/ gang shar gyi ngo bo la blta dgos yag red/ gang shar dang gang rig gang gsal de'i ngo bo la blta yong dus yul la bltas yong dus/ de nas yul med sems su mthong*/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i sgom byung gi shes rab kyis blta yong dus yul thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i yul thams cad 'di sems su mthong thub pa red/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du 'gyur yong dus kho yul la phar lta ba red ces lab pa red ma gtogs/ yul gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa gang snang ba thams cad 'di sems kyi rol rtsal yin par ha go ba red/ mdo sdud pa nang la gsung pa nang bzhin gyi/ nam mkha' mthong zhes sems can tshig tu rab brjod pa// nam mkha' ji ltar mthong zhes don 'di brtag par bgyi// de ltar chos mthong ba yang bde bzhin gshegs pas bstan// mthong ba dpe gzhan gyis ni bsnyad par nus ma yin// zhes bshad yong dus nam mkha' mthong zer ba'i skabs su kha dog dang 'brel yong ba'i skabs su go bde ba tsam la nam mkha' zhes btags pa red ma gtogs/ don la nam mkha' de 'dra red zer nas dpyad na ha go yag cig yod ma red pa/ sems can gyi tshig la brjod kyi yod red/ yin na yang blos nam mkha' blta ba yin bsam gyi yod red zer/ yin na yang nam mkha' ji ltar mthong gi 'dug zhib cha'i thog nas bsam blo btang na/ nam mkha' mthong yag dang mthong bya mthong byed med pa red/

de nang bzhin gyi dngos gnas drang gnas gnas lugs kyi don zer ba de'ang*/ gnas tshul sems kyi gnas tshul mthong song*/ sems kyi ngo bo mthong song zer yag de'ang ga re kho gnas lugs kyi steng la bzo bcos dang bral ba'i yin lugs shig gi steng la/ phar ma bcos pa bzhag thub na de la gnas lugs kyi don mthong lab pa red ma gtogs/ mthong rgyu dngos gnas rdog rdog 'dra po rig rgyu yod nas mthong bsdad pa yin na/ de gnas lugs mthong ba de'i steng la slebs thub kyi yod sa ma red/ 'di de 'dra yin pa'i skabs la rig bya rig byed med pa'i tshul gyis mthong dgos pa red 'dug /mthong ba la yang dpe gzhan gyis mtshon mi thub pa red/ phra phyir thos pa'i yul min cing*// don dam phyir na bsam pas med// chos nyid zab phyir 'jig rten gyi// sgom pa la sogs yul ma yin// 'jig rten pa'i thos bsam sgom gsum gyi thog nas bshad mi thub pa red/ brda dang tha snyad kyi thog nas de 'dra zhig yod red ces ga tshod bshad bsdad pa yin na'ang bshad mi thub pa red/ rgyal ba klong chen pas/ 'di don brjod la rgyal ba'i ljags kyang sdug / gsungs pa red/ gang ltar de'i 'grel bshad rgyab dgos song na bcom ldan 'das kyis zhal ldig 'gro gi red lab pa red/ de 'dra yin dus kho 'grel bshad rgyab yag cig la mtshon byed kyi dpe zhig bshad mi thub pa red/ de 'dra yin dus kho nyams myong gi steng nas 'grel yong dus kho nyams myong gi thog nas mtshon yong dus kho de 'dra zhig red/ nyams su myong ba'i tshul gyis rig dgos pa red ma gtogs de la rnam 'gyur hur da phur da byas na yang rig rgyu med pa yin pa red 'dug /de 'dra yin dus/ yul med sems su mthong*/ zer yag 'di gnas tshul de 'dra yin sa red/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i sgom byung gi shes rab kyis de kho na nyid la ma bcos pa'i gnas tshul mthong yong dus/

lta ba'i yul thams cad de'ang phyi'i yul drug la sogs pa gang shar gyi chos thams cad 'di sems kyi rang bzhin mthong thub kyi red/ de 'dra yin dus dang po snang ba thams cad sems su grub pa red/ 2 sems kyang gzhi med rtsa bral du mthong ba/ 'o na sems bden par grub pa red pas zer na ma red/ sems la bltas pas sems med ngo bos stong*// de yin pa'i skabs la 'o na sems kho rang bden par grub pa red pas zer na ma red/ de bzhin du sems nyid kyi rang ngo la bltas pas sems nyid kyi rang ngo la blta bya lta byed yod ma red de yin na yang blta dgos pa red/ blta bya lta byed med na yang blta dgos pa red/ sems nyid kyi rang ngo la rang gis nyams su myong ba'i tshul gyis blta yong dus/ de nas mnyam par bzhag pa'i mthu la brten nas de nas sems kho rang yang gzhi med pa/ rtsa ba dang bral ba de nas mthong thub pa red/ sems med ngo bos stong*/ sems kho rang yang med pa red/ sems kyi ngo bo yang de 'dra po zhig yod red zer nas mtshon bya mtshon byed gang yang med pa red/ sems kho rang yang gzhi med pa/ rtsa ba dang bral ba gzhi med rtsa bral du rtogs thub kyi red/ sems kyi ngo bo la phar bltas pas dang po/ sems kyi ngo bo la bltas pas sems kho rang yang gzhi med rtsa bral du stong pa nyid la rtogs thub pa red/ 3 snang sems gnyis 'dzin rang sar grol ba/ de nas gnyis la bltas pas/ snang sems gnyis ka la blta yong dus ro gcig tu 'dres pa red/ snang sems gnyis ro gcig tu 'dres yong dus snang sems ro gcig tu 'dres yong dus gnyis 'dzin gyi rang sar grol song ba red/ yul dang yul can gnyis su 'dzin pa zhig dang*/ 'o 'khor ba'i skyon 'di nas bshad kyi yod red/ 'khrul yong dus 'di skyon 'di bral ba red/ red 'dug a/ snang sems gnyis 'di ro gcig tu rtogs yong dus yul dang yul can gnyis su 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gi skyon 'di rang sar grol gyi red/

sbrul gyi mdud pa rang sar grol ba nang bzhin/ sbrul rang sar du grol ba la sbrul gyi mdud pa kho rang rgyab kyis red/ bshig yang kho rang gis bshig 'gro gi red ma gtogs nga tshos bshig yag 'gro dgos kyi yod ma red/ de nang bzhin byas nas kho sbrul gyi mdud pa rang sar grol ba nang bzhin gyis yul dang yul can gnyis su 'dzin pa'i rtog pa de'ang rang sar zhi thub kyi red/ 'od gsal sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs par shog /de 'dra'i thog nas snang ba sems su sgrub/ sems stong pa nyid la sgrub/ de nas de'ang gsal stong gnyis su med pa snang sems ro gcig tu rtogs thub pa yin na thabs de lta bu la brten nas phyag chen pa'i skabs la/ snang ba sems/ sems stong pa/ stong pa lhun grub/ lhun grub rang grol du ngo sprod pa dngos gnas drang gnas/ rje btsun mi la dang dwags po rin po che gnyis de 'dra byas nas mar ngo sprod kyi tshul du gsungs gnang gi yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus snang ba sems su bsgrub/ 4 snang stong lhun 'grub tu yod pa/ sems kho rang yang snang ba sems su bsgrub song na sems kho rang bden pa red pas zer na ma red/ stong nyid du sgrub/ stong pa nyid de'ang stong pa stong rkyang ci yang med pa ci med cang med nam mkha' lta bu red pas zer na ma red/ stong pa de'ang lhun grub/ sangs rgyas kyi sku dang ye shes 'du bral med pa ye gdod ma nas kho rang bral min yon tan drug cu la sogs pa gtso bo byas pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yon tan thams cad rang bzhin gyis lhun gyis grub bsdad pa bzo bcos la bsten mi dgos pa rgyu rkyen la brten mi dgos pa kho rang bzhin gyis lhun grub kyi tshul du yod pa red/ stong pa'i ngang du lhun grub yod pa lhun grub de lta bu zhig yod pa'i cha nas gnyen po bsten na'ang 'dra/ ma bsten yang 'dra/ sems can thams cad ye gdod ma nas kho gnas lugs kyi steng la rang grol yin pa red/

'o de 'dra yin dus de 'dra'i gnas lugs kyi steng la slebs yong dus 'od gsal sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs par shog /sgrib pa dang bral ba dper na nyi ma sprin las grol ba nang bzhin yin pa red/ nyi ma kho rang dus rtag par sprin pas bsgribs na'ang 'dra/ ma bsgribs na yang 'dra/ nyi ma'i ngo la shar dang ma shar gyi dbye ba med pa red/ yin na yang nga rang tsho'i ngo la sprin pa yod med la nyi ma shar ma shar gyi dbye ba nang bzhin gyi sems kyi gnas lugs kyi de bzhin nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'di sems can 'di ye gdod ma nas rang chas su yod pa red/ ji tsam ji tsam nyon mongs pa shugs chen po yod na yang sems kyi gnas lugs la sgrib yag med pa red/ ji tsam ji tsam gnyen po bsten nas nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa la sogs spang yong dus sems kyi ngo bo kho rang dag tu dag tu 'gro yag yod ma red/ yin na yang nyon mongs pa glo bur ba yin pa yin dus/ glo bur dri ma 'di pha spangs yong dus rang la yod pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'di ye gdod ma nas rang chas su yod bsdad yag 'di/ rgyu rkyen la bltos mi dgos pa 'di dngos gnas drang gnas kyi rang bzhin lhan skyes su yod bsdad yag 'di tsam ngo shes pa red/ ngo shes pa la sangs rgyas zer ba red/ rang la yod pa'i gnas lugs lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'di ngo shes pa'am rang la yod pa'i ca lag ngo shes pa nang bzhin chags yong ba yin na grol ba yong ba red/ de la brten nas rang grol zer ngo shes pa red/ 'o 'di yin dus 'od gsal sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs par shog zer sgrib pa dang bral ba'i gnas lugs 'di rtogs thub par shog / dza zhi lhag zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor de'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs/ yid byed bral ba 'di ni phyag rgya che// mtha' dang bral ba dbu ma chen po yin// 'di ni kun 'dus rdzogs chen zhes kyang bya//

gcig shes kun don rtogs pa'i gdengs thob shog / 1 yid byed bral ba la phyag chen du btags tshul/ ming mang po yod red ces lab pa red/ rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de la dus gsum gyi 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da lta ba la sogs pa dang*/ de ga nang bzhin gyi bdag dang gzhan la sogs pa de 'dra'i dbye ba dbye ba'i yid la bya rgyu/ bsam blo btang yag zer na yang mi 'dug /gang ltar yid la bya rgyu dang*/ yid la byed mkhan dang*/ yid la byed pa mtha' dag dang bral yong ba de la mtshan gzhan ga re btags yod red zer na/ lhan cig skyes pa ji lta ba rtogs pa de la phyag rgya chen po zer btags yod red/ bcos min blos de dang zhes byas nas gang yang bzang ngan spang blang la sogs gang yang med pa gang shar rjes med du skyong thub na de la phyag rgya chen po zhes btags bzhag red lab pa red/ phyag rgya chen po zer yong dus phyag zer yag 'di/ phyis su lo tsā ba rnams kyis gsar pa bsnan pa rgyab pa red ma gtogs don la mu dra zhes byas nas kho rang legs sbyar skad nang la rgya zhes yong ba yin dus/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la de 'dra bo'i ga re zer dgos red/ rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i chos nyid kyi gnas tshul 'di 'khor 'das thams cad la khyab bsdad yod pa red/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyang lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de'i ngang la yod red/ chos nyid de lta bu'i ngang nas ma 'das pa red/ dbyings de lta bu'i ngang nas ma 'das pa red/ dbyings de'i nang la yod bsdad pa red/ de'ang yon tan thams cad ye nas rdzogs pa'i thog nas yod red/ skyon thams cad ye nas zad pa'i thog nas yong gi yod red ma gtogs/ skyon gsar du spang yag dang yon tan gsar du bsgrub yag de 'dra gang yang med pa red/ de 'dra yin dus lhan cig skyes pa'i gnas lugs 'di 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad de'i ngang la yod pas dper na rgya 'dra po zhig yin pa red/

rgyal pos dmangs su rgya gnang yong dus rgya de'i 'og la 'bangs kyis rgyal po'i bka' de las ldog thub kyi yod ma red/ de las phar 'da' thub kyi yod ma red/ de dang 'dra po 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad 'di de'i ngang las phar 'da' sa med pa'i phyir na rgya lab pa red/ 'di'i tshig 'di yang gzhan dag la nor 'gro gi red dran nas lo tsā ba thams cad kyis kyang phyag zer ba'i tshig gcig sbyar ba red/ de 'dra zhig byas nas stong pa'i ye shes de la phyag zer yag 'di stong pa'i ye shes la go ba red/ rgya zer yag 'di de las ma 'das pa red/ 'grel bshad de 'dra byas bskyon gyi yod red/ 2 yid byed bral ba la dbu ma chen por btags tshul/ yang mtshan gzhan btags yong dus yang yod pa dang med pa/ gnyis ka dang gnyis min la sogs pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis rtsa shes kyi bstod pa nang la gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi mgo la mchod brjod nang la/ gang gis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*// 'gag pa med pa skye med pa// chad pa med pa rtag med pa// 'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa// tha dad don min don gcig min// spros pa nyer zhi/ zhes spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba mtha' bzhi dang spros pa brgyad dang bral ba/ spros pa mtha' dag nye bar zhi ba'i dbyings de la dbu ma chen po zhes ming btags pa red/ dbu ma chen po zer yag 'di mtha' dbus dang bral bas na dbu ma chen po zhes ming btags na yang 'grig gi red/ de 'dra'i yid byed dang bral ba'i phyag rgya chen po de yang mtha' thams cad dang bral dgos red ma gtogs/ yang mtha' dang ma bral ba'i phyag rgya chen po yod ma red/ de 'dra yin dus kho sngon la lta ba'i dpyad pa byed yag 'di sngon du nges par du 'gro dgos rgyu yod red/ lta ba'i dpyad pa sngon du ma song na lta ba de'i steng la phab pa'i dgongs pa la nges shes nges thub kyi yod ma red/ gang zag dbang po rim gyis pa 'di mang gi red/

cig car ba 'di nyung gi yod red/ 'di'i cha nas kho yin gcig min gcig dang po 'di lta ba'i dpyad pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa red/ yin na yang gnas lugs kyi steng la slebs yong dus rnam rtog gi dpyad pa mang po mi byed pa red/ kho yin lugs gang yin pa de'i steng la ma bcos pa mnyam par bzhag yong dus phyag rgya chen po lab yong gi yod red/ de'i sngon la de 'dra yi gnas lugs 'di mtha' thams cad dang bral ba yin pa red/ yod pa'i mtha' yang yod ma red/ med pa'i mtha' yang yod ma red/ gnyis ka dang gnyis min thams cad kyi sgro 'dogs thams cad las 'das pa red/ rnam rtog gi drwa ba thams cad 'das pa'i phyir na dbu ma chen po zer/ spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i nges shes kyi dbyings yin pa red/ de ni rdzogs chen yang red/ phyag rgya chen po'ang red/ dbu ma chen po'ang red/ rdzogs pa chen po'ang red/ 3 yid byed bral ba la rdzogs chen du btags tshul/ rdzogs chen zer yag 'di ni kun 'dus rdzogs chen zhes kyang bya de 'dra zhig dngos gnas drang gnas kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gang yin pa 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad 'di de'i nang la rdzogs bsdad pa'am tshang bsdad kyi yod red/ rdzogs zer ba'i skabs la tshang bsdad pa/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad de'i nang la yod red/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad de'i klong nas mar 'byung ba red/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad de'i dbang du yar rdzogs pa yin pa red/ 'byung khungs thams cad dang spro bsdu mar spros yag dang yar bsdu yag spro bsdu dang*/ 'byung tshul thams cad yang gtso bo gang las yong gi yod red zer na/ 'di lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de'i steng nas yong gi yod red/ ngos 'dzin byed stangs ma 'dra ba red/ tha snyad bed spyod byed stangs ma 'dra ba red ma gtogs de ka rang yong bsdad kyi yod red/ de la rdzogs chen zer nas ming btags na'ang mi 'grig pa min 'dug gsungs pa red/

mang po yod red/ kho mkhas pa so sor gang bshad bshad yin pa red/ 'di yin dus kho don dag de'i steng la slebs thub pa zhig 'byung na tha snyad 'di ga re sbyar na'ang gcig pa red/ gang ltar dbu ma lab na'ang khos de ka rang la go bsdad rgyu yin pa red/ rdzogs chen zhes lab na'ang 'khor 'das thams cad 'di gnas lugs lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de'i nang la ye gdod ma nas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rdzogs bsdad pa'am tshang bsdad pa red/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad de'i dbang du phar gyur pa red/ de'i nang la phar thim pa red zer na de ka rang red/ phyag rgya chen po'i skabs su de ka rang bshad bsdad kyi yod red/ tha snyad btags stangs dang*/ 'grel ba rgyab stangs dang*/ bzo lta bkod stangs ma 'dra ba red ma gtogs gcig pa yin pa red/ don dag 'di 'o de 'dra byas gcig shes kun don rtogs pa'i gdengs thob shog /

zhi lhag 'di shes tshar ba'i skabs la/ yang nyams dang rtogs pa shes dgos pa red/ nyams rtogs ma shes na/ yang zhi lhag shes bsdad pa yin na yang nyams gang 'dra gcig yong gi yod na/ de yang rtogs pa zer yag 'di gang 'dra ci yong gi yod na bsam gyi yod red/ yang de la dang po nyams bshad pa red/ nyams de la/ wa nyams skye tshul/ zhen pa med pa'i bde chen rgyun chad med// mtshan 'dzin med pa'i 'od gsal sgrib g.yogs bral// blo las 'das pa'i mi rtog lhun gyis grub// rtsol med nyams myong rgyun chad med par shog / 1 bde ba'i nyams bstan pa/ 'di zhi lhag gi rnam dpyod la yid mnyam par bzhag yong dus skyon med pa'i nyams gsum zer yag cig 'ong gi yod red/ de la dang po de la spyir btang kyi bde ba'i nyams/ gsal ba'i nyams/ mi rtog pa'i nyams zer thun mong dngos kyi skad cha zhig red/ de tsam mi rtog pa zer ba 'di bde ba'i nyams dang*/ gsal ba'i nyams dang*/ mi rtog pa'i nyams zhes nyams gsum bshad yag yod red/ de nas bden 'dzin dang chags 'dzin chags pa dang 'dzin pa dang*/ bden pa'i rnam rtog la sogs pa zhen pa zer yag de'i nang la mang po go gi yod red/ gtso bo bden 'dzin bzhag dgos pa red/ bden par zhen pa'i blo dang*/ 'dzin chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa'i bden 'dzin 'dra po zhen chags 'di med yong dus/ zhen pa 'di med pa'am zhen pa 'di spang yong dus/ de nas gang zag de lta bu'i rgyud la mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po 'di lus sems gnyis ka de skabs la bde ba zer yag 'di lus sems gnyis ka la go ba red ma gtogs sems rkyang pa'i bde ba ma red/ de 'dra yin dus lus kyi bde ba dang*/ sems kyi bde ba gnyis ka yin par go ba red 'dug /de yin dus lus sems gnyis ka'i bde ba de rgyun chad med pa/ nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu bde ba de rgyun chad med pa/ lus sems gnyis kyi bde ba ngo ma 'dzin byed ma thub pa dngos gnas drang nas bde ba rgyun chad med pa yong gi red/

2 dga' bzhi dang stong bzhi'i 'brel yul/ dga' ba/ mchog dga'/ lhan cig skyes dga'/ dga' bral/ dga' ba bzhi dang stong pa bzhi'i 'brel yul/ bde chen 'di kho na rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i brgyud nas 'gro yong dus/ gnam nyin mtshan med pa gang zag de lta bu 'di bde ba'i dbyings la rgyun mi chad pa byas nas rtag par bsdad thub kyi yod sa red/ sngags kyi skabs su sngags kyi phyag rgya'i skabs de 'dra rang yong gi yod red/ dga' bzhi skyes pa'i ye shes la de 'dra yin dus/ mdo yi skabs la kho zhen 'dzin dang 'dzin chags dang de 'dra med yin dus kho'i rgyud la bde ba chen po rgyun chad yod ma red/ nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu bung ba gnam la 'khor ba nang bzhin byas nas skad rgyun chad med pa yong gi 'dug /de ka nang bzhin gyis lus sems gnyis ka la bde ba rgyun chad med pa shar gyi red lab pa red 'dug /gtso bo 'di phal cher nyams 'dra po de gtso bo tshogs sbyor skabs la yong gi yod sa red/ 'di phyag chen skabs kyi red 'dug go/ ma gtogs yang thun mong ba'i mdo'i skabs la tshogs lam/ sbyor lam/ skor gyi skad cha bshad kyi med pa red/ 3 gsal ba'i nyams bstan pa/ phyag chen skabs la yang de 'dra gnyis de ga re yin dgos red zer na/ phyag rgya chen po'i skabs kyi tshogs sbyor la yong gi yod red lab pa red/ de nas 'o na sa dang po mthong lam thob pa'i skabs la ga re yong dgos red zer na/ mtshan 'dzin med pa'i 'od gsal sgrib g.yogs bral// de'i skabs la bde ba'i nyams 'di yag po byas nas shar thub na/ de nas gsal ba dang*/ mi rtog pa skye yag sla bo yod pa red 'dug /de 'dra yin dus mtshan 'dzin med pa'i zer ba'i skabs su yul la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i blo med pa yin dus/ shes pa 'di bying rmugs kyi skyon gyis ma gos pa zhig dgos kyi yod red/ bying ba dang rgod pa la sogs pa de 'dra'i skyon med yong dus gtso bo 'di mtshan 'dzin de la bzhag pa red/

shes pa bying rmugs kyi skyon med yong dus de nas rang rig 'od gsal 'di la nyi ma'i sprin dang bral ba nang bzhin gyi nyon mongs pa'i bying rgod la sogs pa gtso bo byas pa'i nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang bral yong dus rang rig 'od gsal nyams rgyun chad med pa shar thub pa red 'dug /'di gsal ba'i nyams red/ rgyun chad med pa'i nyams/ sgrib g.yog dang bral ba'i nyams/ nyams gnyis pa de mthong lam la slebs pa byas/ 4 mi rtog pa'i nyams bstan pa/ de nas blo las 'das pa'i mi rtog thams cad sgrub tshar dus mthong lam nas byas nas theg pa chen po 'phags lam thams cad nas yong gi yod red/ blo kun rdzob pa'i skyon med kyi blo'i dpyod yul las 'das yong dus rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa 'di slebs yong gi yod red/ rnam par mi rtog pa 'di sgom lam skabs su yong gi yod red/ lhun gyis grub 'dug a/ da lta lhun gyis grub pa de sgom lam pa'i skabs su yong gi yod pa red/ de yin dus lhun gyis grub pa'i nyams/ de gsum byed nas de gsum po 'di rtsol med nyams myong rgyun chad med par shog /de lta bu'i nyams gsum de slebs e yong bsam pa'i re ba/ 'o nyams gsum po yong gi min 'dug ga re byed song bsam pa'i dwogs pa/ 'o de 'dra'i re dwogs slebs na yang skyon yong gi yod red/ bde ba la zhen na 'dod khams la gol ba/ gsal ba la zhen na gzugs khams la gol/ mi rtog pa la zhen na gzugs med kyi khams la gol ba zhig gi gang ltar bde gsal mi rtog gsum la zhen yong dus/ 'bras bu khams gsum re re bzhin du 'gro yag gi skyon zhig bshad bsdad kyi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus nyams skyon dang bcas pa zhes slebs yong dus nyams skyon can 'di yang zhen na skyon can slebs kyi red/ ma zhen na skyon ma red/ nyams dgos dgos kyi yod red/

nyams la zhen na skyon yin pa red/ 5 nyams dgos kyang der zhen na phan thogs med pa/ yang nyams zer mkhan dngos nas dgos yag cig red pas zer na/ dgos yag cig red/ de la zhen na phan thogs yod ma red/ ga re zer na/ nyams nag khung nang bzhin red/ smug pa nang bzhin red/ kho yal 'gro gi red/ rlung brgyab na brlag 'gro gi red/ de 'dra yin dus kho ya gi rtogs pa'i steng la slebs yong dus nyams brlag 'gro gi yod red/ rje btsun mi las kyang*/ nyams na bun dang 'dra ste yal nas 'gro// rtogs pa nam mkha' dang 'dra ste 'gyur ba med// zhes gsungs yong dus kho nyams zer mkhan 'di nag khung smug pa nang bzhin red/ yal 'gro gi red/ de'i nang nas rnyed yong ba'i rtogs pa 'dra po de kho nam mkha' nang bzhin red/ de la kho 'gyur ba yong gi ma red/ de 'dra yin dus rtsol med nyams myong rgyun chad med par shog /rtsol ba med pa zhig dgos rgyu yod red/ yang rtsol ba med pa zer ba 'di re dwogs med pa zhig la gtso bo go dgos kyi yod sa red/ slebs yong bsam pa'i de 'dra'i nyams gsum 'di 'byung na bsam pa 'dra po re ba dang*/ de 'dra zhig slebs ma song ga re yin na bsam pa'i dwogs pa 'dra po de 'dra'i rtsol ba med pa gnyug ma'i ngang du phar rang babs kyi thog la phar rang sar nyams su myong thub pa zhig dgos kyi yod red/ rtsol med nyams myong rgyun chad med par shog /de yang rgyun chad med pa yong bar shog lab pa red/ de rgyun chad med pa la de 'dra'i nyams myong 'di rtag par yong bar shog /chags pa la zhen pa 'di bde ba'i nyams red/ mtshan ma la 'dzin pa de 'od gsal red/ de nas blos gzung ba yin na mi rtog pa'i skyon red/ 'di gsum po 'di phar spangs yong dus bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams gsum po 'di rgyun chad med pa slebs thub kyi yod sa red/ 'di la 'dzin chags yod na nyams gsum po 'di rgyun chad med par yong thub kyi yod sa ma red/

'gag 'gro gi yod red/ 'di nyams byas/ rtogs pa 'di gang 'dra yod red zer na rtogs pa 'di/ zha rtogs pa skye tshul/ bzang zhen nyams kyi 'dzin pa rang sar grol// ngan rtog 'khrul pa rang bzhin dbyings su dag / tha mal shes pa spang blang bral thob med// spros bral chos nyid bden pa rtogs par shog / 1 nyams kyi bzang zhen spang dgos pa/ nyams 'di skyes pa la rtogs pa 'di yong gi yod red/ nyams skyes tshar nas yang brlag 'gro gi yod ma red/ rtogs pa yong gi yod red/ nyams kyi rjes thob rtogs pa/ rtogs pa 'di gang 'dra yod red zer na/ bzang zhen nyams kyi 'dzin pa rang sar grol// zhes nyams skyes yong dus nyams 'di yag po yin pa red bsam nas nyams la bzang por zhen pa slebs yag skyon yod red/ de 'dra yin dus nyams la bzang po zhen song na yang 'di skyon yin pa yin dus de 'dra'i bzang po la zhen pa'i nyams kyi 'dzin pa'am/ de'i nga rgyal de'i rlom sems 'dra po rang sar grol ba/ sbrul mdud rang sar grol ba lta bu gnyen po lam sang bsten thub kyi yod red/ gnyen po lam sang bsten yong dus kho lam bzang zhen gyi rtog pa slebs 'ong na'ang de la zhen ma song ba/ 'dzin ma song ba zhig dgos kyi yod red/ bzang po'i yon tan ci byung na// de la snyems rtog med par shog / gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi de la nga rgyal dang che 'dzin dang rlom sems byed mi rung ba bshad pa red 'dug /'di 'byung ba yin na skyon yong gi red/ yang 'khrul shes kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ ngan rtog 'khrul pa rang bzhin dbyings su dag /ces ngan pa'i rtog pa zer yag 'di 'khrul pa'i chos kyi rjes su 'gro nas 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug la sogs pa de 'dra'i ngan pa'i rtog pa/ ngan rtog yin na yang 'di ched du spang na spang yag med pa red/ ngan rtog slebs song yag po byung ma song*/ 'di dngos gnas drang gnas thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa la bar du gcod mkhan zhig red bsam bsdad na yang 'di spang dgos kyi 'dug bsam nas gnyen po bsten dgos kyi 'dug bsam na'ang 'di skyon bshad pa red/

de skabs la ngan rtog gi 'khrul pa dang po mgo la/ bzang zhen nyams kyi 'dzin pa rang sar grol ba nang bzhin 'khrul pa chos kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i ngan pa'i rnam rtog de'ang ched du spang mi dgos pa mnyam par bzhag yong dus kho rang bzhin gyis grub pa 'di dbyings su dag thub kyi red gsungs pa red/ 2 'khrul pa'i rnam rtog thams cad dgag thub pa/ de kho na nyid kyi gnas lugs kyi steng la slebs yong dus kho me 'di ga tshad thag nye na yang kho mar la sogs pa 'di tsho dro dus kho mkhregs po bsdad yag gi go skabs med pa yin dus/ mnyam bzhag gi nus pa de'i steng nas 'khrul chos kyi rnam par rtog pa thams cad de'ang kho mkhregs po bsdad yag gi go skabs med pa yin pa red/ de 'dra yin dus mnyam par bzhag la de kho na nyid la sems yong dus/ 'khrul pa'i rnam rtog thams cad kyang dbyings su rang bzhin gyis dag thub kyi red ces lab pa red 'dug / 3 tha mal gyi shes pa mthong thub pa/ tha mal shes pa spang blang bral thob med// 'di 'dra'i bzang zhen gyi rtog pa rang sar grol/ ngan rtog gi 'khrul pa yang mnyam par bzhag pa'i blo'i stobs kyis dbyings su dag yong dus/ 'di'i nang nas ga re yod red zer na/ tha mal gyi shes pa zer mkhan zhig rnyed kyi red lab pa red 'dug /tha mal gyi shes pa zer yag 'di ga re/ gnyug ma'i sems red/ de'i skabs la tha mal zer yag 'di ma bcos pa rtsis bcug yag red/ tha mal zer yag 'di ma bcos pa'am rang babs/ de 'dra la tha mal lab kyi yod red/ tha mal gyi shes pa/ 'di bzang po'i rnam rtog de'ang spang*/ ngan pa'i rnam rtog spang yong dus bzang ngan gyi rtog pa gnyis spang tshar ba'i rjes la ga re lhag yong gi yod red zer na/ bzo bcos rtsa nas med/ bzo bcos la ma song ba'i bcos ma'i blo ma yin pa/ bcos ma'i dbang du ma song ba/ bzo bcos kyi dbang du ma song ba'i ye gdod ma nas rang chas su yod bsdad pa'i tha mal gyi shes pa zhig rnyed kyi red/

'o 'di tha mal gyi shes pa de'i steng la 'di spang bya red/ 'di blang bya red zer yag med pa red/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// zer ba'i skabs tshig 'di de skabs la yong gi yod red/ 'di la zer ba'i skabs de 'dra'i tha mal gyi shes pa 'di la bsal bar bya ba'i yon tan 'di gsar du bsgrub dgos yag med pa red/ tshur bsgrub yag yin dus gsar du sgrub dgos yag med pa red ga re zer na yon tan thams cad ye nas rdzogs pa yin pa red/ phar spang ya'i nyon mongs pa yod ma red/ ga re red zer na nyon mongs ye nas zad pa red/ nyon mongs ye nas med pa red/ de 'dra yin dus tha mal gyi shes pa kho rang gi ngo bo la spang blang yod ma red/ spang bya'i cha thams cad phar bral yag yod ma red/ blang bya'i yon tan thams cad tshur gsar du thob yag yang med pa red/ spang blang bral thob med/ 'di yin dus spros bral chos nyid bden pa rtogs par shog /spros pa dang bral ba'i gnas lugs chos nyid kyi don dam pa'i bden pa 'di/ tshur ji lta ba bzhin du ma nor ba de 'dra byas nas yong ba rtogs par shog gsungs pa red 'dug /da 'di ni snying rje red/ 'di tsho tog tsam go bde bo yod red/ za snying rje chen po ngos bzung ba/ 'gro ba'i rang bzhin rtag tu sangs rgyas kyang*// ma rtogs dbang gis mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams// sdug bsngal mu mtha' med pa'i sems can la// bzod med snying rje rgyud la skye bar shog / 1 dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje la go dgos pa/ de la yang snying rje la spyir btang gsum yod red/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje gsum bshad kyi yod red/ 'di'i skabs kyi snying rje 'di dmigs med kyi snying rje go dgos kyi yod red/ ga re red zer na/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang*/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje gnyis phyag chen gyi sngon 'gro skabs la bshad tshar ba red/

phyag chen gyi sngon 'gro'i skabs su sems bskyed kyi skabs su sbyar tshar ba red/ 'di de la mi dgos ba red/ de 'dra yin dus 'di'i skabs la gtso bo 'di 'gro ba'i rang bzhin rtag tu sangs rgyas yin na yang*/ ma rtogs dbang gis mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams// sdug bsngal mu mtha' med pa'i sems can la// bzod med snying rje rgyud la skye bar shog /zer ya'i bzod du med pa'i snying rje 'di dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje la yin gcig min gcig go dgos kyi yod red 'dug /'di yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ga re red zer na/ gnas lugs kyi don mthong nas dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje skye dgos pa red/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje skye dgos pa'i dus tshod 'di ga dus skye gyi red zer na/ gnas lugs kyi don 'di mthong tshar nas dmigs med snying rje skyes kyi 'dug ba/ de red ma gtogs tshab la gnas lugs kyi don 'di ma mthong ba la dmigs med snying rje skye thub kyi yod ma red/

2 sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya rung du bstan pa/ de 'dra yin dus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin nam 'gro ba'i gnas tshul 'di/ dus rtag tu sangs rgyas red/ 'di zer ba'i skabs la rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha nas bshad kyi yod red/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha nas bshad yong dus/ 'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu// zhes bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po 'dis sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la khyab bsdad pa red/ ma 'ongs pa la 'tshang rgya rung yin pa red/ 'tshang rgya rung yin pa yin dus sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi khams/ sa bon/ nus pa/ rigs/ ga re lab na yang gang ltar 'di yod pa red/ sa bon 'dra po 'di yod pa yin dus/ 'gro ba'i rang bzhin 'di dus rtag tu sangs rgyas red/ ngo bo la chos nyid 'di chos can gyi tshul du yod pa red 'dug /chos nyid don dam pa'i gnas tshul 'di sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la chos can gyi tshul du khyab bsdad pa red/ 3 glo bur gyi dri mas sgrib par bstan pa/ yin na yang rang gi ngo bo 'di glo bur gyi dri mas sgrib bsdad dus ma mthong ba yin pa red 'dug a/ dper na gser gyi gzugs 'di sgrib pa bzhin/ gser gyi gzugs 'di sa dang rdul la sogs pas sgrib pa nang bzhin gyis thog med nas goms pa'i bag chags ma rig pa nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyi dbang gis sems kyi gnas lugs la bsgrib bsdad pa red/ ma gtogs ngo bo'i thog nas sems can dang*/ sangs rgyas gnyis la khyad par med pa red/ spang bya mtha' dag zad pa'i cha dang*/ yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i cha nas sems can gnas lugs de lta bu tha mal gyi shes pa de'i ngo bo la sangs rgyas dang*/ sems can gnyis la khyad par med pa red/ 'di mngon du 'gyur ma 'gyur zhig gi khyad par yin dus sems can dang sangs rgyas byas nas gang ltar ga re red/ 'o sems kyi rang ngo zin ma zin zhig gi khyad par la gtso bo 'di 'khrul grol gnyis kyi sa mtshams 'di sems kyi rang so zin ma zin la bzhag yod red/

sems kyi rang so ma zin yong dus 'khrul pa zhes bshad pa red/ sems kyi rang so 'di zin yong dus grol ba zhes bshad kyi yod red/ de yin dus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin 'di dus rtag tu sangs rgyas red zer ba'i skabs la chos sku'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa red/ de yang rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos sku'i rang bzhin khyab bsdad yod red/ yin na yang 'o na sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas yod na ga re byas nas 'khrul pa red zer ba'i skabs su tshad ma rnam 'grel las gsungs pa nang bzhin gyis/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas sgrib// ces bshad yong dus/ ma rtogs dbang gis mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams// zer yag 'di gcig pa yin pa red/ de lta bu'i sems kyi rang bzhin 'di ga re/ chos nyid kyi gnas tshul de las ma 'das pa red de yin na yang 'di ma rtogs pa red/ ga re byas nas ma rtogs pa red zer na/ ma rig pa rmongs pa'i dbang gis de'i nang nas gtso bo rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi dang po ma rig pa nyon mongs pa'i dbang du gyur pa'i ma rig pa de yis ma mthong ba red/ nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa red/ kha sang mgo la bshad pa nang bzhin gyi rang snang la yul du 'khrul ba/ rang rig la bdag tu 'khrul nas gnyis 'dzin gyi dbang gis 'khor ba la 'khyams yong dus/ de 'dra ma gtogs ma rig pa de'i dbang gis rang la yod pa'i dngos po 'di rang gis ma mthong ba red/ de la brten nas mtha' med pa rang gi rang la sdug bsngal bzo nas dper na bum pa nang la thim song ba'i bung ba nang bzhin red/ bum pa nang la chud bsdad pa'i bung ba nang bzhin gyi don med pa'i 'khor bar 'khor bsdad pa red/ mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba la sdug bsngal mu mtha' med par 'khyams bsdad pa red/ de 'dra don med pa'i sdug bsngal mu mtha' med pa'i sems can la/ don med pa'i sdug bsngal yong bsdad pa'i sems can mu mtha' med pa de rnams la don med pa red/

ga re red zer na/ rang la de lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong mi dgos ya'i cha rkyen cha tshang tshang bsdad yod red de/ rang la de 'dra'i sdug bsngal myong mi dgos pa'i cha can 'di bed spyod btang mi shes pa red/ de 'dra'i cha can 'di ngos 'dzin byed ma thub yong dus/ don med pa'i sdug bsngal zhig myong bsdad pa red/ de 'dra yin dus sdug bsngal don med pa'i sdug bsngal ji lta bu myong bsdad pa'i sems can 'di gtso bo ga ba nas yong ba red zer na/ bdag med pa la bdag tu zhen/ bden par ma grub pa la bden zhen gyi rtog pa 'byung nas gtso bo 'di zhen yul la 'khrul pa'i blo phyin ci log pa'i 'khrul snang zhig la go dgos pa red/ zhen yul la 'khrul pa'i log shes zer na de las yong gi yod pa yin dus/ de 'dra'i zhen yul la 'khrul pa'i log shes 'di spang bar bya ba'i ched du bzod med snying rje rgyud la skye bar shog /zer yag 'di gtso bo 'di dmigs med kyi snying rje go song a/ 4 snying rje skye dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ da lta 'di snying rje skye dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de ga re red zer na/ sems can thams cad la snying rje skye dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di pha ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bshad kyi yod ma red/ sems can thams cad la snying rje skye dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di 'brel ba yod pa'i cha nas rgyu mtshan bshad kyi yod ma red/ ga re byas nas snying rje skye dgos pa red zer na snying rje dngos gnas drang gnas kyi snying rje mtshan nyid pa 'di skye yag la de lta bu'i ma 'ongs pa la 'tshang rgya thub ya/ sdug bsngal thams cad zad thub dang*/ yon tan thams cad ye nas rdzogs bsdad pa'i gnas lugs de lta bu de'i steng la slebs yag la dka' las med pa/ de 'dra zhig mthong gi yod red/ chos nyid kyi bden pa gzigs bsdad pa'i gang zag de yis gzigs yong dus de 'dra zhig gzigs yong dus de 'dra yod pa de rang la rang gis de lta bu yod pa de ma shes nas 'di bed spyod btang ma shes nas don med pa'i sdug bsngal zhig myong bsdad kyi yod red/

de ma gtogs rang la ma 'ongs pa la sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mtha' dag thob ya'i cha rkyen thams cad med na/ ga tshad cig thabs shes byas na'ang sangs rgyas thub kyi yod ma red/ gal te sangs rgyas khams med na// sdug la skyo bar mi 'gyur zhing*// mya ngan 'das la 'dod pa dang*// don gnyer smon pa'ang med par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa nang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas khams med na nges 'byung skye gi ma red/ thar pa don gnyer gyi blo skye gi ma red/ thar pa don gnyer byas na'ang phan 'dogs kyi ma red/ phyi rol pa'i thar pa bsgrub pa nang bzhin chags 'gro ya'i nyen kha yod red/ de 'dra yin dus thar pa bsgrub na yang don yod pa red/ thar pa sgrub na sgrub rin chog pa zhig yod red/ ga re yod red zer na/ sangs rgyas thub pa'i cha rkyen 'di sems can thams cad la yod pa yin dus/ don dag rtsa nas med pa la cha rkyen yod kyin yod kyin la 'khor ba la don med pa'i sdug bsngal myong ba de la snying rje nges par du skye rung ba/ skye chog pa/ skye rigs yod pa zhig yin pa yin dus/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje zhes bshad pa red/ bzod med snying rje rgyud la skye bar shog /de lta bu'i snying rje de'ang gang las skyes yod red zer na/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i lta ba dang 'brel dgos pa red/ 'phags pa dang so so skye bo'i khyad par 'di 'phags pa 'di sa dang po thob yong ba'i skabs la stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba dang*/ mtha' med pa'i sdug bsngal la dmigs pa'i snying rje gnyis po 'di zung du 'brel ba'i cha nas 'phags pas sa dang po thob pa red/ tshogs sbyor gnyis kyi skabs la 'di med pa red/ 'di yin dus gnas lugs rtogs pa la brten nas dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje 'di skyes dgos kyi yod red/ 'di la brten nas de 'dra byas nas yong dgos kyi red lab pa red 'dug /dper na/ byang chub sems dpa' mnyam bzhag tu//

goms pa'i stobs kyis rdzogs pa na// dngos 'dzin gdon gyis zin pa la// khyad par du yang snying rje skye// zhes bshad pa red/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di'i blos stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba'i goms pa 'di yag po zhig rdzogs yong dus dngos 'dzin gdon gyis zin pa la lhag par du snying rje skye thub kyi yod red gsungs pa red/ dper na/ ma gcig la bu gcig ma gtogs med na brtse ba yod red/ yin na yang bu 'di yang nad kyis zin song ba 'dra po dang*/ sems gdon gyis zin song ba 'dra bo/ 'byung pos gnod pa'i thog nas smyo song ba 'dra po chags na snying rje che ru 'gro gi red ma gtogs snying rje chung du 'gro gi ma red/ de nang bzhin gyi spyir byang chub sems dpa' sa dang po tshogs sbyor gyi skabs na yang sems can thams cad la snying rje yod red/ lhag par bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba dang 'brel yong dus/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i lta ba dang 'brel yong dus/ sa dang po 'phags pa thob yong dus snying rje dang grogs stong pa nyid mnyam du 'brel/ lta ba rtogs pa'i stong nyid dang snying rje gnyis po 'brel yong dus/ dngos 'dzin gdon gyis zin pa'i so so skyes bu rnams la khyad par du yang snying rje skye/ snying rje che ru 'gro ba yin pa red/ 'o de 'dra yin dus snying rje rgyud la skye bar shog zer yag 'di dmigs med snying rje la sgrub song*/ 'a snying rje stong nyid dang zung du 'jug dgos pa/ bzod med snying rje'i rtsal yang ma 'gags pa'i// brtse dus ngo bo stong don rjen par shar// zung 'dug gol sa bral ba'i lam mchog 'di// 'bral med nyin mtshan kun tu bsgom par shog / de 'dra'i snying rje de la stong pa nyid gnyis zung du 'brel dgos pa red ma gtogs snying rje rkyang pa byas na'ang phan gyi ma red/ stong nyid rkyang par shor na'ang 'grig gi yod ma red/

byang chub sems dpa' la bdud kyi las gnyis yod gsungs pa red/ ga re red zer na/ thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab red/ shes rab dang bral ba'i thabs red/ thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab zer yag 'di/ snying rje med pa'i shes rab 'di red/ shes rab dang bral ba'i thabs zer yag 'di stong pa nyid ma rtogs pa'i snying rje zhig yod red/ de gnyis ka'i yang gcig gis srid pa khams gsum 'khor ba la 'ching gi yod red/ gcig gis zhi ba myang 'das la 'ching gi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus de 'dra'i skyon gnyis po spang yag la phar phyin nang la/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*// snying rjes zhi la mi gnas dang*// thabs ma yin pas ring ba dang*// thabs kyis ring ba ma yin nyid// zer ba'i skabs su 'bras yum shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la thag nye ru 'gro yag 'di ga re red/ theg pa chen po'i lam la bshad yod red/ ring ba 'di nyan thos pa'i theg pa dman pa'i lta ba bshad yod red/ nye ba 'di theg pa chen po'i lta ba bshad yod red/ de yang ga ba la rag las yod red zer na/ stong snying gnyis kyi zung 'jug gi lta ba zhig la sbyar te bshad yod red/ 1 snying rje ma 'gags ngang nas stong nyid shar dgos pa/ de 'dra yin dus stong pa nyid dang snying rje gnyis zung 'jug yin tshul 'di/ bzod med snying rje'i rtsal yang ma 'gags pa'i// zhes snying rje'i rtsal lam snying rje'i nus pa 'di ma 'gags pa 'char bzhin pa'i ngang nas brtse ba'i dus de nyid nas/ brtse dus ngo bo stong don rjen par shar// brtse ba'i dus de tsam nas spros bral gyi gnas lugs 'di stong nyid kyi gnas lugs 'di rjen par shar song na 'ol spyi tsam ma yin pa/ rtog pas btags pa tsam ma yin pa/ 'ol spyi don spyi tsam 'dra po zhig ma yin pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i blo zhig dgos kyi yod red/ de sa dang po yin pa red/ de 'dra yin dus brtse dus ngo bo brtse ba'i dus de nyid nas stong pa yin pa/

chos thams cad stong pa nyid yin pa'i skabs nas brtse ba'i rang mdangs ma 'gags pa de 'dra zhig dgos kyi yod red ma gtogs brtse ba dang stong pa gnyis po 'di khag khag shor song ba yin na/ snying rje skabs la stong pa brlag /stong nyid zer ba'i skabs su snying rje brlag na 'di nyams len 'di lhan cig tu sbyar ma shes na zung du 'jug pa'i lta ba slebs thub kyi yod ma red/ de 'dra yin dus brtse ba'i dus de nyid nas ngo bo stong pa yin pa/ ngo bo stong bzhin du la'ang brtse ba'i snying rje gnyis su rtsal ma 'gags pa/ 'o de 'dra'i rjen par shar/ rjen par shar zer ba'i skabs la mngon sum du rtogs pa red/ mngon sum du shar ba/ zung 'jug gol sa bral ba'i lam de 'dra po 'di gol sa bral ba'i lam nor 'khrul med pa'i lam yin pa red/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje 'di ro mnyam pa'am/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje gnyis po 'di zung du 'jug pa'i lta ba 'di lam mchog tu gyur pa/ lam de lta bu 'di nor 'khrul dang bral ba'i lam red/ lam mchog 'dir 'bral med zer dus dus dang rnam pa kun tu nyin mtshan dang 'bral ba med par dus rtag tu rang rgyud la sgom thub par shog / ya lam mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu la smon pa/ sgom stobs las byung spyan dang mngon shes dang*// sems can smin byas sangs rgyas zhing rab sbyangs// sangs rgyas chos rnams 'grub pa'i smon lam rdzogs// rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum mthar phyin sangs rgyas shog / da rdzogs song*/ sgom stobs las byung spyan dang*/ mngon shes dang*/ de 'dra ba sgom gyi stobs las byung ba'i de lta bu'i zhi gnas dang lhag mthong*/ nyams dang rtogs pa/ snying rje dang stong nyid la sogs pa de 'dra'i thog nas yang spyan lnga dang*/ mngon shes drug dgos kyi yod red/ sems can gyi don byas pa la spyan lnga dang mngon shes drug la sogs pa med na/ sems can gyi don byed shes kyi ma red/

khams dang*/ dbang po/ mos pa so so dang sbyar nas chos ston dgos kyi yod red/ de yang mdzad pa phrin las skyong dgos kyi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus spyan dang mngon shes drug la sogs pa yod pa'i cha nas sems can thams cad smin par byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thob yag la sbyangs thub par byed pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams thams cad rdzogs thub pa zhig gis rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum gyis mthar phyin pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob dgos kyi red lab pa red/ de'ang sems can thams cad mtha' dag ma smin pa 'di smin par byed dgos kyi yod red/ de nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di yongs su sbyangs thub pa dgos kyi yod red/ de nas sangs rgyas kyi chos sam yon tan/ chos zer na yon tan red/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad 'di rdzogs thub pa dgos kyi yod red/ de 'dra yin dus byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ rang mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas yag la rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum mthar phyin pa byas nas sangs rgyas kyi red ma gtogs/ rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum mthar ma phyin pa la sangs rgyas ya'i nus pa yod yod red/ rang sangs rgyas na'ang rgyas thub pa byas kyi red/ rgyas thub ya'i cha rkyen yod red/ rgyas thub kyi red de/ yin na'ang rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum mthar ma phyin pa la sangs rgyas kyi ma red/ dus ma yin pa la sangs rgyas kyi ma red/ de 'dra yin dus dus ma yin pa zer ba'i skabs su rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum mthar phyin bcug nas sangs rgyas kyi yod pa red 'dug /de 'dra yin dus bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo'i nang la/ smon lam chen po bcu rdzogs yag de la smon lam chen po bcu la sogs pa rdzogs yag cig bshad yod sa red/ de nas smin pa de la mdo sde rgyan nang la byang sems rang nyid la smin pa'i mtshan nyid rnam pa dgu 'dra po zhig de 'dra byas nas mtshan nyid rnam pa dgu ldan gyi thog nas smin stangs shig bshad yod sa red/
sbyang yag de la 'dug se byas nas zhing rab tu sbyangs yag 'di da lta bzang spyod smon lam nang la/
