de ltar ma lus chos rnams thams cad du// rgyal ba rnams kyi zhing gi bkod la 'jug / zer yag gi smon lam rgyab stangs de 'dra yin pa red/ de 'dra gsum gyi thog nas rdzogs pa dang*/ smin pa/ sbyangs pa gsum gyi thog nas mthar phyin/ mthar phyin nas sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas par shog / ra smon lam gyis mjug bsdu ba/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*// rnam dkar dge ba ji snyed yod pa'i mthus// de ltar bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// smon lam rnam dag ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig / 'di mtshams sbyor 'dra po bzhag red bzhag /phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs rje dang*/ rang gi tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i rnam par dkar ba'i dge ba lus ngag yid gsum gyi dge ba ji snyed bsgrubs yod pa de'i mthus/ de ltar bdag rang nyid dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyis nges don phyag rgya chen po'i smon lam gang dang gang btab pa de'ang dngos gnas drang gnas kyi lan dang rnam smin la re ba med pa/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can mtha' dag gi don kho na la dmigs pa'i phar phyin nas bshad pa'i 'dun pa gnyis ldan gyi sems bskyed/ shes rab kyis rdzogs sbyangs la dmigs pa dang*/ snying rjes gzhan don la dmigs pa'i blo gnyis po de yis rnam par dag pa'i smon lam ga re btab yod pa 'di/ de dang de lta bu'i chos nyid bden pa'i stobs kyis de lta bu grub par shog lab pa red/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje dang gcig /nga rang gi smon lam btab pa dang gnyis/ chos nyid kyi nus pa gsum po 'di 'dzoms na grub thub kyi yod red/ dwags po thar rgyan nang la 'dug a/ 'di gsum ma rdzogs na re re ba'i thog nas yong thub kyi ma red zer/ sems can gyi smon lam kho na yis kyang yong thub kyi ma red/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje kho na yis yong thub kyi ma red/

chos nyid kyi nus pa kho na yis yong thub kyi ma red/ de gsum mnyam du 'dzoms nas smon lam 'di lta bu zhig 'grub thub kyi red lab pa red bzhag /nyung nyung zhig red/ rgyas pa ni si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi 'grel pa dang*/ sman sdong mtshams pa rin po che'i 'grel pa la sogs pa nang la gzigs gnang*/ 'di nas lhag po zhig gsal po zhig yod sa red/ la bsngo ba dang bsgyur byang*/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te// skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs 'khrugs pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba grol bar shog// / ces pa 'di yang bal yul 'phags pa shing kun gyi nye 'gram dpal ban chen phun tshogs dar rgyas gling gi dben gnas su skyabs rje sangs rgyas mnyan pa rin po che mchog nas de bzhin phyag chen smon lam gyi bka' khrid gnang ba de nyid sgra 'dzin 'khor lo'i thog tu yod pa de/ dharma kā ra stsom sgyur tshogs pa nas yig thog tu dbab dgos zhes mthun rkyen yongs rdzogs gnang nas yang yang bskul ba'i ngor bal yul 'phags pa shing kun gyi nye 'gram du gnas 'cha' ba'i dpal karma legs bshad gling bshad grwa'i lo rim gong ma rnams kyis rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing mo bya lo dbo zla'i dmar rdzogs pa gsum par sri zhu rdzogs par bgyis pa de yang nongs pa mchis na gzur gnas mkhas pa'i spyan sngar 'chags la/ cung zad 'bad pa'i dge bas rang gzhan thams cad myur du phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa mngon du 'gyur bar shog /dge'o/// / oṃ swa sti siddhi rastu// deng 'dir gsung rab rin chen 'phrul par du// bzhengs dges legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum du// bgyis pa'i dge tshogs dri ma med pa rnams// gcig tu bsdoms te mthun rkyen sgrub rnams dang*// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag tshe ring 'byor ldan zhing*// ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs te// bla med rnam grol thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo// bstan 'dzin dam pa gang na su bzhugs rnams// sku tshe'i rkyen gegs tha dag rab zhi nas// bstan 'gro'i don chen bla med mdzad bzhin du// dam chos bdud rtsi'i sbrang char 'bebs gyur cig

/yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu lo legs shing*// nad mug 'khrugs rtsod thams cad zhi ba dang*// mi mthun rgud pa'i ming yang mi grags par// rdzogs ldan dang po'i lang tsho 'char bar shog /de'i mthus kha ba ri pa'i skye rgu'i yid// rnam dkar dge ba'i las la phyogs pa dang*// mthun rkyen legs tshogs gong nas gong 'phel te// dam chos 'dzin pa'i snod du rung bar shog /'jig rten dbang phyug phyag na padmo yi// zhabs pad bho ṭa'i ljongs 'dir myur bkod de// zhi bsil chos kyi bdud rtsi'i zil mngar ror// longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang myur 'char shog /khyad par bstan pa'i snying po sgrub brgyud kyi// ring lugs dri med sa chen yongs khyab ste// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams// sku tshe mi 'gyur tshe lha'i ngo bor brtan// phrin las mi zad nyi zla'i 'od dang sdeb// 'dus tshogs dge 'dun bgrang yas rgyu skar la// zab rgyas chos kyi gru char 'bebs par shog /lha rnams mkha' la shis pa'i glu dbyangs len// 'gro rnams bde zhing skyid pa'i yun du 'tsho// klu rnams dga' bas nor 'dzin dbyig gis bkang*// mthar thug sangs rgyas ye shes thob par shog// / ces pa'ang 7rgyal dbang karma pa o rgyan phrin las rdo rje mchog dgung grangs bcu gsum steng*/ 'og min mtshur phu'i gdan sar ljags rtsom gnang ba'i rten gsum gsar bzhengs kyi dge bsngo'i smon tshig byin rlabs can no/// /
